jobs.title: AI & Software Engineering Intern - FinTech Systems
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Our specialized financial services consulting firm has been engaged by an established financial technology and brokerage group to identify a small number of high\-potential students for its AI Engineering Internship, joining the client’s internal AI transformation team. This is not a coffee\-and\-slides internship. Selected students will work directly alongside our client’s senior engineering and department leads, contributing to production software modules, data workflows, and system integrations that the business actually runs on. The work is real, it is reviewed closely, and it ships. The focus is practical engineering: connecting systems through APIs, structuring and cleaning data, and automating internal processes such as client onboarding and the client portal. The role suits students who want to see how a financial technology business operates from the inside and who learn fastest by building. AI is at the core of how this team builds. Interns are expected to work with AI coding assistants and LLM tools every day: to design and write code, explore unfamiliar systems, generate tests, and automate workflows. Hands\-on experience programming with AI is a requirement, not a nice\-to\-have. Our client is looking for curiosity and tenacity above credentials. Students who perform well will be given increasing ownership over individual modules and a clear path toward a longer\-term engagement with the firm. **Our Client** Our client is a financial technology group serving active and institutional traders, with an established product suite spanning execution, market data, and quantitative research infrastructure. As the firm expands its institutional business, it is investing in the internal systems behind it: onboarding, client\-facing portals, data pipelines, and the integrations that connect them. This search supports that build\-out. **Location \& Format** **Location:** New York, hybrid (3 days in office, Midtown, next building from Penn Station) **Format:** Part\-time or full\-time options available **Reports to:** Department leads **Key Responsibilities** * **AI\-assisted development** – Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, CodeX, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of daily work to design, write, test, and document code, and build LLM\-powered steps into internal workflows where they add value * **System integration** – Design, build, and maintain API connectors between internal and external databases and systems * **Module development \& automation** – Support the development and automation of core internal modules, including client onboarding and the client portal * **Data processing \& management** – Structure, clean, and analyze diverse datasets; set up reliable database connections and keep data logic consistent across systems * **Technical collaboration** – Work directly with lead engineers and department heads to translate business logic into working code and automated scripts * **Independent problem\-solving** – Read documentation, investigate unfamiliar systems, and resolve technical problems independently before escalating **Target Candidate ProfileFields of Study** * Master’s or upper\-level Bachelor’s students in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Computational Finance, Financial Mathematics * Ideally with a minor or concentration in Data Science or Finance **Track Record Beyond Coursework** Preference will be given to students who have shown initiative outside the standard curriculum, for example: * Math, physics, or programming olympiads * Coding competitions and hackathons * Business case challenges * Active roles in technical, quantitative, or finance student clubs **Requirements** * **Analytical rigor** – Strong mathematical foundation, logical reasoning, and a structured approach to problem\-solving * **Software \& data fundamentals** – Practical programming experience with a solid grasp of software development principles, APIs, database architecture, and data structures * **Hands\-on AI programming experience (required)** – Demonstrated experience building software with AI coding assistants and LLM tools; be ready to walk through a concrete project and explain how you used AI to build it and how you verified its output * **Curiosity** – Real curiosity about how systems and financial businesses work, evident in projects you started on your own * **Tenacity** – The persistence to work through documentation and unfamiliar codebases and to finish difficult tasks without step\-by\-step guidance * **Coachability** – Openness to direct code review and the ability to apply feedback quickly * Clear written and spoken English **Strong Plus Qualifications** * Experience building with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG, or agent frameworks * Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, or integration and automation platforms * Familiarity with relational databases and basic data modeling * Personal or academic projects available on GitHub or a portfolio * Interest in markets, trading, or financial technology **What This Role Is Not** To save everyone time: this is not a quantitative research or trading position. Our client is looking for strong data skills, sound logic, and solid software engineering fundamentals. Nor is it a role for someone who treats AI tools as optional: they are central to the day\-to\-day work. Equally, this is not a passive observation role. Students who prefer well\-defined tasks with close supervision at every step are unlikely to enjoy it; those who like to take a vague problem, read up, and come back with working code will. *This search is being conducted by a specialized financial services consulting firm on behalf of an established financial technology and brokerage group. All applications will be treated in strict confidence. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for initial screening before being presented to our client.* *Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.* Pay: From $40\.00 per hour Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10123

jobs.title: Advanced 3D Printing Mechanical Engineering Intern
jobs.description: **Advanced 3D Printing Mechanical Engineering Intern** San Francisco · Onsite · Internship **About Bracket Bot** We believe planet earth can thrive and be alive. Robots should manufacture goods, clean roadways, tidy our rooms, build more homes, cook healthy food, and lower the cost of living. We aren’t quite there yet, robots are too expensive, too difficult to program, fragile, and unfriendly. Bracket Bot is changing that. We believe that robots are currently in the ENIAC era and we are bringing them to the Macbook era. We believe in high performance engineering teams where everyone you work with is what you imagined Bell Labs employees to be like. Intelligent, scrappy, dedicated, kind. At Bracket Bot, we have a few objectives. We are working to make the ideal role model of a company, one where everyone is at the top of their field, inventing new ways to solve the problems we face across mechanical, electrical, software, and machine learning. What does a company that creates entirely new ways that teams work together look like? A company that invents new materials for lighter weight actuators and structures? A company that creates and publishes new inverse kinematics algorithms for robots? A company that is thinking radically differently, and executing on another level. In every field there are small teams who did something their peers had decided was impossible. The 10\-second barrier in sprinting, or the eight engineers who left Motorola and made the 6502 for 10x lower cost than other chips at the time making the personal computer possible. SpaceX has landed the same rocket 36 times. Bracket Bot believes actuated, alive machines can be glorious, affordable, easy to use, and ubiquitous, and we are pulling that future forward. Our products are a mirror of what we think about the world, on engineering \& research, and what we think *should* be introduced into the world. In history, there are simply products that *should* exist, and only once created, are obvious in hindsight. Bracket Bot’s mission is to introduce as many of these products into the world as possible. We believe there are hundreds of these in the space of robotics. Across physical robot hardware, software and operating system; the infrastructure and distributed systems they connect to; the AI inference they run, both local and cloud, and so much more. Our first product, Bracket Bot 1, exemplifies what a small team of highly talented people can do. At Bracket Bot, we genuinely believe 100x engineers exist, and a room full of them can create things that dozens of other companies have failed to do. We’ve brought to market a robot that is 10x lower cost than any other robot in its category, while out performing them on manipulation, autonomous navigation, speech interaction, and developer UX. We’re backed by Fifty Years (Scott Phoenix), BoxGroup, SV Angel, Betaworks, Pace Capital, angels including Nat Friedman, Logan Kilpatrick (Google AI), Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and others from Tesla AI, Physical Intelligence, and Markforged. **About the role** Additive manufacturing lets us move quickly from a mechanical idea to a part we can assemble, test, and improve. We’re hiring an Advanced 3D Printing Mechanical Engineering Intern to help develop printed robot parts and the processes used to make them. You’ll work across CAD, print preparation, materials, tolerances, testing, and mechanical iteration. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys understanding why a print or mechanism failed and making the next version better. **What you’ll do** * Design and iterate mechanical parts for additive manufacturing. * Prepare prints and evaluate orientation, supports, fit, strength, and material choices. * Operate and maintain 3D printers and troubleshoot print failures. * Measure parts, check tolerances, assemble prototypes, and test mechanical behavior. * Compare print settings and designs using practical experiments. * Document results and help make successful parts and print processes repeatable. **What we’re looking for** * Hands\-on 3D printing experience and examples of mechanical parts you’ve made. * CAD skills and an interest in mechanisms, materials, and manufacturing. * Ability to troubleshoot print failures and reason about fit, strength, and tolerances. * Patience with measurement and iteration, alongside a drive to build quickly. * Clear communication and careful documentation of results. **Nice to have** * Experience with functional robot parts, assemblies, or fixtures. * Experience testing different materials or improving print reliability. * Experience maintaining printers or managing multiple prints and revisions. **Important notes** * This is a hands\-on internship based onsite in San Francisco. * The work combines mechanical engineering with practical additive manufacturing. * We value useful parts, thoughtful experiments, and evidence of your own builds. Bracket Bot is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a diverse team and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description: **The Company** TelemetryX, formerly Access Control Group, is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Pacific Rim Capital. TelemetryX is a fast\-growing provider of agnostic telemetry data and third\-party asset management services. TelemetryX centralizes fleet intelligence to transform data into operational power — driving continuous improvement across every asset and aspect of fleet operations. Our solutions help clients optimize total cost of ownership, performance, and safety. **Job Summary** The Director of Engineering for Telematics Hardware and Embedded Software is responsible for the design, development, and lifecycle management of telematics hardware and embedded software systems. The Director of Engineering manages internal and external engineering teams responsible for hardware development, embedded firmware, and device platform architecture used in connected equipment and vehicle telemetry solutions. The Director of Engineering ensures reliable, scalable, and cost\-effective device platforms while coordinating closely with product management, operations, and outsourced manufacturing and engineering partners. **Key Responsibilities** The primary duties include: * Lead development of telematics platforms including cellular, GPS, sensor interfaces, and power management systems and embedded software and firmware. * Manage the full product development lifecycle from concept through production and field deployment and * Manage contract manufacturers, suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure timely production and delivery of telematics hardware and coordinate with outsourced manufacturing partners to ensure design for manufacturability, design for test, and production quality. * Establish and maintain engineering processes for design reviews, documentation, testing, and release management and implement metrics to track development timing, product reliability, and productivity. * Define system architecture for telematics devices including communications, data processing, over\-the\-air updates, and security. * Oversee device certification efforts including cellular, FCC, carrier approvals, and environmental compliance. * Ensure devices meet quality and reliability requirements and standards. * Lead and mentor multidisciplinary engineering teams including hardware, embedded software, and systems engineers. * Work with operations and supply chain to manage component selection, cost targets, and lifecycle risks. * Collaborate with product management to translate market requirements into technical specifications and development roadmaps. * Support customer deployments by assisting with technical troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis of field issues. **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. Master’s degree preferred. * 10\+ years of experience in embedded systems and hardware product development. * 5\+ years leading engineering teams. * Experience developing connected devices, telematics systems, cloud\-connected IoT platforms. * Experience with wireless technologies such as LTE, LTE\-M, NB\-IoT, WiFi, or Bluetooth. * Experience bringing hardware products from concept through production. * Experience working with contract manufacturers. * Experience designing ruggedized or automotive\-grade electronics. * Experience with certification processes (FCC, PTCRB, EE, carrier certification). * Familiarity with GPS/GNSS systems and vehicle or equipment interfaces (CAN, OBDII, J1939, sensor I/O). * Knowledge of OTA update frameworks and device security architecture. **Compensation and Benefits** * **Salary**: $188,000 \- $213,000 * **Performance Bonus**: Eligible for a quarterly bonus of up to 20%, bringing the total compensation range to $225,600\-$255,000\. * **Health Benefits**: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, along with an Employee Assistance Program and 401(k) plan with company match, available for full\-time employees. * **Paid Time Off**: Accrue three weeks of PTO annually. * **Holidays**: Enjoy 15\.5 paid holidays throughout the year. *TelemetryX is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.* *If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact the People and Culture department.* *We believe that diversity of thought, background, and experience makes us stronger and helps us better serve our employees, customers, and communities.*

jobs.description: **Columbia Gorge Education Service District** **Job Description** **Job Title:** Director of Technology Services **Assignment:** Technology Services **Reports To:** Superintendent **Evaluated By:** Superintendent **FLSA Status:** Exempt / Administrative **Wage:** $126,060\.00 \- $131,790\.00 Annually **JOB SUMMARY** The Director of Technology Services provides executive strategic, operational, and technical leadership for the Columbia Gorge Education Service District’s (CGESD) technology infrastructure, instructional technologies, cybersecurity, enterprise data, and regional service initiatives. Reporting directly to the Superintendent and serving as a member of the Executive Administrative Team, the Director leads the strategic use of technology to support the ESD’s mission of improving student outcomes with excellence, equity, and efficiency. The Director establishes a comprehensive, regional technology vision aligned with Local Service Plan priorities, component school districts, and contracted user needs across classrooms, offices, and schools. The position oversees department operations, directs capital replacement planning and budgeting, manages USAC E\-Rate programs, and supervises Technology Department personnel. Additionally, the Director leads enterprise data governance, Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection, and regional technology coordination. After\-hours and emergency response duties are an expected component of exempt salaried responsibilities. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** *Essential duties of this position include the following. Employees in this position perform some or all of the following tasks. Other related duties may be assigned.* * Leads strategic and operational implementation for the Technology Department, establishing service expectations, departmental workflows, technical standards, and performance benchmarks that align with the CGESD mission, vision, and board strategic goals. * Drives the strategic application of information and instructional technology in offices, schools, and classrooms to enhance student learning and regional operational efficiency. * Supervises, evaluates, and leads Technology Department personnel (including engineers, cybersecurity analysts, database managers, and technical support staff); manages recruitment, workload assignments, professional development, and personnel matters. * Develops, manages, and monitors the Technology Department operational budget in collaboration with Fiscal Services, ensuring fiscal integrity, cost\-effective service delivery, and alignment with district priorities. * Establishes and maintains a comprehensive multi\-year technology replacement and capital improvement plan, evaluating total cost of ownership (TCO) and long\-term sustainability across hardware and software ecosystems. * Directs the district’s E\-Rate program, federal technology grants, and regional funding opportunities to maximize financial resources and cost\-sharing for CGESD and component school districts. * Develops, implements, and monitors a comprehensive enterprise information security and data risk governance plan to safeguard assets, networks, cloud computing, and Personally Identifiable Information (PII). * Ensures that all CGESD and regional district employees receive systematic, ongoing training related to cybersecurity, information security best practices, and data privacy with focused attention on PII protection. * Provides executive leadership and oversight for enterprise networking, virtualized hypervisors, telecommunications, cloud tenant environments (Azure, AWS, M365, Google Workspace), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Student Information Systems (SIS), and database applications. * Oversees enterprise backup strategies, immutable data repositories, and disaster recovery execution protocols, leading periodic continuity testing to ensure high operational resilience and business sustainability. * Provides executive advice to the Superintendent, Board of Directors, and administrative team regarding technology investments, emerging instructional technologies, information security, and technical risk management. * Facilitates regional technology governance, local service plan alignment, and collaborative committees with component school district superintendents, technology directors, and educational partners. * Negotiates systems acquisitions, software licenses, vendor contracts, and end\-user service agreements in accordance with district procurement guidelines and state regulations. * Acts as executive technical escalation lead for major network disruptions, critical cybersecurity incidents, system outages, or complex inter\-agency technical integration challenges. * Coordinates with district facility leaders regarding long\-range infrastructure design, low\-voltage installation standards, and building technology systems in existing and new facilities. * Maintains accurate department documentation, inventory records, egulations. **Strategic, Analytical, and Communication Skills** * Visionary Strategic Planning: Ability to align technology investments with educational outcomes, equity, and regional Local Service Plans. + Executive Communication: Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical and quantitative concepts clearly to school boards, superintendents, and non\-technical stakeholders. + Inter\-Agency Collaboration: Skill in building regional partnerships, negotiating multi\-district service agreements, and fostering cooperative technology models. **Licenses and Clearances** * Valid Oregon Driver’s License and evidence of insurability. + Criminal Justice Fingerprint Clearance. + Successful completion of ESD background screening. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Founding Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You own how MintMCP shows up in the world. We're defining a category as it forms — how enterprises put AI agents to work without handing over the keys — and you're the one who turns a deep, fast\-moving technical product into a story that engineers, security leaders, and buyers actually get. This is a founding role, so you own the whole arc. You'll set our messaging and narrative, the source of truth for what we say, to whom, and why it matters, and you'll hold it steady as the product and the market move underneath you. You'll drive launches end to end, from narrative to release to follow\-through, staying close enough to customers to carry each release from beta to broad availability and own how activated people are on what ships. You'll turn customers like Coursera, Stability AI, and Modern Treasury into case studies and proof. You'll establish MintMCP's point of view on agent governance and get it heard through thought leadership, the SEO/AEO engine, and the agencies that scale it. jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Engineer
jobs.description: **Machine Learning Research Engineer** San Francisco · Onsite · Full\-time **About Bracket Bot** We believe planet earth can thrive and be alive. Robots should manufacture goods, clean roadways, tidy our rooms, build more homes, cook healthy food, and lower the cost of living. We aren’t quite there yet, robots are too expensive, too difficult to program, fragile, and unfriendly. Bracket Bot is changing that. We believe that robots are currently in the ENIAC era and we are bringing them to the Macbook era. We believe in high performance engineering teams where everyone you work with is what you imagined Bell Labs employees to be like. Intelligent, scrappy, dedicated, kind. At Bracket Bot, we have a few objectives. We are working to make the ideal role model of a company, one where everyone is at the top of their field, inventing new ways to solve the problems we face across mechanical, electrical, software, and machine learning. What does a company that creates entirely new ways that teams work together look like? A company that invents new materials for lighter weight actuators and structures? A company that creates and publishes new inverse kinematics algorithms for robots? A company that is thinking radically differently, and executing on another level. In every field there are small teams who did something their peers had decided was impossible. The 10\-second barrier in sprinting, or the eight engineers who left Motorola and made the 6502 for 10x lower cost than other chips at the time making the personal computer possible. SpaceX has landed the same rocket 36 times. Bracket Bot believes actuated, alive machines can be glorious, affordable, easy to use, and ubiquitous, and we are pulling that future forward. Our products are a mirror of what we think about the world, on engineering \& research, and what we think *should* be introduced into the world. In history, there are simply products that *should* exist, and only once created, are obvious in hindsight. Bracket Bot’s mission is to introduce as many of these products into the world as possible. We believe there are hundreds of these in the space of robotics. Across physical robot hardware, software and operating system; the infrastructure and distributed systems they connect to; the AI inference they run, both local and cloud, and so much more. Our first product, Bracket Bot 1, exemplifies what a small team of highly talented people can do. At Bracket Bot, we genuinely believe 100x engineers exist, and a room full of them can create things that dozens of other companies have failed to do. We’ve brought to market a robot that is 10x lower cost than any other robot in its category, while out performing them on manipulation, autonomous navigation, speech interaction, and developer UX. We’re backed by Fifty Years (Scott Phoenix), BoxGroup, SV Angel, Betaworks, Pace Capital, angels including Nat Friedman, Logan Kilpatrick (Google AI), Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and others from Tesla AI, Physical Intelligence, and Markforged. **About the role** Machine learning should give robots useful capabilities that hold up beyond a single demonstration. We’re hiring a Machine Learning Research Engineer to develop, evaluate, and integrate models for physical robots. You’ll work across research experiments, data, model evaluation, and inference to turn promising ideas into working robot behavior. You’ll collaborate with robotics and software engineers, test on real hardware, and use observed failures to guide the next experiment. **What you’ll do** * Develop and evaluate machine learning approaches for robot perception and behavior. * Build data and evaluation workflows that make model performance and failure modes clear. * Run experiments, compare approaches, and communicate results and tradeoffs. * Integrate models into robot software and test them on physical hardware. * Improve inference performance and reliability within practical compute and latency constraints. * Work with robotics and software engineers to turn research results into useful product capabilities. **What we’re looking for** * Strong machine learning fundamentals and practical research engineering skills. * Experience implementing, training, or evaluating models. * Ability to design useful experiments and reason carefully about results. * Strong programming skills and comfort working across research and production code. * Interest in physical robots and willingness to test ideas against real\-world behavior. **Nice to have** * Experience with robotics learning, computer vision, multimodal models, or control. * Experience with simulation, robot datasets, or real\-world evaluation. * Experience optimizing inference on constrained hardware. * Open\-source work, research projects, or shipped ML systems that demonstrate your approach. **Important notes** * The role combines research with implementation and testing on robots. * We value clear experiments, honest evaluation, and capabilities that work in practice. * You’ll help shape how machine learning becomes part of the product. Bracket Bot is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a diverse team and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We develop AI products that operationalize AI across enterprises operating in complex regulatory environments. We partner with other NTT companies (NTT DATA Inc, NTT DATA Japan, NTT Docomo) to ensure successful deployment to NTT clients. Our clients benefit from AIVista's deep product AI expertise combined with the industry domain and systems integration experience of NTT DATA. **Role Description** The Member of Technical Staff\- AI Engineer role involves designing, developing, and deploying AI capabilities, including agentic infrastructure, model customization, and agentic workflows for some of the world's largest enterprises. This is a hands\-on engineering role for engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building or contributing to production AI systems. You will work alongside experienced engineering and science teams to build scalable AI capabilities, solve complex technical problems, and deploy those capabilities within enterprise environments. Successful candidates will be comfortable writing production\-quality software, working with modern AI technologies, and taking ownership of meaningful components or capabilities from implementation through deployment and ongoing improvement. We are looking for engineers who want to build AI systems, not simply consume them. Candidates should have hands\-on experience developing AI\-powered applications, infrastructure, models, or related capabilities and an interest in deepening their expertise in agentic AI systems. **Qualifications** * Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master's or PhD degree preferred. * 3\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including hands\-on experience building or contributing to AI\-powered products or production AI systems. * Strong foundation in computer science and software engineering, with hands\-on experience developing production\-quality software. * Hands\-on experience with at least one or more modern AI technologies or architectures, such as: o Agentic systems and agent orchestration o Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) o Model customization, tuning, or optimization o Large Language Models (LLMs) o AI infrastructure and inference systems o Data processing and knowledge pipelines o Agent protocols or multi\-agent architectures * Experience translating AI techniques or models into practical software capabilities. * Ability to make sound implementation decisions and understand tradeoffs involving performance, scalability, reliability, and cost. * Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn quickly as AI technologies and development practices evolve. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. **Benefits** * **Medical, dental, and vision insurance** * **401(k) plan** * **Significant Company HSA contribution** * **Paid holidays and flexible PTO** The estimated annual salary range for this role is **$180,000–$240,000 USD**. The salary for the successful applicant will depend on job\-related factors such as education, training, work experience, business needs, and market demands. This range may be modified in the future. Total compensation also includes variable pay in the form of an annual target bonus and other cash incentives, with a combined potential of up to 150% of base salary. NTT DATA AIVista is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decisions, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Product Software Engineer II

The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. **Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:** **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. **Messaging Fleet** is responsible for maintaining the Unified Messaging Platform (UMP), a multi\-channel (push, email, sms) marketing support system. The platform provides marketing with the tools needed to drive engagement, retention, and legal transactional messaging requirements through segmentation, targeting, scheduling, and a sophisticated decision engine that automates and personalizes messages for every user. **Responsibilities** * Design core, backend software components for the Unified Messaging Platform and implement tier\-1 microservices in Java. * Implement asynchronous processes to run in the cloud for various data transformation operations. * Lead the design \& enhancement of critical services in UMP, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability. Research and integrate new technologies into the production environment to optimize core service offerings. * Work on tech design for various initiatives and projects as per business needs. * Provide technical guidance to junior team members, covering code quality, system design, and best practices in software development. Actively participate in code reviews, offering constructive feedback to improve code quality, system reliability, and performance. * Collaborate with your squad, Product Managers, Designers, QA, Operations, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and articulate technical decisions and outcomes. * Participate in Agile methodology and SCRUM processes such as Sprint Planning, Backlog grooming, Daily Standups, and Retrospectives with the team. * Provide on\-call support for critical services on a rotational basis. * Own features/functionality and deliver projects end\-to\-end with high quality and robust architecture. * Ramp up on new domains and technologies. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience. * 3\+ years of experience building internet\-scale web or services applications. * Experience in Java, cloud services, and management tools (e.g. Git, SVN, Jira, Basecamp) * Excellent understanding of software development fundamentals * Experience with writing unit, integration and functional tests * Experience with standard CI/CD procedures \& tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Spinnaker. * Proven ability to integrate with service APIs and/or SDKs. * Experience working in a modern, agile software team with version control \& project. **Preferred Qualifications** * Knowledge or certification with AWS services, including ECS (Docker), S3, EC2, Lambda, CloudWatch * Experience with big data technologies \& tools like Spark, Databricks, EMR * Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code tooling * Experience building scalable, fault\-tolerant, high\-uptime systems * Creative and inventive problem solving * Experience mentoring other developers * Experience with UI frameworks (React/Typescript) * Knowledge of JavaScript \#DISNEYTECH The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $123,000 to $165,000 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: QA Engineer (Contract)
jobs.description: CourtAvenue is a company of industry experts accelerating digital transformation for the world’s most ambitious companies. At CourtAvenue, you will be a part of a culture powered by entrepreneurs, technologists, data scientists and the habitually restless dedicated and energized to design products and services that transform businesses while optimizing them for growth. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow within a culture that values innovation while focusing on redesigning the experience between consumer and service (or product) by leveraging a fluid, seamless, and thoroughly transparent engagement. In 2026, CourtAvenue launched a dedicated MarTech practice, bringing enterprise platform strategy, systems integration, and digital experience delivery under one roof. Our MarTech team works at the intersection of the CMO and CTO, designing and implementing platform ecosystems across Adobe Experience Cloud, Contentful (now part of Salesforce), Optimizely, and emerging composable stacks. This is disciplined, standards\-driven platform delivery that earns trust with client IT and marketing leadership alike. The QA Engineer at CourtAvenue works directly with Project Managers and Developers to understand requirements, execute test cases, and identify defects before they reach the client. On the MarTech practice, this role supports DAM migration and platform implementation work, ensuring that content, assets, and integrations are validated thoroughly before release. This is a junior\-to\-mid\-level contract role. You do not need deep Adobe platform expertise to be successful here, though familiarity with Adobe Asset Manager or Adobe Experience Manager is a plus. What matters most is disciplined test execution, clear defect documentation, and a zero\-tolerance mindset for quality gaps. ### **Responsibilities** * Review requirements, specifications, and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback on testability and completeness * Create detailed, well\-structured test plans and test cases for DAM migration, content platform, and integration workstreams * Execute test cases and document results clearly and traceably * Identify, record, and track defects with thorough documentation that developers can act on * Estimate, prioritize, and coordinate testing activities across sprint cycles * Collaborate with CourtAvenue stakeholders across technology, creative, and delivery to clarify unclear requirements before testing begins * Track quality metrics and contribute to sprint retrospectives with QA findings * Stay current on testing tools and strategies relevant to CMS and DAM platform work ### **Requirements** * 2 to 4 years of experience in a QA Analyst or QA Engineer role on digital platform or web development projects * Experience writing clear, concise, and comprehensive test plans and test cases * Familiarity with Agile and Scrum development processes; comfortable working within sprint ceremonies * Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira * Strong written communication skills; your defect reports should speak for themselves * Adobe Asset Manager or Adobe Experience Manager familiarity is a plus but not required; experience with any DAM or CMS platform is valued * Experience with performance or security testing is a plus $55 \- $75 an hour Contract rate to be discussed. This is a junior\-to\-mid\-level engagement scoped for DAM migration support. *CourtAvenue, INC. is an* ***Equal Opportunity Employer****. CourtAvenue recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or genetic information.* *CourtAvenue, INC. participates in the* ***E\-Verify program****. jobs.title: Research Engineer / Research Intern — Embodied AI & Robotic Manipulation
jobs.description: About the role **Overview** ------------ RealHand is an AI robotics company building dexterous robotic hands and the intelligence that drives them. The goal of the company is to give machines human\-level dexterity — hardware that survives real\-world contact, and policies learned from how humans actually use their hands. Our hands are deployed on humanoid and mobile platforms across research, automation, and human\-robot collaboration. RealHand is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA. We are looking for full\-time Research Engineers and Research Interns to develop algorithms and systems for embodied AI and robotic manipulation. The work focuses on enabling robots to understand multimodal instructions, learn from data and physical interaction, and perform complex manipulation tasks using robotic arms, dexterous hands, and bimanual systems. Research areas include foundation models, robot learning, perception, manipulation, planning, reasoning, and real\-world robot deployment. This is an algorithm\-focused role, with physical robotic systems serving as the primary platform for developing and evaluating new methods. On\-site · Available as a full\-time or internship opportunity. Salary range: $20\-$75/hour based on experience. What you will do **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop learning, perception, reasoning, and planning methods for robotic manipulation, including grasping, assembly, tool use, and long\-horizon tasks. * Explore foundation models, VLM/VLA models, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and multimodal robot learning. * Develop visual and 3D perception methods for object localization, pose estimation, grasp planning, and manipulation. * Combine learned robot policies, motion planning, manipulation skills, reasoning, code generation, and tool use into reliable execution systems. * Develop feedback, verification, memory, and failure\-recovery methods that enable adaptation during physical interaction. * Improve policy reliability, generalization, execution efficiency, and inference latency. * Design and conduct experiments on physical robots, including automated evaluation, failure analysis, and policy improvement. * Contribute to research publications, datasets, demonstrations, and open\-source projects. What you bring **Requirements** ---------------- * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, AI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Strong Python programming skills and solid foundations in machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or related algorithms. * Research or engineering experience in one or more of the following areas: robotic manipulation; robot learning; computer vision / 3D vision; multimodal foundation models; VLM / VLA models; imitation learning; reinforcement learning; motion planning and robot control; or LLM/VLM reasoning, planning, tool use, or code generation. * Experience working with physical robots is highly desirable. * Ability to independently implement algorithms, build research prototypes, design experiments, and analyze failure cases. * Must be able to start within three months. * Must have valid U.S. work authorization; OPT and CPT are accepted. Nice to have **Bonus qualifications** ------------------------ * Experience with dexterous manipulation, contact\-rich tasks, bimanual coordination, or force/tactile sensing. * Experience with large\-scale robot data collection, behavior cloning, diffusion policies, VLA models, or reinforcement learning. * Experience with automated policy improvement, memory, feedback, or failure recovery. * Relevant publications at major AI, robotics, or computer vision conferences. * Strong open\-source contributions or demonstrated ability to reproduce and extend recent research.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer [NYC]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payors, and government agencies run their patient\-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre\-visit intake, care navigation, post\-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction. Unlike single\-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments and not just one narrow use case. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you. **About this role** =================== As a Sales Engineer at Concurrence, you'll own the technical side of a deal from first conversation through signature. You'll work alongside the account executive with CIOs, chief medical officers, and their teams, establish what their environment supports, and build the demo that proves it. It's a hands\-on role: our sales engineers write code, and the job is to show a prospect what's possible, not only what already exists. The role exists so our Applied AI Engineers can stay focused on production deployments. You own the pre\-sales technical surface: scoping what we can do, building proof\-of\-concept agents, running technical discovery, and making the product feel real before anything is signed. You'll often be the only technical person in the room, so the role suits someone who can carry that without support. The standard we work to is that a demo should hold up as a product rather than a services engagement. We're building the team around two complementary strengths, and we'd rather someone be excellent at one than adequate at both. The first is building: you'd rather prototype five ideas in a week than polish one for a month, and you're happy being the first person to try the platform in a clinical domain we haven't touched. The second is domain depth: understanding how health systems operate, who signs, and who blocks. Over time we want coverage across the ecosystems our customers run on, including Epic, Cerner, Salesforce, and on\-premise deployments. **What you'll do** ================== * Build rapid POCs and demo environments tailored to specific prospect workflows and clinical use cases * Partner with account executives during technical discovery to scope what's possible and shape deal architecture * Design and deliver live technical demonstrations that translate prospect pain points into working agent experiences * Prototype experimental agent configurations that explore new use cases and push the boundaries of what our platform can do * Run technical deep dives with prospect clinical, IT, and operations teams to understand integration requirements and workflow constraints, including EHRs and payor systems we haven't worked with before * Create reusable demo assets and POC templates that accelerate future sales cycles * Write the reference architectures, pricing and sizing models, and persona maps our cloud and data partners need to put us in front of their field teams * Translate technical objections into solutions during the sales process, including security, compliance, and integration feasibility * Collaborate with Applied AI Engineers to hand off won deals cleanly, documenting POC learnings and customer expectations * Feed insights from the field back to product and engineering: what prospects are asking for, what patterns emerge, and where the platform should go next * Stay current on AI and LLM developments and competitor capabilities **What we're looking for** ========================== * Experience in sales engineering, solutions engineering, or a technical pre\-sales role at a SaaS or AI company, with deals you can point to and describe your own technical contribution on * Strong hands\-on coding ability. You can build a working prototype, not just talk about one, and you're proficient in Python * Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering,  run a room, presenting to technical and executive audiences, handling objections live, and thinking on your feet * Strong discovery skills: you ask the right questions to uncover real problems, not just stated requirements * Experience working deals alongside account executives, and an understanding of sales cycles and buyer psychology * Clear technical communication. You can explain complex systems to non\-technical stakeholders without dumbing it down * Comfort with ambiguity: prospects don't hand you clean requirements, and you thrive in that environment * You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar * You can work on site in New York City **Nice to have** ================ * Experience in healthcare technology or another regulated industry * Background as a software engineer who moved into a customer\-facing role, or the reverse * Deep knowledge of one ecosystem we sell into (Epic, Cerner, Salesforce, on\-premise health systems), including how those organizations buy * Familiarity with healthcare workflows, clinical terminology, and interoperability standards such as FHIR * Understanding of healthcare compliance requirements such as HIPAA and SOC 2 * Experience building demo environments or sandbox platforms * Experience with voice agents, and the latency and quality tradeoffs in speech to text and text to speech * Experience building cloud partner motions, such as AWS or GCP marketplace listings and joint reference architectures * A track record of directly influencing deal outcomes through technical work **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas—not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer — E-commerce Platform
jobs.description: **Position Details** * **Employment:** Full\-time, permanent W\-2 employee. * **Location:** Fully remote within the United States; no office attendance or relocation required. * **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 40 working hours per week. Saturday and Sunday off. * **Working hours:** Flexible start and finish times, with availability from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Central Time for collaboration. Lunch breaks are outside working hours. * **Base salary:** $175,000–$205,000 USD annually, before taxes, paid biweekly. * **Reports to:** Head of Engineering. * **Travel:** None required. **About ParcelNest** ParcelNest Technologies builds software that helps online retailers manage orders, inventory, and shipping through one platform. Our team focuses on making everyday operations simpler and more reliable for growing businesses. **About the Role** You will design and develop the backend services behind ParcelNest Hub, with a focus on order processing, inventory synchronization, and third\-party integrations. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with ownership of technical decisions, from initial design through deployment and ongoing improvement. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Support to turn real customer problems into reliable software. **What You’ll Do** * Build and maintain backend services and APIs for orders, inventory, and shipping workflows. * Develop integrations with e\-commerce platforms and shipping providers, including authentication, webhooks, and data synchronization. * Design background processing that handles retries, duplicate events, and third\-party service failures safely. * Improve database performance, data integrity, and the reliability of customer\-facing features. * Own projects from technical proposal and implementation through testing, rollout, and monitoring. * Investigate production issues during working hours and address their underlying causes. * Review code, document important decisions, and mentor teammates through pairing and constructive feedback. * Work with Product to balance customer needs, delivery timelines, and long\-term maintainability. **What You’ll Bring** * At least five years of professional backend software engineering experience. * Strong production experience with Python and a framework such as FastAPI or Django. * Strong SQL skills and experience designing, maintaining, and optimizing PostgreSQL databases. * Experience building APIs and integrating with external services. * Practical understanding of asynchronous processing, message queues, idempotency, and failure recovery. * Experience deploying and supporting applications in a cloud environment, preferably AWS. * Confidence writing automated tests, reviewing code, and using logs and metrics to diagnose problems. * Clear written and spoken English and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote team. * Experience independently delivering a substantial feature or service from design to production. A computer science degree is welcome but not required. We value relevant experience and demonstrated engineering judgment. **Nice to Have** Experience with Shopify or WooCommerce integrations, fulfillment systems, multi\-tenant SaaS products, Redis, Terraform, or application observability. You do not need experience with every tool in our stack to apply. **Our Technology Stack** Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. **Compensation and Working Expectations** The base salary range is $175,000–$205,000\. Your offer will reflect relevant experience, system design skills, and the level of responsibility you can take on. The same range applies across eligible U.S. locations. This is a salaried position. The stated range is base pay and does not include the value of benefits. No variable bonus or equity award is included in this sample package. Compensation is reviewed annually. We plan work around a 40\-hour week. This position does not include an after\-hours on\-call rotation or scheduled evening or weekend work. **Benefits** * **Medical, dental, and vision:** Coverage begins on the first day of the month following hire. ParcelNest pays 90% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums. * **401(k):** Eligible after 90 days, with a dollar\-for\-dollar employer match on the first 4% of eligible pay you contribute. Employer contributions vest immediately. * **Paid time off:** 20 vacation days accrued annually, plus 7 paid sick days and 10 paid company holidays. * **Parental leave:** 8 weeks of paid leave after 12 months of employment. * **Life and disability insurance:** Company\-paid basic life and short\-term disability coverage. * **Remote equipment:** Company\-provided laptop, monitor, and accessories, plus a one\-time $750 home\-office allowance. * **Internet support:** $75 monthly reimbursement toward home internet. * **Professional development:** Up to $1,500 annually for approved courses, certifications, books, or conferences. * **Paid onboarding:** A structured introduction to the product, architecture, and development process, with an assigned engineering buddy. **How We Work Together** We value thoughtful engineering, clear communication, and people who follow through. You will have room to work independently, with teammates available to discuss a design or help investigate a difficult problem. We document decisions, keep meetings focused, and give feedback respectfully. Asking for help is welcome. When something breaks, we focus on understanding the failure and improving the system. You can contribute fully whether you are outgoing or more reserved. Social activities are optional, and personal time is respected. **Your First 90 Days** * **First 30 days:** Learn the product and architecture, set up your development environment, and ship an initial improvement with support from your onboarding buddy. * **By 60 days:** Own a scoped backend feature or integration improvement through design, testing, and release. * **By 90 days:** Independently lead a project and contribute a practical improvement to reliability, performance, or the development process. Success is measured by reliable delivery, sound technical decisions, maintainable code, and effective collaboration. **Hiring Process** * A 30\-minute introductory conversation about your experience and expectations. * A 60\-minute practical coding and debugging session using a small sample service. * A 60\-minute system design discussion based on an e\-commerce workflow. * A 30\-minute conversation with the Head of Engineering about collaboration and ownership. No unpaid take\-home project is required. The target process takes two to three weeks, with time for your questions at every stage. **Eligibility and Application** Candidates must reside in the United States and be authorized to work there. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. An English\-language résumé is required. A LinkedIn profile, GitHub profile, or examples of relevant work are optional; a cover letter is not required. ParcelNest welcomes applicants from different backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Pay: $175,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Engineer

jobs.title: Senior or Staff Design Verification Engineer
jobs.description: **Design Verification Lead** **Reports To:** Head of Engineering **About Us** Powerlattice is a well\-funded semiconductor start\-up company backed by leading Silicon Valley venture capital firms. We are developing groundbreaking chiplet power delivery technology that will transform how high\-performance processors are powered, enabling the next generation of AI and advanced computing. **About the Role** We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on Senior or Staff Design Verification Engineer to spearhead verification activities for complex SoC/IP designs, developing scalable SystemVerilog\-based verification environments, verification strategies, reusable test infrastructure, and automated regression flows. This position drives functional verification from RTL through gate\-level simulation, including coverage closure, assertions, timing verification, and debug. They will collaborate closely with RTL, analog, architecture, and silicon validation teams to identify and resolve design issues. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead verification planning and execution for complex digital and mixed\-signal subsystems, including defining verification strategies, test scenarios, coverage goals, and signoff criteria. * Architect, develop, and maintain SystemVerilog\-based verification environments and reusable verification infrastructure. * Develop directed, constrained\-random, regression, and corner\-case tests to verify functional requirements and design specifications. * Develop reusable verification components and protocol\-based test infrastructure for I2C/I3C, SPI, JTAG, AMBA, and OBI interfaces. * Perform and support Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) verification for async and sync clock\-domain interfaces. * Develop and maintain UVM\-based infrastructure and RAL models where applicable. * Develop checkers, scoreboards, reference models, assertions, and functional coverage to provide comprehensive verification of design behavior. * Perform RTL and gate\-level simulation, including SDF\-annotated GLS, to identify functional, timing, initialization, reset, and connectivity issues. * Develop and optimize regression and GLS flows using Xcelium and VCS. * Analyze functional and code coverage and drive coverage closure by identifying verification gaps and developing targeted tests. * Debug complex RTL, testbench, simulation, and gate\-level failures using waveform and log analysis. * Work closely with RTL designers, analog designers, architects, and silicon validation teams to reproduce issues, determine root cause, and drive resolution. * Review specifications and RTL to identify corner cases, interface issues, reset/clocking problems, and potential functional gaps. * Translate silicon validation findings into simulation\-based verification scenarios and regression tests. * Provide technical leadership to a team of verification engineers. Mentor the team in verification methodologies, tools, and coverage improvements. **Qualifications** This is a **Hybrid role requiring 3 days a week onsite at our HQ’s in Vancouver, WA (Greater Portland Area) or Chandler, AZ.** *While we are primarily seeking candidates in HQ\-Vancouver and Chandler, remote flexibility may be considered for exceptional candidates in Silicon Valley, CA.* * Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field * 10\+ years of experience in digital verification of SoCs with proven ownership of subsystems or full\-chip verification. * Solid Understanding of: * Digital design fundamentals, FSMs, CDC, RDC, mixed\-signal subsystems, and SoC integration. * Industry\-standard protocols including AMBA, I²C, I3C, SPI, JTAG, and OBI. * Strong Expertise in: * Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM and class\-based verification methodologies. * Constrained\-random, coverage\-driven verification, regression automation, and verification signoff. * SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), formal verification techniques. * Python, Perl, and UNIX/Linux shell scripting for automation. * Hands\-on experience developing testbenches, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, assertions, and reusable verification IP. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to debug complex issues, communicate clearly, mentor engineers, lead technical initiatives, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Experience with industry\-standard EDA tools (Synopsys, Cadence) **Preferred Qualifications** * Working knowledge of PMIC architectures and power management principles. * Experience with formal verification techniques **Compensation \& Benefits** Anticipated annual base salary for Member of Technical Staff: $160k \- $190k * Stock option grant * Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and 401(k)
