jobs.description: **About Exponent** ------------------ **Exponent** is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges. Our vision is to engage multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability. Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team! **Key statistics:** * 950\+ Consultants * 640\+ Ph.D.s * 90\+ Disciplines * 30\+ Offices globally **Our Opportunity** ------------------- We are currently seeking a **Scientist** for our **User Sciences** Practice to be based in our **Philadelphia, PA** office. In this role, you will work as part of a team to conduct user experience (UX) and usability research across a range of projects spanning consumer electronics hardware and software, medical devices, wearable technology, and artificial intelligence (AI) applications. Your work will help clients understand how users interact with their products—uncovering usability challenges, informing design improvements, and providing insights into safe and intuitive use. You will collaborate with a team of scientists and engineers from complementary disciplines to deliver research\-driven insights that are rigorous, actionable, and clearly communicated to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Projects will often span study design through data collection, analysis, and final reporting. **You will be responsible for** ------------------------------- * Reviewing and synthesizing scientific literature, technical data, and industry standards to ground research and inform study design and expert analysis * Designing and executing primary user research studies including usability testing, surveys, interviews, and observational research with careful attention to human perceptual, cognitive, and physical capabilities and limitations * Performing quantitative and qualitative data analysis including, for example, statistical analysis of behavioral and performance metrics and thematic analysis of qualitative data * Providing project management for multiple projects at a given time, including overseeing budgets and deadlines, coordinating project teams, and performing support tasks for team members * Preparing written reports and communicating complex analyses and findings clearly and succinctly to technical and non\-technical audiences * Developing client contacts and building foundational business development skills through client interactions, supporting proposals, and gaining exposure to consulting strategies across a variety of areas (e.g., consumer products, medical devices, etc.) **You will have the following skills and qualifications** --------------------------------------------------------- * Ph.D. in Developmental, Experimental, or Cognitive Psychology, Neuroscience, Vision Science, Data Sciences, Biomechanics, or a related discipline * Currently based in or are willing to relocate to the Philadelphia area * Willingness to travel for research sessions, client meetings, or on\-site evaluations * Breadth of knowledge of scientific literature from relevant fields along with the ability to creatively adapt expertise to specific and novel problems * Strong record demonstrating your ability to design and execute human subjects research studies using a variety of methods (e.g., usability testing, survey, experimental, quasi\-experimental, case study) * Experience leading multiple scientific studies from start (i.e., design) to finish (i.e., communicating your results) * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills * Assertive, self\-starter, and able to work with accuracy and attention to detail under pressure and/or deadlines * Proficiency in analytical, statistical, and computer programming (specifically Excel, MATLAB, Python, R, or SPSS) * Presently legally authorized to work in the United States; no immigration sponsorship or processing required *Applicants are encouraged to submit a CV (Curriculum Vitae) with publications (feel free to include publications that are in review or pending) \[not restricted to 1 page].* **Life @ Exponent** ------------------- To learn more about life at Exponent and our impact, please visit the following links: https://www.exponent.com/careers/life\-exponent https://www.exponent.com/company/our\-impact Attracting, inspiring, developing, and rewarding exceptional people with diverse backgrounds and expertise are central to our corporate culture. Our diverse team allows us to provide better value to our clients and enjoy an enriched work environment. Our firm is committed to offering a variety of programs and resources to support health and well\-being. We believe that providing competitive benefits as well as compensation and recognition programs empowers our staff to do work that makes a difference. **Work Environment** -------------------- At Exponent, we have found that in\-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging. In our offices, you can expect a supportive culture and a collaborative, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary work environment. Our consultants engage in\-person in the office unless they are traveling for client work or other business activities. We value the rich lives our colleagues enjoy outside of work and understand that work/life balance is critical to our employees and their well\-being. Consultants have the autonomy to balance their work and personal schedules so you can meet with clients, visit inspection sites, attend conferences, and make time for priorities outside of work, too. It is this flexible, agile work style and working hours that allow our teams to drive innovation and results in their own ways, while meeting the needs of clients. \#LI\-Onsite **Compensation** ---------------- Our consultants are rewarded for their technical and business contributions and have an opportunity to plan for future success and career growth. Exponent's total compensation plan is consistent with its expectations of the quality and quantity of work performed and with the professional standards set by Exponent. At the Associate and Senior Associate level, total compensation includes base salary, bi\-weekly bonuses for high\-intensity efforts, annual bonus and 401(k) employer contribution of 7% of base salary. At ExxonMobil, our values aren't just words— they're how we show up, focused on delivering the right answer, the right way, every day. **What role you will play on our team** --------------------------------------- As a Continuous Improvement Cost Engineer, you will be responsible for utilizing your engineering expertise, data engineering skills, and financial knowledge to support our Cost Engineering team and enhance decision\-making processes. improving capital accuracy and efficiency. **What you will do** -------------------- * Manage and support capital cost forecasting and AFE creation custom software, prioritizing incidents and enhancements. * Drive capital cost forecasting process across all represented functions and collaborate with BPS Analytics to design custom software changes that support cost forecasting strategy. * Oversee the AFE lifecycle: own AFE readiness (supporting the LS2Spud process) and post\-job AFE compliance. * Perform financial analysis and modeling to support budgeting and forecasting, integrating engineering and execution data with financial information. * Design, develop, and implement data engineering solutions to collect, process, and analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data from various sources. * Apply statistical analysis techniques to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in the data to support decision\-making and risk assessment. * Design and implement dashboards and visualizations to present key performance indicators (KPIs), financial metrics, and project execution insights to stakeholders at all levels of the organization. * Challenge the status quo, identifying, developing, and implementing enhanced process efficiencies. * Collaborate with finance and accounting teams to ensure accurate cost allocation, tracking of capital expenditures, and compliance with financial reporting requirements. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop and maintain data models, databases, and data pipelines to ensure data integrity, accessibility, and security. **About you** ------------- **Skills and Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering required. * Minimum 4 years of industry experience with cross functional experience control techniques, and financial analysis. * Experience in data engineering, including data integration, data cleansing, and data modeling. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to collect, analyze, and interpret cost data from complex datasets, deriving meaningful insights and actionable solutions. * Excellent numerical and financial acumen, with the ability to work with complex financial models, budgets, and cost control systems. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively present technical and financial information to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Knowledge of industry\-standard cost engineering software, such as Oracle Primavera Unifier or similar cost management tools. Familiarity with financial systems and tools (e.g., ERP systems, financial modeling software, WellView) and ability to integrate financial data with engineering and operational data. * Familiarity with data modeling techniques, data warehousing concepts, and database systems (e.g., SQL, NoSQL). * Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Spotfire, Power BI, or similar platforms, with the ability to create visually compelling and interactive dashboards preferred. * Self\-motivated and adaptable to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities and deadlines. **Your benefits** ----------------- An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Enrollment is automatic and at no cost to you. More information on our Company’s benefits can be found at www.exxonmobilfamily.com. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: FMNE Insurance is seeking a **Data Engineer** to join our growing IT team. We’re looking for someone that'scollaborative and solutions\-focused, who enjoys building reliable, scalable data solutions and solving complex data challenges. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with modern cloud data technologies and a strong commitment to data quality and continuous improvement. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Please submit a resume and cover letter for consideration. We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, a generous 401(k), pension plan, wellness programs and a hybrid work model for eligible employees. **Role Overview of a Data Engineer:** The Data Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable data solutions to support enterprise analytics and operational reporting. This position focuses on building and maintaining data pipelines and architectures using modern cloud technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and SQL Server, enabling the delivery of high\-quality, well\-governed data across the organization. The engineer collaborates closely with data analysts, software developers, business stakeholders, and architects to ensure that data is accessible, accurate, timely, and aligned with business goals. **Responsibilities****:** * Design, develop, test, and maintain data pipelines and transformation workflows using Azure Data Factory and Databricks. * Build and optimize data models, tables, and views to support reporting, dashboards, and self\-service analytics. * Ensure data reliability, availability, and performance through proactive monitoring, alerting, and tuning of ETL/ELT processes and databases. * Work with business and technical teams to gather data requirements, define data contracts, and ensure alignment across stakeholders. * Collaborate with Data Architecture and other teams to support data platform modernization and cloud\-first strategies. * Support CI/CD practices through integration with Azure DevOps and automated data pipeline deployments. * Apply data quality, profiling, and cleansing techniques to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of datasets. * Enforce data governance and security policies, including data classification, lineage, and role\-based access controls. * Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including data dictionaries, pipeline diagrams, and support procedures. * Conduct root cause analysis on data issues and recommend long\-term solutions to prevent recurrence. * Stay current on industry trends, tools, and best practices in the data engineering space. **Skills and Qualifications****:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field; or equivalent experience in data engineering roles. * Minimum 2–4 years of experience in data pipeline development, ETL/ELT, and database systems. * Proficiency in SQL and performance tuning within SQL Server or similar RDBMS platforms. * Hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and related Azure data services. * Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure DevOps tools. * Experience with data modeling techniques, especially in dimensional modeling and schema design for analytics. * Strong understanding of data privacy, security, and governance concepts. * Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell is a plus. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to debug complex data workflows and recommend scalable solutions. * Effective verbal and written communication skills; ability to communicate technical concepts to business stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, self\-organize, and thrive in a collaborative Agile environment. **Preferred**: * Experience with Data Lake architecture, delta tables, and real\-time or near\-real\-time streaming. * Exposure to Power BI or similar data visualization tools. * Familiarity with metadata management, data catalogs, and data lineage tools. FMNE Insurance Company recognizes that an individual with a disability may require accommodation to enable them to successfully perform a job function. Should you require such accommodation, please indicate the job function and suggested accommodation during the interview process. FMNE will attempt to make reasonable accommodation.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Network Architect
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Senior Platform Network Architect/Engineer is responsible for the end\-to\-end design, architecture, and engineering of the Tier\-1 customer platform—an industry\-standard, multi\-tenant, cloud\-hosted ecosystem of virtualized network services with a global footprint. This role leads the technical definition and implementation of next\-generation capabilities, ensuring high availability, resiliency, security hardening, and scalable connectivity (including high\-speed interfaces up to 400G) across globally distributed Equinix POPs and interconnected networks. The engineer will drive parallel\-build and migration interoperability requirements between current platform iterations and the next\-generation platform, while maintaining strict tenant isolation and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities **Platform Architecture \& Design** * Own the architecture and detailed design of the platform infrastructure and networking, including dual rack/dual rail design, high\-speed leaf/spine switch fabric backplane, and flexible resiliency (local HA, geo\-redundancy, regional failover, etc.).) * Define and evolve this multi\-tenant architecture ensuring data confidentiality/integrity and enforcing compute isolation requirements (e.g., no vCPU core thread sharing between customers). * Lead next\-generation platform design enhancements incorporating Dell CPU\-based servers, Red Hat OpenStack and OpenShift, and SONiC Enterprise networking while incorporating novel compute (GPUs, DPUs, etc.) and networking capabilities to grow the overall platform repertoire. **Network Engineering, Connectivity \& Resiliency** * Design and engineer WAN/management network reachability to ensure continuity during single and multiple network failures. * Engineer redundant management access patterns (e.g., jump server connectivity) across platform sites using diverse paths such as AVPN, Teridion IPsec tunnels, and back\-to\-back links via third\-party carriers (e.g., Zayo, Windstream, Zenlayer). * Define and implement high\-speed connectivity standards, including upstream/downstream connectivity up to 400G with support for sub\-rate port speeds. * Maintain and enhance geo\-redundant node designs and HA patterns (logical pairs, local and geo\-redundancy) aligned to contracted customer designs. **Platform Build, Parallel Deployment \& Migration Interoperability** * Lead platform rollout as a full parallel build to existing platforms with no shared functions, ensuring clean separation of environments. * Design and implement interoperability between platforms for migration purposes using cross\-connects within each POP site as required. * Support compute repurposing strategies for post\-migration (e.g., repurposing eligible legacy compute into next\-generation compute). Virtualized Network Functions (VNFs) \& Service Enablement * Architect platform capabilities to host Tier\-1 customer endorsed/approved services (voice and data products such as AVPN, ADI, and other transport services). * Ensure the platform can support VNFs such as virtual routers, firewalls, SBCs, and related network functions at scale. * Contribute to simplified and scalable Layer 2/overlay designs (e.g., VXLAN\-based approaches) and automation patterns that reduce manual configuration and improve consistency. Security, Compliance \& Hardening * Ensure platform engineering aligns with Tier\-1 customer ASPRR accreditation expectations, including robust hardening policies and procedures for production devices and servers. * Partner with security stakeholders to ensure architecture supports confidentiality, integrity, and operational controls appropriate for a shared\-hardware, multi\-tenant cloud environment. **Operational Excellence \& Documentation** * Produce high\-quality architecture artifacts (HLD/LLD), standards, implementation guides, and operational runbooks. * Provide technical leadership across engineering teams and vendors; drive design reviews, risk assessments, and implementation readiness. * Participate in incident/problem management as a Tier 4 escalation point for complex platform/network issues impacting availability or reachability. * \- Contribute to select customer designs owned by dedicated teams (e.g.,. LCM, Consulting) requiring advanced networking, resiliency, and integration of partner ecosystem capabilities (e.g., Equinix Fabric). **Required Qualifications** * 8–12\+ years of experience in network/platform engineering with significant responsibility for architecture and design in large\-scale, multi\-site environments. * Demonstrated experience designing highly available, resilient compute platform architectures serving network functions across geographically distributed data centers/POPs. * Strong background in management network design, secure remote access patterns (jump hosts), and redundant WAN connectivity. * Experience with high\-speed data center networking (100G and above; 400G preferred) and designing for scale and throughput. * Hands\-on experience with virtualization and hosting virtualized network functions (VNFs) and containerized network functions (CNFs) in cloud\-enabled, NFV, or cloud\-native environments. * Experience with Red Hat platforms and other virtualization software used to deploy, operate, and lifecycle\-manage enterprise compute and network\-function environments. * Experience with Kubernetes\-based platforms and container orchestration patterns for CNF deployment, scaling, service discovery, and operational resiliency. * Experience with Redis or comparable in\-memory data stores used for caching, state management, messaging, or high\-performance application/service architectures. * Proven ability to produce architecture/design documentation and lead technical reviews with cross\-functional stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Red Hat\-based infrastructure platforms and lifecycle engineering in enterprise environments. * Familiarity with SONiC\-based switching/network operating systems and modern data center fabric designs. * Experience working in Equinix colocation environments and designing global POP deployment standards. * Knowledge of overlay networking concepts (e.g., VXLAN) and automation\-driven provisioning/service chaining approaches. * Experience supporting regulated or accredited environments with formal hardening standards (e.g., ASPRR\-aligned controls). * Knowledge of AI and GenAI infrastructure concepts, including model architectures, inference traffic patterns, AI provider ecosystems, GPU cluster design, and operational considerations for AI\-enabled services. **Key Competencies** * Systems thinking and architecture leadership in complex, multi\-tenant platforms * Deep troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis across network/compute boundaries * Strong vendor/carrier coordination and cross\-connect planning * Clear written communication and ability to translate requirements into implementable designs * Ability to balance standardization with customer\-specific contracted designs Pay: $60\.00 \- $63\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Manufacturing Technician 2
jobs.description: **Forming Our Future together** FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de\-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America. Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership \& Accountability, Respectfully \& Effectively Communicate, and Motivate \& Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter. **Shift:** The regular hours for this position are Sunday, Monday, Tuesday and every other Wednesday from 6:00am to 6:15pm.**Job Description:** The **Manufacturing Technician 2** performs skilled production tasks in a clean‑room manufacturing environment. This role is responsible for operating and maintaining production equipment, monitoring and optimizing processes, and supporting engineering teams with experiments, data collection, and continuous improvement efforts. The Technician II also contributes to team capability by coaching and guiding less experienced technicians. **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- **Production Operations** * Perform a variety of production activities within a clean‑room environment, following established procedures and safety protocols. * Use specialized systems and software programs to track, control, and document components as they move through the production process. **Equipment Setup, Calibration \& Maintenance** * Set up and calibrate manufacturing equipment to meet operational specifications. * Carry out routine preventative maintenance tasks to ensure uptime, repeatability, and optimal performance. * Identify equipment irregularities, perform basic troubleshooting, and escalate complex issues to engineering or maintenance teams. **Process Monitoring \& Optimization** * Collect, review, and evaluate equipment and process data to perform on‑line adjustments that support process stability and optimization. * Maintain accurate logs, charts, and documentation related to production performance, equipment conditions, and process parameters. **Engineering \& Experimentation Support** * Partner with engineers to conduct tests, trials, and experiments aimed at improving yields, enhancing processes, or supporting new product development. * Provide observations, feedback, and data to enable effective root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts. **Coaching \& Team Development** * Provide guidance, informal coaching, and task‑level training to lower‑level technicians to support skill development, teamwork, and operational consistency. * Promote adherence to safety, quality, and procedural standards across shifts. **Work Environment:** * Work performed primarily in a clean‑room manufacturing setting, requiring adherence to gowning and contamination‑control procedures. * Role may involve frequent standing, repetitive hand motions, and handling small or delicate components. * May require exposure to chemicals, specialty tools, microscopes, or precision measurement equipment. **Skills:** Assembly Manufacturing, Cleanroom Operations, Electrical Assembly, Electrical Soldering, Microscope Inspection, Microsoft Office, PCB Troubleshooting, Product Assembly, PROMIS, Team Organization, Team Player, Teamwork, Troubleshooting**Education \& Experience:** Minimum of 1 \- 2 years of related experience. Operative/Technician roles will typically operate more complex machinery/processes \| Required**Pay Range:** $22\.10 \- $29\.03**Pay Range Explained:** This role in Livermore, California pays between $22\.10 and $29\.03 per hour, depending on your experience, skills, and background. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit\-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** FormFactor is an equal opportunity employer. FormFactor complies with all national, state, and local laws that seek to promote equal opportunities for any applicant or employee without regard to age, race, color, gender, gender identity/expression, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, disability, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, military service, or any other legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Senior Account Executive
jobs.description: **FORTIFY SECURITY** **Senior Account Executive — Physical Security Systems** *Full\-Time · Hybrid / Territory\-Based Greater Los Angeles Area · Base Salary \+ Uncapped Commission* **About Fortify Security** Fortify Security is an enterprise security systems integrator with nearly 15 years of experience designing, selling, installing, and supporting sophisticated physical security systems. We specialize in Verkada solutions and maintain a strong, direct partnership with Verkada's team. We handle everything from single\-site installations to complex, multi\-site nationwide deployments. What sets us apart is how we operate: we are nimble, fast, and obsessed with customer satisfaction. Where larger competitors are weighed down by red tape and slow to act, we move quickly, take real pride in our workmanship, and treat every client relationship as something to be earned and protected. We are looking for an Account Executive who embodies that same standard. **The Role** This is a senior, high\-ownership Account Executive position — effectively stepping into a role currently held by a company leader. You will own the full sales cycle end to end: sourcing and developing new opportunities, responding to inbound leads from our vendor partners (including Verkada), and driving every deal from first contact through close. You will be the primary point of contact and relationship holder for your customers. Your job is to make clients genuinely want to work with you — not because you are selling, but because you are responsive, consultative, sharp, and easy to trust. You will coordinate closely with our sales engineers, keep deals moving, ensure every question is answered fast, and use good judgment about when an account warrants extra investment (site visits, drop\-offs, gifting, and other relationship\-building touches). **The single most important trait for this role: an obsession with fast, thorough communication.** We expect no email, text, or call to sit unanswered for long — as a rule of thumb, within about 30 minutes. That doesn't mean having every answer instantly; it means never leaving someone waiting or wondering. A quick "Great question — let me confirm and get back to you by \[time]" is exactly the standard. The right person already works this way. It's not a policy we have to enforce; it's something that comes from within them. **What You'll Do** * **Actively source and develop opportunities** for new business through proactive prospecting, networking, and relationship\-building within the security and adjacent industries. * **Respond to and own inbound leads** from vendor partners like Verkada — quickly, professionally, and in a way that reflects Fortify's reputation for speed and quality. * **Drive the full sales cycle** from qualification through proposal, negotiation, and close, keeping momentum at every stage. * **Serve as the main point of contact and relationship holder** for your accounts — the person the customer naturally turns to, trusts, and wants to talk with. * **Coordinate closely with sales engineers** to scope and design the right solution, translating customer needs into technically sound proposals. * **Capture the fine details and translate them across audiences** — faithfully carrying every small requirement the customer raised into the sales engineer, shaping a tailored design, and then presenting it back in the customer's own language. You adapt the pitch to whoever is in the room: ROI and cost of ownership for a CFO, liability and operational impact for a COO, integration and infrastructure detail for an IT manager. This is what builds real customer confidence. * **Manage communication, timelines,** and follow\-ups so nothing stalls and no question goes unanswered for long. * **Exercise judgment** about which accounts merit additional investment — extra site visits, drop\-offs, gifts, or other high\-touch efforts — and act on it. * **Maintain long\-term, high\-satisfaction customer relationships** built on a consultative approach rather than a hard sell. * **Keep deals and pipeline organized** with accurate forecasting, follow\-through, and clean handoffs to delivery/install teams. **Who You Are** * **You are relentlessly responsive.** Communication is your obsession, not just a skill. You are compulsively responsive — the idea of leaving a message unanswered genuinely bothers you. You reply fast, keep people in the loop, and never go quiet on someone waiting on you. * **You communicate with detail and clarity.** When you respond, you are clear and complete. You explain things fully so the customer understands exactly what you mean, what happens next, and by when — no vague or half\-answers that create more questions. * You have 5\+ years of proven success in a sales, account executive, or business development role. * You come from the security industry (video surveillance, access control, alarms, or low\-voltage integration) and understand the technical realities of security projects. Verkada experience is a strong plus; we will train the right person on our stack. * You are driven and self\-motivated — you chase opportunities without being told to. * You have both a high IQ and a high social EQ: smart, quick, and genuinely likeable, with strong instincts for how to read and interact with people. * You have delivered proposal presentations and can tailor your message to your audience — speaking ROI and finance to a CFO, liability and operations to a COO, and technical detail to an IT manager — without losing the thread of the design. * You sell consultatively. You solve problems and build trust rather than pushing product. * You are organized enough to run multiple deals at once without letting anything slip. **Bonus Points** * Direct experience with Verkada products (cameras, access control, sensors, and the Command platform). **An existing network of contacts in facilities, IT, operations, or security decision\-making roles.** Experience with multi\-site or enterprise\-scale security deployments. **What We Offer** * Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission on closed deals. * A steady flow of qualified inbound leads from our Verkada partnership, on top of your own pipeline. **FORTIFY SECURITY** A nimble, fast\-moving company where your work is visible and your ownership is real — no red tape. **The backing of an experienced team that can execute on projects of any size, so you can sell with confidence.** Pay: From $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Will you now or in the future require sponsorship to legally work in the U.S.? Ability to Commute: * Van Nuys, CA 91406 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Van Nuys, CA 91406

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Tampa, Florida (On\-site) **﻿About frame Security:** Frame is on a mission to build the future of Human Security in the AI era. With significant funding, a seasoned cybersecurity team building the right product, and a huge market opportunity, we are just getting started. Our AI engine develops security awareness training and attack simulations that empower every employee to make smarter security decisions and eliminate human risk. Frame is trusted by leading global organizations on their journey to prevent AI\-driven, human\-centric attacks across email, voice, video, and beyond. We believe that security starts with humans as the strongest line of defense. Join us as we build the engine that protects the human layer of every organization in the AI era. **Who are we looking for?** Frame Security is seeking a highly energetic, versatile, and technically proficient Sales Engineer to join their building Sales Engineering team. This role is a hands\-on, dynamic role, primarily focused on providing essential pre\-sales technical solutions to our customers and resellers with the goal of logo acquisition. Beyond the initial sale, the Sales Engineer will own the customer onboarding process and act as the technical authority, proactively identifying optimization opportunities within the United Kingdom and Ireland markets. **﻿Key Responsibilities:** * Partner with Sales and Channel teams to lead deep\-dive discovery sessions, uncovering complex customer pain points and architecting tailored security solutions. * Design and execute high\-impact demos and Proof of Concept (PoC) evaluations that clearly communicate Frame’s value and secure technical buy\-in from key stakeholders. * Lead the post\-sale implementation strategy, serving as the primary technical consultant to guide customers through initial setup, maintaining a high standard of customer satisfaction. * Lead the post\-sale implementation strategy, serving as the primary technical consultant to guide customers through initial setup and ongoing usage of the platform. * Act as the technical backbone for our reseller partners, providing the training and support necessary to scale our market presence and ensure partner\-led success. **﻿Success Metrics:** * Sales cycle. * New logo acquisitions. * Customers onboarded. Requirements: **﻿Required Skills \& Experience:** * 2\-5 years of experience in Pre\-Sales/Post\-Sales or "Founding SE" roles. * Technical background with hands\-on experience in enterprise IT environments, including identity management (Entra ID, Okta), SSO/SAML configuration, domain whitelisting, and customer\-facing integrations. * Experience in AI\-driven Cybersecurity and SaaS companies. * A "bias for action" mindset\-comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking initiative. * Demonstrated ability to build technical playbooks, POC templates, and demo environments from the ground up. * Experience with identity providers (Okta/Azure AD), email infrastructure (M365/Google Workspace), and API\-based integrations. * A proven collaborative and clear communicator, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. **﻿Benefits:** * Medical, dental and vision insurance. * Monthly connectivity reimbursement. * Unlimited paid time off. * 401(K) Retirement Savings Plan. * Free daily on site lunch. * On site covered parking. **﻿Why frame:** * High Impact: Build and own processes from start to finish that directly impact our product and customers, affecting millions of people. * Early\-Stage Advantage: Join at the ground floor of a category\-defining company. The decisions you make today will shape how the world thinks about Human Security tomorrow. * Built to Win: Frame is backed by world\-class investors, operating in a market undergoing a fundamental shift, and has the right team and product. * Competitive Salary and Meaningful Equity: Our success is your success. Everyone has a meaningful stake in the company.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote (US) **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- Product R\&D **Compensation** ---------------- * Total Earnings (Base \+ Bonus) $260K – $320K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus At G2, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Now, we have joined forces with Capterra, SoftwareAdvice, and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI. Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK! **About G2 \- Our People** At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (*P*erformance \+ *E*ntrepreneurship \+ *A*uthenticity \+ *K*indness. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people. **About The Role** ------------------ **Summary of Responsibilities:** As a Software Engineering Director, Agentic Evaluations, your responsibilities will center around delivery of useful and credible evaluations of agents offered by software vendors. You’ll enhance the system that performs validation of agent performance, and lead the core team behind it. You will leverage “agent\-first” ways of working, applying agentic engineering techniques to deliver your work to production. ### **Detailed Responsibilities:** ***Build and enhance agent evaluations that run against live agents \[80%]:*** * Help scope out the feasibility and effort involved in evaluating an agent offered by a software vendor, identifying the most practical path to reaching a credible evaluation * Own the full stack of the core evaluation system, from admin \& API surface to eval workflow dispatch * Design evaluation system primitives that generalize across software verticals, so onboarding a new category benefits from reuse * Distill the appropriate and repeatable processes in onboarding and maintaining integrations into repeatable AI skills or agents to increase evaluation velocity * Keep tabs on emerging frameworks and techniques for agent evaluation which offer improvements to evaluations, and provide industry\-accepted means to distribute eval results * Collaborate with data science peers in their pursuit to develop rich and proprietary benchmarks ***Lead a group of engineers and be a source of wider influence \[20%]:*** * You will facilitate the growth and mentorship of a core team of engineers, and be a source of technical leadership and subject matter expertise in evals for them * You will also help socialize the use of evals in agent\-oriented products built by the wider organization. **Minimum Qualifications:** --------------------------- We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. * 10\+ years of professional programming experience in backend or full\-stack environments * 2\+ years of experience directly managing engineers * Expert\-level proficiency in backend development using languages like Python, Java/Kotlin, Typescript/Javascript or Go; strong proficiency in associated backend frameworks like FastAPI or Node.js * Direct experience creating evaluations (evals) against a customer\-facing agent, leveraging agent trajectory trace data and rubrics to measure an agent’s task completion rate, accuracy, correctness, or policy adherence * Direct experience using frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google in LLM\-as\-a\-judge applications * Regular use of coding agent harnesses like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, or Pi as part of the daily development workflow * BS/BA degree in related field ### **What Can Help Your Application Stand Out:** * Experience with agent tool use via direct integration or as mediated by MCP servers * Knowledge of STATE\-Bench, tau2\-bench or similar benchmark frameworks * Experience using Playwright, browser\-use, Chrome DevTools MCP or others to drive user flows in the browser * Experience with durable execution frameworks \& workflow solutions, like Temporal, DBOS, Cloudflare / Vercel Workflows, or similar; or experience with agent sandboxing using AWS E2B, Daytona, Cloudflare / Vercel Containers or similar **Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity** At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. While AI technology supports our recruitment workflow, all final hiring decisions remain under human oversight and judgment. **Your Choice Matters:** If you would prefer that your application be reviewed without AI assistance, you can opt out by entering your email address in the email entry field at the bottom of the Automated Processing Legal Notice. jobs.title: Specialist - Material Characterization
jobs.description: Activities aimed at characterizing, analyzing, and understanding material structure, composition, and performance through metallographic techniques and microscopy methodologies. Work in this role focuses on preparing, examining, documenting, and interpreting material characteristics to support research, development, manufacturing, quality, and failure analysis efforts. Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team. Executes specialized operational and technical tasks with a high degree of independence. Responsible for maintaining laboratory standards, coordinating laboratory operations, ensuring equipment readiness, and delivering accurate characterization results to internal and external stakeholders. **Job Description** =================== **Roles and Responsibilities** * Perform metallographic sample preparation and characterization support for metallic materials, coatings, ceramics, polymers, and other engineering materials. * Conduct sectioning, mounting, grinding, polishing, electropolishing, and etching of materials using established laboratory procedures and best practices. * Prepare specimens for characterization using optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS), and electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), including advanced polishing and electropolishing techniques required for EBSD\-quality specimen preparation. * Acquire, analyze, document, and communicate microstructural characterization results obtained through optical microscopy and SEM imaging. * Coordinate metallography laboratory operations, including equipment maintenance, calibration activities, consumables inventory management, safety compliance, and process documentation. * Troubleshoot characterization and sample preparation challenges and develop improved preparation methodologies for difficult\-to\-prepare materials. * Collaborate with engineers, scientists, and project teams to determine appropriate characterization approaches and sample preparation techniques. * Ensure adherence to laboratory safety procedures, quality requirements, and standard operating practices. * Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and laboratory best practices. * Train and mentor laboratory users on metallographic preparation techniques, microscopy sample preparation methods, laboratory equipment operation, and safe laboratory practices. * Support continuous improvement initiatives to improve laboratory efficiency, quality, throughput, and user experience. * Maintain accurate records of laboratory activities, equipment status, consumable inventories, and characterization results. * Support research and development, manufacturing, quality assurance, and failure analysis programs through timely delivery of high\-quality prepared specimens and characterization data. **Required Qualifications** * + Associate's Degree (AA/AS) or higher in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Engineering Technology, Materials Characterization, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline from an accredited college or university. + Minimum of **10 years of experience** in metallography, materials characterization, microscopy, or related laboratory operations. + Demonstrated expertise in metallographic sample preparation, including cutting, mounting, grinding, polishing, electropolishing, and etching techniques. + Hands\-on experience preparing samples for SEM, EDS, and EBSD characterization, including advanced polishing and electropolishing techniques required for EBSD\-quality specimen preparation. + Experience using optical microscopy for microstructural evaluation and documentation. + Experience coordinating or managing operations within a metallography or materials characterization laboratory. + Experience operating metallographic sample preparation equipment and maintaining laboratory readiness. + Working knowledge of laboratory safety practices, quality systems, and materials characterization procedures. + Ability to generate technical reports and communicate characterization findings effectively. + Demonstrated ability to work independently while supporting multiple customers and projects simultaneously. **Desired Characteristics** * Extensive experience characterizing metallic materials, coatings, ceramics, polymers and other engineering materials. * Experience supporting failure analysis investigations and fractography evaluations. * Familiarity with the principles of EBSD and specimen preparation requirements for successful EBSD analysis. * Strong understanding of microstructure\-property\-processing relationships. * Experience supporting research and development, manufacturing, quality assurance, or failure analysis programs. * Familiarity with ASTM, ISO, and other metallographic characterization standards. * Experience with image analysis software and digital microscopy systems. * Strong organizational, planning, and laboratory coordination skills. * Strong oral and written communication skills. * Demonstrated jobs.title: Principal Project Manager
jobs.description: **What You Will Do:** --------------------- **GFT** is seeking a **Principal Project Manager:** **Power** to join our Team. This role follows a remote work model. This position creates a unique opportunity for an accomplished Power professional to influence project pursuits, expand client relationships, and drive successful project performance within a nationally recognized Power practice. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to investor\-owned utility clients, private developers, and contractor clients, while managing complex multi\-disciplinary, and multi\-office Power engineering projects. This role also offers the opportunity to help grow GFT’s EPC capabilities, while partnering with practice leaders to expand our market presence. Joining the Power team at GFT means contributing to innovative solutions for sustainable power infrastructure. Our team delivers services across transmission, distribution, substations, power generation, renewable energy, grid modernization, protection and control schemes, energy advisory services, and related infrastructure. With a focus on integrating technology, sustainability, quality, and compliance, we consider each project a chance to innovate and enhance quality of life. **What** **you’ll** **be challenged to do:** As a Principal Project Manager, you will manage projects across our portfolio that involve substantial risk and complexity. You will work independently to drive operational excellence, resource coordination, profitable project execution, client satisfaction, and business growth. * Develop and maintain industry relationships to track opportunities and form project teaming relationships. * Manage projects successfully in a fast\-moving EPC environment as we continue to grow our portfolio of EPC work. * Participate in the full lifecycle of projects from initial tracking through execution and project close\-out. * Manage multi\-disciplinary, and multi\-office teams of engineers, project controls, project administrators and other project participants. * **In this capacity, the successful candidate will** **be responsible for** **the following:** * Maintain communication with internal and external customers and stakeholders, focusing on client’s governing bodies, executive managers, and project managers in accordance with the project execution plan. * Negotiate teaming relationships with joint venture partners and/or subconsultants, subcontractors, and vendors. * Negotiate contract scopes and fees with clients and subcontractors. * Review and approve adjustments and modifications to the WBS. * Prepare project status reports with input from other team members. Review and approve project costs through preparation of cost management reports, Earned Value Analysis (EVA), or other techniques * Lead, coordinate, and manage the quality assurance process in accordance with the GFT Quality Management System * Develop and assign budgets, financial forecasts, and resource plans to monitor profitability. Identify potential pitfalls and implement corrective actions. * Develop, coordinate, and efficiently manage the resources to complete the scopes of service involving multiple practices and offices. * Develop project schedules to meet contractual requirements, internal process requirements, and overall project objectives. **Education \| Experience:** ---------------------------- **What** **you will** **bring to our firm:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Construction Management, or Project Management. * Minimum 20 years of progressively responsible experience in project management, engineering consulting, or related industries. * Experience supporting electric utility, power generation, renewable energy, transmission, distribution or substation projects. * Significant experience with project planning, budgeting, scheduling, and resource management principles of projects in excess of $10M. * Professional Engineer (PE) license. * Project Management Professional (PMP) credential. * Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel as required. * Experience with project financial management and performance reporting. * Experience managing subcontractors. * Sound business acumen, financial awareness, strategic thinking, and a results\-oriented approach. * Demonstrable experience using Deltek Vantagepoint, BST, or other financial management software, along with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Power BI, and PowerAutomate tools. * Must have strong oral and written communication skills. * Must be able to analyze and solve problems efficiently and effectively; work independently, prioritize tasks, interpret client requests, and guide others in the execution of tasks. **What we prefer you bring:*** Master’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline. * Experience with EPC delivery frameworks. * Ability to incorporate technology into engineering project delivery and management workstreams, including fluency with Copilot and AI tools. * Knowledge of engineering consulting industry practices and contracting methodologies. * Experience working across multiple disciplines and business lines. **Compensation:** The salary range for this role is $170,000 \- $210,000\. Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location. **Featured Benefits:*** Hybrid (in\-person and remote) work environment. * Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance. * Tax\-deferred 401(k) savings plan. * Competitive paid\-time\-off (PTO) accrual. * Tuition reimbursement for continued education. * Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations * Incentive compensation for eligible positions. **Company Overview:** --------------------- At GFT, a privately held AEC firm, we innovate where transportation, water, power, and buildings converge. We call this the Infrastructure of Life. We measure our success by the strength of our relationships – that’s why we’re the employer of choice for 5,000\+ of the industry’s brightest engineers, planners, architects, inspectors, designers, and more. Our clients choose us for our expertise and prefer us for our nimble approach, creativity, and personal touch. Backed by over a century’s experience, together we’re building a lasting legacy for future generations: stronger communities, a healthier planet, and better lives. **GFT: Ingenuity That Shapes Lives™** is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veterans’ status or other characteristics protected by law. Unsolicited resumes from third party agencies will be considered the property GFT. GFT does require the successful completion of a criminal background check for all advertised positions. **Location:** **Core Business Hours:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM **Employment Status:** Full\-Time **Applicants in the County of Los Angeles\-** Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.**Applicants in the City of San Francisco\-** Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.**Applicants in the State of California**\-Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Microsoft Fabric and AI Director
jobs.description: **Role Summary** GS1 Global Office is seeking a Data Engineer Director to join the Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team. The role will design, build and support secure, scalable enterprise data and analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services and Power BI. It will also develop AI\-enabled data pipelines that connect approved enterprise data with large language model platforms, including Claude AI and other approved enterprise AI tooling. This is a senior, hands\-on individual\-contributor role combining data engineering, business intelligence, AI\-enabled solution development and production support. The role will provide technical leadership, establish reusable engineering standards and work with stakeholders across GS1 Global Office and Member Organisations to translate business needs into reliable, well\-governed data products. **Responsibilities** **Data engineering and architecture** * Design, develop and maintain scalable data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services. * Build and support Lakehouse, Data Warehouse and semantic model solutions using appropriate architecture and reusable design patterns. * Develop reliable data integration processes using Microsoft Fabric Data Pipelines, Azure Data Factory, APIs and other approved integration methods. * Support migration and modernisation initiatives involving Microsoft Fabric and Azure analytics services. * Optimise data processing performance, scalability, maintainability and cost efficiency. * Contribute to enterprise data architecture decisions and the evolution of shared data models and analytics standards. **AI\-enabled data solutions** * Design and build retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines that securely connect approved enterprise data to Claude AI and other approved large language model platforms. * Develop data preparation, chunking, embedding, indexing and retrieval processes that support accurate and traceable AI\-enabled search and analytics. * Support the responsible adoption of approved enterprise AI and development tools, including Claude AI and Claude Code, with secure data\-handling and access patterns. * Evaluate and prototype AI\-enabled analytics use cases with senior leaders and technical stakeholders, considering business value, architecture, risk and guardrails. * Monitor and improve AI pipeline reliability, quality, performance and cost in line with GS1 governance standards. * Maintain appropriate documentation, traceability and human oversight for AI\-enabled solutions. **Business intelligence and reporting** * Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, datasets and semantic models that provide clear and actionable insights. * Support operational reporting, data\-quality reporting and prioritised ad hoc analytics requests. * Work with business stakeholders to understand requirements, define acceptance criteria and translate needs into sustainable reporting solutions. * Promote consistent definitions, measures and reporting practices across the organisation. **Data quality, security and governance** * Implement data validation, observability, monitoring and quality controls across data pipelines and analytics solutions. * Support metadata management, data lineage, documentation, retention and governance requirements. * Design solutions in accordance with GS1 information security, data privacy, access\-control and responsible AI requirements. * Implement role\-based access controls, data classification and auditability appropriate to the sensitivity and intended use of the data. * Identify and escalate data\-quality, security, privacy, model\-risk and governance concerns. **Engineering quality and production support** * Develop automated testing and validation for data pipelines, semantic models, reports and AI\-enabled solutions. * Use Git, source control, CI/CD and environment\-management practices to support reliable deployment across development, test and production environments. * Monitor critical solutions, resolve production incidents and troubleshoot pipeline failures, refresh errors, reporting issues, RAG pipeline errors and performance bottlenecks. * Conduct root\-cause analysis and implement preventative improvements. * Maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks and recovery procedures, and contribute to release validation and business\-continuity activities. **Technical leadership and collaboration** * Provide technical leadership on data architecture, solution design, engineering standards and responsible AI implementation. * Review code and solution designs, share knowledge and coach other team members in data engineering and analytics practices. * Partner with Product Owners, Data Engineers, QA, Software Engineering and business stakeholders across a globally distributed organisation. * Communicate technical options, dependencies, risks and costs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Assess trade\-offs and make recommendations that balance business value, usability, security, scalability, cost and maintainability. * Contribute to planning, architecture discussions, continuous improvement and workload priorities across the BIDA team. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. * At least five years of relevant experience in data engineering, business intelligence or analytics, including responsibility for production solutions. * Strong practical experience with Microsoft Fabric, or significant experience with Azure Synapse, Databricks or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms. * Strong experience developing Power BI reports, semantic models and datasets. * Advanced SQL skills and experience with Azure SQL or comparable relational database services. * Practical experience building ETL or ELT solutions using Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric Data Pipelines or comparable orchestration tools. * Experience with dimensional modelling, data warehousing and enterprise semantic models, including DAX. * Proficiency with Python and/or PySpark for data processing and automation. * Practical experience building or supporting RAG pipelines and working with large language model APIs, such as Claude, OpenAI or comparable platforms. * Experience with embeddings, vector search or vector databases, prompt\-based retrieval patterns and structured and unstructured data integration. * Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD and production monitoring. * Experience implementing data security, role\-based access controls and privacy requirements in cloud data and analytics environments. **Preferred experience** * Microsoft Fabric or related Microsoft data\-platform certification. * Experience with Microsoft Purview, OneLake, Azure DevOps or GitHub. * Experience with Power BI administration, tenant governance or capacity management. * Experience with large\-scale analytical datasets and cloud cost optimisation. * Experience with Claude AI, Claude Code or comparable enterprise AI coding and knowledge\-work tools. * Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, model evaluation and enterprise data\-privacy practices. * Experience working in a global, federated or matrixed organisation. **Skills** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex technical and data\-quality issues. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical teams, functions, locations and cultures. * Strong communication and stakeholder\-engagement skills, including the ability to explain technical topics clearly to non\-technical audiences. * Sound judgement when working with sensitive, confidential or restricted information. * Ability to manage competing priorities and switch effectively between engineering, reporting and operational\-support activities. * Pragmatic, hands\-on and focused on reliable outcomes and measurable value. * Commitment to documentation, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and ongoing learning. * Fluent written and spoken English. **Travel Requirements** This role may require occasional international travel and regular collaboration across European and United States time zones. **IMPORTANT:** Please do not contact hiring managers on LinkedIn. Apply through the advertised application channel and we will be in touch if your experience is a good match for the role. **GS1 is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and a respectful, inclusive workplace. We do not unlawfully discriminate on any ground protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available during the recruitment process and employment.
