jobs.title: Principal Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About Gen** Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award\-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high\-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well\-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. **About the Role** As a Principal Solutions Engineer, you will own the most complex, strategic partner engagements and frontier ICPs end\-to\-end, serving as the technical and strategic authority between our Sales, Partner Success, Product, and Marketing teams. Your focus will center on setting the solution narrative for net\-new verticals, standardizing how the SE function scopes and engages so the work is repeatable and scalable, and mentoring Solutions Engineers to raise the technical and consultative bar across the team. This entails orchestrating high\-stakes demonstrations, architecting solutions in partnership with Forward\-Deployed Engineering where complexity warrants, and driving feedback loops that unblock partners and align the Product roadmap. You will play a critical role in accelerating the adoption of Digital Marketplace Infrastructure as a senior client\-facing member of the Revenue team. Together, we aim to empower regional and community banks, as well as credit unions, to thrive within the digital landscape. **Key Responsibilities:** * Own outcomes across a portfolio of the most complex, strategic partner engagements and frontier ICPs, holding self and others accountable for commitments. * Set solution narratives and architectural framing for net\-new verticals, partnering with FDE on demand\-side complexity when it exceeds the advisory model. * Standardize scoping and engagement models so SE work is repeatable and scalable across the team — building the artifacts and templates others reuse. * Travel with Sales and Partner Solutions for the highest\-stakes prospect and partner meetings, providing technical and strategic authority in\-person. * Lead discovery and solution design for the most strategic opportunities, prioritizing by revenue, risk, and strategic importance across the portfolio. * Architect and personally demo the most technically or commercially complex solutions, going beyond standard product walkthroughs. * Mentor Solutions Engineers on technical depth and consultative rigor; raise the bar on how the team communicates with partners. * Own documentation strategy — create and deploy internal and external best\-practice materials, not just contribute to them. * Drive feedback loops from active partners directly into the Product roadmap, going beyond flagging requests to shaping what gets prioritized. * Align partners, Sales, Partner Solutions, and Product around solution direction on the largest or most ambiguous deals. * Represent the SE function's technical point of view with senior internal and partner stakeholders, and at industry conferences. * Identify expansion and de\-risking opportunities across the portfolio, influencing which deals SE resources are deployed against. **About You** * 8\+ years of experience in a sales engineering or technical account management role, preferably with financial institutions, enterprise tech, or consulting firms \- with a track record of owning the most complex, ambiguous engagements rather than a defined book of business. * Demonstrated ability to set architectural framing and solution narratives for net\-new verticals or frontier use cases, not just execute established integration patterns. * Experience mentoring or raising the bar for other technical/pre\-sales professionals. * Ability to travel for in\-person partner visits at a regular cadence, including the highest\-stakes engagements requiring senior representation. * Proficiency translating technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences, including in ambiguous or unscoped situations. * Track record of building repeatable scoping frameworks, playbooks, or engagement models that scale a function — not just delivering individual engagements well. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with senior client and internal stakeholders. * Strong judgment on when to pull in technical resources to help resolve partner blockers, accelerating time\-to\-activation. * Detail\-oriented with strong problem\-solving skills; comfortable operating with less structure and more ambiguity than a Senior\-level scope. **What’s next:** * Recruiter Phone Screen * Hiring Manager Interview * Cross\-functional Interviews * Technical Interview Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs. Compensation Range: $0 \- $200K

jobs.title: Design Professional III
jobs.description: **Bring your experience. Find your people. Build what matters.** At Goodwyn Mills Cawood (GMC), we believe great work happens when talented people have the trust, resources, and support to do their best work. As a **Design Professional III,** you’ll bring your experience to meaningful projects that shape the communities we serve. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in conceptual design, planning, programming, and related activities, as well as coordination and communication with clients, consulting engineers, and contractors. Most importantly, **you won’t be expected to do it alone.** You’ll be surrounded by a multidisciplinary team that values collaboration, shares knowledge, and is invested in your success. **What You’ll Do** As a Design Professional III, you’ll serve as a trusted degreed, non\-licensed architecture professional, responsible for performing a variety of assignments requiring advanced skills across all conventional areas of practice with minimal supervision. You’ll: * Utilize an expert understanding of computer\-aided design (CAD) software, including Revit, along with established techniques, standards, and tools to support the preparation of technical drawings. * Transform and develop initial rough preliminary designs into working documents utilizing Revit and or CAD software. * Review drawings and documents for accuracy, consistency, and compliance with project standards. * Coordinate and consult with clients and team members to complete projects on time. Maintains deadlines, goals, and production standards set by the department. * Lead the development of client presentations and visual materials. * Apply standard methods to routine tasks with an advanced understanding of professional judgment and ethical responsibilities. * Conduct code and product research, prepare as\-built drawings, and support permit applications and project documentation. * Prepare meeting agendas, document notes, and respond to contractor RFIs. * Review shop drawings for compliance and conduct site visits to monitor construction progress. * Coordinate and delegate work of team members. **We’ll Support Your Growth** We’re looking for an experienced Design Professional III who is ready to make an impact in GMC in Mobile, AL. It’s about **sharing what you know, learning from others, and helping the entire team succeed.** In this role, you’ll have opportunities to: * Collaborate with design originators to resolve discrepancies between original drawings and final working drawings * Communicate effectively with team members regarding project planning, meetings, schedules, and deadlines. * Collaborate across disciplines and office locations to leverage the firm’s collective expertise. * Prepare to take the exam for architectural licensure or advancing skill and experience without a priority of achieving licensure. * Gain strong understanding of building details and construction document development. **The Kind of** **Team Member We’re Looking For** You’re an experienced Design Professional II who enjoys both the **work and the people behind the work.** **You bring:** * A commitment to quality and thoughtful problem\-solving. * A collaborative mindset and willingness to share your experience with others. * Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills. * A desire to contribute to something bigger than an individual project **What You’ll Need** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture from an accredited architectural program. * 5\-15 years of experience, preferred * Effective communication and teamwork abilities. * Expert knowledge of Revit and CAD software. * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite * Eagerness to learn and develop technical and professional skills * Must be able to perform work\-related travel and have a valid driver’s license * Must be local to GMC office **Where You’ll Work** This is primarily an office\-based role, with opportunities to get out into the field and stay connected to the projects and people you’re serving. **Travel:** Up to 15%, including project site visits, client meetings, professional development, and other project\-related activities. Fieldwork may involve exposure to varying weather conditions, temperatures, construction environments, pollutants, chemicals, insects, and other site conditions. Appropriate protective clothing and equipment will be provided and required as appropriate. The role also includes periods of desk and computer work, as well as occasional bending, twisting, crouching, and other physical movements. Employees may occasionally need to lift up to 25 pounds. **Why GMC?** At GMC, we believe communities are built by people—not companies. We’re one of the Southeast’s largest privately held architecture and engineering firms, but our size isn’t what defines us. **Our people do.** We bring architects, designers, engineers, planners, environmental professionals, surveyors, and disaster recovery experts together to solve complex challenges and create better outcomes for the communities we serve. Our work touches everyday life—from schools, parks, hospitals, and commercial developments to clean water, safe streets, resilient environments, and everything in between. And while the work matters, how we work matters just as much. We’re guided by four values: * **Quality —** We care deeply about the work we put into the world. * **Integrity —** We do the right thing for our clients, colleagues, and communities. * **Creativity —** We believe the best solutions come from curiosity, collaboration, and fresh thinking. * **Care —** We invest in our people, our clients, and the places we’re fortunate to serve. At GMC, your experience has a place, your ideas have a voice, and your leadership can make a difference. Come build something meaningful with us. GMC is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans.

jobs.title: Data Center Plant Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: This role is not eligible for U.S. immigration sponsorship.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 9 years of years of experience in Electrical, Mechanical/HVAC, or controls experience in an industrial/commercial environment. * Ability to lift and move 50 lbs of equipment, and work on platforms, ladders, and under raised floors. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment. * Knowledge of the mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Feeders, Transformers, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems or similar). * Knowledge of the building management controls systems. **About the job** ----------------- The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non\-critical electrical or mechanical system components). As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $138000 \- $200000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Drive efforts to test, validate, improve, and certify new processes and procedures for critical complex equipment operation for data center domain of expertise. * Lead efforts to perform compliance activities for a data center and analyze compliance results for data centers globally. Ensure regional and global teams are complying with project/schedule guidelines and Google design standards. * Drive efforts to monitor data center systems operations, control site activities to minimize risk, and to ensure effective response to any excursions. * Drive efforts to ensure sites are following facility, maintenance, and standard programs globally while exhibiting strength in improvement to said policies and programs. * Lead the development of strategies to keep operational costs to a minimum, improve efficiency, and reduce environmental impact at a site, along with driving site\-level development of programs and initiatives. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Civil Engineer - Entry-level Highway Design
jobs.description: **Launch Your Career in Transportation Engineering** Are you ready to help design the roadways that connect communities, support economic growth, and improve daily travel? Is seeking seeking a motivated **Entry\-Level Highway Engineer** to join our transportation team. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to gain hands\-on experience working on highway, roadway, intersection, and traffic improvement projects while learning from experienced transportation professionals. As an **Entry\-Level Highway Engineer**, you will contribute to the planning, design, and delivery of transportation infrastructure projects that improve safety, mobility, and accessibility for the traveling public. You'll work in a collaborative environment that values professional development, mentorship, and technical excellence, providing a strong foundation for a successful engineering career and future PE licensure. **GPI** is a multi\-discipline engineering firm providing planning, design, and construction services for transportation infrastructure and building system projects throughout the United States for over 50 years. Ranked in the Top 100 Firms by Engineering News Record, GPI is a forward\-thinking, innovative firm with a culture committed to excellence and fosters staff empowerment. For more information, visit: www.gpinet.com **Responsibilities:** * Assist in the design of highways, roadways, intersections, and transportation infrastructure projects. * Prepare engineering calculations, plans, specifications, and technical reports. * Develop geometric roadway designs using industry\-standard engineering software. * Support drainage, stormwater management, erosion and sediment control, and utility coordination efforts. * Assist with traffic analysis and transportation studies. * Perform field visits to collect data, evaluate existing conditions, and support project development. * Coordinate with project managers, senior engineers, surveyors, environmental specialists, and other design disciplines. * Review construction plans and contractor submittals for compliance with project requirements. * Assist with permit applications and regulatory submissions. * Participate in meetings with clients, contractors, and transportation agencies. * Support construction phase services, including responding to requests for information and reviewing field conditions. * Maintain project documentation and follow quality control procedures. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET\-accredited university. * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification or ability to obtain certification within one year preferred. * Internship or co\-op experience in transportation or civil engineering is a plus. * Basic understanding of highway design, transportation engineering, and roadway construction principles. * Familiarity with AutoCAD Civil 3D is a plus. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills. * Ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment. * Willingness to perform occasional field work and site visits. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Coursework in transportation engineering, traffic engineering, highway design, or drainage design. * Familiarity with DOT design standards and specifications. * Experience with traffic analysis or roadway modeling software is a plus. * Desire to pursue Professional Engineer (PE) licensure and long\-term career growth in transportation engineering. * Maintain a valid driver's license with a clean motor vehicle report (MVR) for final consideration * Read, write, and understand plans and directions given in the English language * Basic computer skills with the ability to create and edit Microsoft Word and Excel documents, create Outlook emails and utilize SharePoint and Microsoft Teams to communicate with other team members * Able to traverse a construction job site consisting of uneven ground varying in height and consistency of material, with a variation of elevation 19" or less (mud, gravel, rutted ground, etc.) * Able to wear GPI required PPE, i.e., hard hats, safety vest, work boots, and/or safety glasses/goggles while working * Able to move equipment or inspection specimens weighing up to 50 pounds GPI offers excellent benefits, including a 401(k) plan, ESOP, medical/dental/vision plans, paid time off, and more. GPI is an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. D/V **Notice To Third\-Party Agencies** GPI does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters and/or agencies. Any staffing employment agency, person, or entity that submits an unsolicited resume to this site does so with the understanding that the applicant's resume will become the property of GPI and has the right to hire that applicant at its discretion and without any fee owed to the submitting staffing/employment agency, person, or entity. GPI will not pay a placement fee unless the agency or recruiter has a signed contract with GPI’s Corporate Human Resources department in advance of submitting a candidate for consideration. Staffing/employment agencies must submit applicants to the designated GPI recruiter to be eligible for a placement fee. Verbal and written approvals will not be considered a valid contract for service. **Work Authorization** In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, we will hire only U.S. citizens and aliens lawfully authorized to work in the United States (if the position is or will be one that is subject to U.S. law). Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is typically not available for entry\-level positions. GPI participates in E\-Verify. Know your Right to Work. **Email Communications** Thank you for your interest in Greenman\-Pedersen, Inc. (GPI). By applying, you may receive periodic email notifications about career opportunities. These communications are designed to keep you informed of new and exciting openings across our organization. You can opt out of these notifications at any time.

We have successfully performed engineering work for a complete spectrum of utility infrastructure projects providing solutions and construction support from Coast to Coast in areas ranging from complex urban city centers, to rural greenfields, to limited access rights\-of\-way. In July 2020, HBK Engineering was acquired by Quanta Services. Quanta Services provides infrastructure services for electric power, pipeline, and communications industries and employees over 50,000 people. Quanta’s focus on the utility industry and HBK’s focus on constructability in our designs has made our integration into the Quanta family of companies seamless. This entry\-level position involves providing contract engineering resources to a local electric and gas utility in **Missoula, Montana**. The role supports the company’s expanding efforts to connect new customers to the local utility grid. Additionally, this position provides critical engineering support for existing customers through capacity upgrade projects, system rebuilds, and the relocation of existing utility infrastructure. (Preferred) * 0 to 4 years of experience. jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - Building Design
jobs.description: Assistant Project Manager \- Building Design \- (196307\) At HDR, our employee\-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world? Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our\-story' Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world. We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high\-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next\-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence. HDR is looking for an Assistant Project Manager to join our Building Engineering Services Group in our Charlotte, NC office. The Assistant Project Manager must have experience that focuses on client development and delivery of projects including facilities design for datacenters, office, manufacturing, and tenant upfit for a wide variety of clients. The ideal candidate should have a proven background in successfully supporting the delivery of various projects with scope ranging from upfront planning and pre\-design activities through detail design, construction support and commissioning. This position is an opportunity to join one of the largest, fastest growing, and comprehensive engineering and design practices in the industry. In addition to management and delivery of projects (which is the primary focus of this role), the successful candidate must possess the drive, experience and charisma needed to develop and secure work from a robust global client base and expand upon HDR’s reputation within these markets. This individual will manage multi\-disciplinary design teams from project conception to completion. Keen focus on organizational skills and follow\-through are required to be successful in this role. They will work closely with local Project Managers as well as our global client management team. Some travel to client sites or other HDR offices is required. On a day\-to\-day basis, the Assistant Project Manager will also be expected to: * Coordinate work of single or multidiscipline teams throughout the project's life cycle (from development and initiation to close\-out), while under supervision of a Project Manager. * Be responsible for many aspects of a small project or a single aspect of a larger project. * Coordinate workload through project execution and complete deliverables on budget and schedule. * Work with the Project Manager, Accounting, Operational and Business leadership for periodic project reviews. * Perform other duties as needed. **Preferred Qualifications** * Preference given to local candidates * PMP certification or PE license * Familiarity and/or experience with Revit, AutoCAD, BIM360 Docs, BIM360 Field, AutoDesk Construction Cloud and Bluebeam * MS Office and MS Project experience (Access experience would be plus) * Familiarity with Google communication products (gDrive, Chat, Docs, Sheets, and Slides) * + LI\-SM1 **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in related field * 5 years related experience * Must have the ability to interact with various design teams, have excellent organizational, project management and communication (both written and verbal) skills * An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must **What We Believe** HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve. **Our Commitment** As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day. Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ\+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees. **Primary Location** -------------------- : United States\-North Carolina\-Charlotte**Industry** ------------ : Building Engineering**Schedule** ------------ : Full\-time**Employee Status** ------------------- : Regular BusinessClass: Program Management**Job Posting** --------------- : Sep 23, 2026

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Research Engineer
jobs.description: **About HUD** ============= HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25\. **About the role** ------------------ We’re looking for an Applied Research Engineer to own implementation. Our data buyers and sellers often have time\-sensitive asks such as troubleshooting and running evals or cleaning data at scale. You’ll take the lead on diagnosing ambiguous technical problems and resolving them. jobs.title: Senior FinOps Platform Engineer
jobs.description: We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. **Role Overview** ----------------- The cloud platform underpins how services are built, deployed, and operated across the organization. As adoption scales, **cost visibility, allocation, and optimization must be engineered into the platform**, not managed reactively. As a **Senior Cloud FinOps Platform Engineer**, you will **lead the development and evolution of the cost management capabilities of the cloud platform**—ensuring teams can understand, attribute, and optimize their cloud usage through standardized, automated, and self\-service mechanisms. This role operates at the **platform layer**, embedding FinOps practices into **cloud foundations, guardrails, and automation workflows**, rather than managing costs through manual reporting or one\-off analysis. You will provide technical leadership for cloud optimization initiatives and help establish reusable FinOps patterns and standards across the organization. Success in this role means cost management becomes **predictable, transparent, actionable, and scalable**, with measurable financial outcomes and decreasing operational overhead. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ ### **Build Cost\-Aware Platform Foundations** * **Design and evolve cost allocation standards** (tagging, labeling, account structure) across cloud environments * Embed cost insight into platform provisioning workflows and templates * Ensure cloud resources are created with **consistent, enforceable cost attribution** ### **Expand Cost Visibility \& Tooling** * **Lead the integration and ongoing development of cloud cost platforms and automation such as Flexera, CloudZero, or equivalent aggregation tools, and cost optimization tools like ProsperOps** * Enable **cross\-cloud cost visibility**, unit cost analysis, and business\-level attribution, including a **showback model** * Build and maintain **cost dashboards, alerts, budgets, and reporting pipelines** for engineering and stakeholders * Improve visibility into shared services, platform costs, and unallocated spend * **Evaluate emerging FinOps capabilities and recommend improvements based on measurable platform and business value** ### **Embed FinOps into Platform Automation** * **Define and implement patterns for integrating** cost controls into **Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and CI/CD workflows** * Automate detection of cost anomalies, unused resources, and optimization opportunities * Ensure cost guardrails are enforced through **policy and automation**, not manual review * **Identify recurring manual FinOps activities and drive their replacement with scalable automation** ### **Enable Cost\-Aware Engineering** * Partner with engineering teams to improve **cost transparency and accountability** * Provide guidance on **cost\-efficient usage patterns** aligned with platform standards * **Establish** documentation, examples, and reference patterns for cost\-aware design * **Mentor engineers and help teams incorporate cloud economics into architecture and engineering decisions** ### **Improve Cost Efficiency Over Time** * Identify systemic cost inefficiencies and **lead platform\-level improvements** * **Drive automation and adoption of** rightsizing, reservation strategies, and usage optimization patterns * Work with Finance and platform leadership to align **forecasting, budgeting, and usage trends** * **Measure realized savings and optimization outcomes against forecasts and recommendations** ### **Vendor Optimization \& Commitment Management** * **Lead the technical evaluation** and integration of supplier\-provided recommendations within platform automation and governance workflows * **Evaluate commitment strategies** such as Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and equivalent offerings against usage patterns, forecasts, architecture changes, and business risk * Translate vendor insights into **repeatable, scalable optimization patterns** * Partner with our cloud providers to **identify new optimization opportunities** and validate realized outcomes **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- ### **Experience \& Skills** * **5–8\+ years of experience** in cloud engineering, DevOps, FinOps, platform engineering, or related technical disciplines * Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) * Solid understanding of cloud cost drivers, billing models, usage patterns, and optimization strategies * Experience with **Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation tools** (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, etc.) * Experience evaluating and implementing **cloud commitment models** (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, or equivalents) * Experience working with **cost optimization vendors or managed FinOps platforms** ### **FinOps \& Tooling** * Experience with cloud cost tools such as **Flexera, CloudZero, CloudHealth, ProsperOps,** or native cloud cost platforms * Experience with cost allocation strategies (tagging, chargeback/showback models) * Good understanding of FinOps lifecycle principles (Inform, Optimize, Operate) * **Ability to translate cost and usage data into actionable engineering and platform recommendations** ### **Engineering \& Collaboration** * Strong systems thinking and ability to work at the platform level * Ability to translate technical usage into **financial insight and measurable business outcomes** * Experience working across engineering, Finance, cloud providers, vendors, and platform teams * Ability to lead technical initiatives and influence standards without direct authority * **Experience mentoring engineers** and sharing technical practices across teams * Clear communication and documentation skills In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation range for this role. The range listed is just one component of Wizards of the Coast’s total compensation package for employees. Employees may also be eligible for annual and long\-term incentives. In addition, Wizards of the Coast provides a variety of benefits to employees. Here’s a look at what your benefits package may include: Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance, Paid Vacation Time \& Holidays, Generous 401(k) match, Paid Parental Leave, Volunteer Program, Employee Giving \& Matching Gifts Programs, Tuition Reimbursement, Product Discounts, and more. Wizards is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment. We are committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status. The above is intended to describe the general content of and the requirements for satisfactory performance in this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of the duties, responsibilities, or requirements of the position. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you are selected to move forward in our application process and need to request an accommodation, please let your recruiter or coordinator know. \#Wizards The pay transparency range for this role is listed below. The hiring range will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location and market conditions. Additionally, employees may be eligible for annual and long\-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package. Pay Range $111,200 \- $166,900 USD Employees may be eligible for annual and long\-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package, depending on role, location, and eligibility. jobs.description: At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. Client Experience * Serves as the primary project contact and brand ambassador. * Maintains regular communication with clients to ensure satisfaction with the project process and engineering work product, and that client views are managed toward the best solution. * Resolves project\-related conflict and responds to client requests and questions on assigned projects; may support these activities on other projects as needed. Core Competencies Communication * Keeps others informed conveying information clearly and with an appropriate level of detail * Listens attentively to others and takes an interest in what they have to say * Responds openly to others encouraging honest, productive communication Integrity * Demonstrates consideration for the opinions, perspectives, and experiences others * Takes responsibility for personal actions and delivers on commitments * Aims to understand how actions impact others Quality Orientation * Takes steps to ensure work is done correctly * Delivers on client expectations * Adheres to policies and procedures Teamwork/Inclusion * Shares time and effort with others * Takes interest and learns from the diversity of others * Shows enthusiasm for team goals Continuous Learning * Views mistakes as a growth opportunity * Recognizes gaps in personal knowledge and pursues opportunities to learn * Engages others when tackling an unfamiliar ta eu of requisite education. * 3 years of relevant experience required, including a minimum of 2 years of project management exposure. Minimum 7 years of experience required without degree. * Strong process improvement focus. * Strong understanding of Data Analysis and the role AI plays in data. * Basic proficiency in project management standards and execution required. * Fundamental understanding of building design and construction principles required. * Self\-starter with the ability to influence and motivate others to achieve goals. * Successful track record of effective collaboration, communication and organization skills. * Must demonstrate proficiency in all core competencies as described in this job description. Physical \& Other Requirements * Other duties as assigned. * Prolonged periods of sitting or standing at a desk and working on a computer. * Ability to read, write and communicate in English. * Occasional travel may be required (10\-15%). Let's Talk Perks We take care of our people. As a Henderson employee, you'll enjoy some pretty awesome perks. Trust us, your friends will all have work envy. Culture * Flexible Work Hours (Because we all need to balance work and life.) * Casual Dress Code (Be yourself, please.) * Paid Volunteer Time (We literally pay you to volunteer.) * Paid Parental Leave (Because we know both parents deserve to be there for a new child.) * Health and Wellness Initiatives (Get Fit and Stay Fit.) * Receptive and Forward\-Thinking Leadership (Our doors are always open.) * Clear Career Path Options (We want you to excel.) Benefits * Industry\-leading 401K match and profit sharing (When the company succeeds, we all share in that success.) * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (Yes, our employees are the owners.) * Paid Training for Professional Development (We’ll pay for the time you take getting better at what you do.) * Performance Bonuses (When you do well, we reward you for your work.) * Comprehensive and Extensive Insurance (We’ve got you covered.) * Paid Term Life and Disability (We’ve got your family covered, too.) * Health Savings Account \& Flexible Spending Accounts (We'll help you take advantage of tax savings.) * Paid Time Off and Sick Time off (Take a break. You deserve it!) * Financial Wellness \& Coaching Program (Financial security makes you a happier team member.) More information can be found here \- https://www.hendersonengineers.com/careers/. We extend offers of employment only after a comprehensive interview process and will never ask you for a payment of any sort nor offer one for any reason. We will not request personal information until a legitimate offer of employment has been extended. If you suspect a recruitment attempt is fraudulent, you should cease communications. jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst I
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** HexArmor® is a leader in developing some of the most advanced PPE solutions for your eyes, hands, arms, and body. At HexArmor®, we believe safety is not a luxury – it's a necessity. Since day one, we have worked hand\-in\-hand with our customers to design innovative, high performance PPE that helps ensure workers return home in the same condition they arrived. Our mission is to provide the protection that makes this possible, for every worker, everywhere. **SUMMARY** We are seeking a Software Engineer II with expertise in Rails and React to join our growing Atlanta\-based Software Engineering team. As an established performer, you take on complex tasks with minimal supervision and deliver resilient software that achieves business results while taking ownership of your work and following through on your commitments. **LOCATION** Corporate Headquarters \- 640 Leffingwell Ave. NE Grand Rapids, MI 49505 **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build, design, and evolve reliable, scalable full\-stack services and applications, including API design and data modeling, for clearly scoped product capabilities across both frontend and backend components * Deliver end\-to\-end features across the full software development lifecycle by implementing design, writing high\-quality code, creating and executing tests, and contributing to deployment, monitoring, and ongoing operational support for web\-based experiences * Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, designers, and technical partners to understand requirements, break down work, and implement full\-stack technical solutions for complex tasks and small projects that integrate with multiple services and domains * Improve code quality, reliability, and performance across the stack by following and contributing to best practices in testing, observability, security, accessibility, and operational excellence for the services and user interfaces you work on * Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing for frontend and backend technologies, supporting a culture of learning and continuous improvement while steadily expanding your technical scope and impact * Apply security best practices throughout development, including secure coding, dependency management, and compliance with company policies and regulatory standards. **JOB DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting in Tableau that gives the organization a clear view of performance against plan, and serves as a go\-to resource for ad hoc analysis * Write and optimize SQL against the company data warehouse, and define and document core business metrics so that reporting stays consistent across teams * Conduct exploratory and statistical analysis including trend, variance, segmentation, and cohort analysis, and support monthly and quarterly business reviews with prepared analysis and recommended actions * Develop and maintain demand, revenue, and sales forecasts at the product, customer, channel, and region level * Measure and report forecast accuracy, investigate variance between forecast and actuals, and refine methodology over time to support annual planning, budgeting, and sales and operations planning * Leverage AI tools to accelerate report, dashboard, and model development, including generating and reviewing SQL, prototyping visualizations, and speeding up documentation and validation, and identify further opportunities to reduce manual effort in recurring workflows * Work alongside and assist the data engineering team on data set and pipeline development, helping define data requirements, validate outputs, and QA new data sources * Assist the data engineering team in developing, testing, and evaluating machine learning models that support reporting and forecasting, and partner with them on data quality and governance standards * Evaluate emerging technologies and analytical approaches, and provide thought leadership and perspective for adoption where appropriate **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in a related field such as Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Finance, or Economics * Demonstrated experience in a business intelligence, analytics, or reporting role * Proficiency in SQL, with experience building and maintaining dashboards in Tableau * Experience working in Microsoft Fabric or a comparable cloud data platform, with comfort handling large, imperfect data sets * Experience building or maintaining forecasts in a business setting, with familiarity with time series and regression\-based forecasting methods * Working knowledge of Python or R and a practical understanding of machine learning concepts, sufficient to contribute alongside data engineering * Experience leveraging AI tools to improve analytical workflows and support the development of reports, dashboards, and models, and up to date with best practices in business intelligence, forecasting, and applied AI * Strong analytical skills and data\-driven thinking, with the ability to translate technical results into clear business recommendations for a non\-technical audience * Dependable, hardworking problem solver and team player with excellent verbal and communication skills, a high standard of performance for self, and a willingness to pivot when needed to complete the crucial task for the business **COMPENSATION** * Salary \+ bonus HexArmor is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. At HexArmor, we believe diversity in people and ideas makes us stronger. We are committed to attracting and retaining a diverse employee workforce honoring people's experiences, perspectives, and cultural backgrounds. As one HexArmor community, we strive to create and maintain a working environment that is welcoming, inclusive, and impartial. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. \*\* Employment offers are contingent upon an E\-Verify check and the successful completion of a pre\-employment drug screen and background check \*\*

jobs.title: Cloud Systems Administrator
jobs.description: SCHEDULE: **Full\-time; Exempt.** Typical hours are Monday\-Friday (8:00 am – 5:00 pm) on\-call nights/weekends as needed. LOCATION: Hills Bank Campus BENEFITS: Our employees are our most valuable assets, so we invest in them with a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Our philosophy of taking care of the customer extends to taking care of our employees so that they, in turn, can take good care of themselves and their families. Join Hills Bank and let us surprise you with even more perks! **ACCOUNTABILITIES:** * Cloud Systems Administration + Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft 365 and Azure solutions: In coordination with the IT security office, design secure and scalable architectures for Exchange Online, Teams, Intune, Entra, and Copilot, etc.; configure systems for compliance, data protection and a high level of resiliency. + Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors: Partner with product owners of other systems (cloud or non\-cloud; internal or external) to assure interoperability and resiliency across all platforms and systems. + Maintain regulatory compliance with banking standards (e.g. FFIEC, FDIC, GLBA): Work with risk, audit and compliance teams to assure maintenance of regulatory requirements on IT systems. + Ensure availability and recoverability of cloud systems and applications: Monitor system health and performance using Azure Monitor and other tools; implement robust backup and disaster recovery strategies, including regular testing of recovery procedures. + Lead or support migration projects from on\-premises to cloud environments: Develop migration plans, assess dependencies, and execute phased migrations with minimal business disruption; validate post\-migration performance and security. + Provide Tier 2 support for cloud\-related issues: Troubleshoot complex problems involving identity, networking, and application integration; escalate to vendors when necessary and ensure timely resolution. + Ensure cloud system and application security: Working with the IT security team who are responsible for implementation of security baselines, conditional access policies, and conduct vulnerability assessments; remediate findings promptly and maintain compliance with industry standards. * Service Delivery Fundamentals + Maintain comprehensive documentation: Create and update architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides to support knowledge sharing and continuity. + Work with a high\-performing team, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. + Promote strong cross\-functional collaboration with IT, risk, compliance, legal, facilities, project management, and business units to ensure business needs and continuity are integrated into all aspects of service delivery decision\-making. + Facilitate regular communication and coordination across departments to ensure cohesive execution of business requirements. + Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize performance, reduce costs and/or add business value. + Participation in on\-call, after\-hours support rotation. + After hours/weekend availability for scheduled maintenance activities. * Other duties as assigned **EDUCATION AND SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Associate's degree or four to seven years of Systems Administrator experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience. * 3–5\+ years of experience administering Microsoft 365 and/or Microsoft Azure environments. * Advanced knowledge of Microsoft technologies. * Proven experience designing and executing cloud migration strategies. * Experience with cloud\-based services (Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, AI, public/private cloud). * Strong understanding of identity and access management, conditional access, and security best practices in cloud environments. * Familiarity with PowerShell scripting for automation and administration. * Experience with hybrid environments and Active Directory synchronization (e.g., Entra Sync). * Experience working with incident tracking/ticketing systems. * Excellent troubleshooting, oral, and written communication skills. * Ability to gather, interpret, document, and evaluate system requirements. * Initiative to learn about new technologies, hardware, and software products and how new services would benefit the company. * Valid driver's license. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER/VETERANS/DISABILITY**

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ================== As a Sales Engineer, you will operate as a lighter\-weight forward deployed engineer embedded in our go\-to\-market motion — part builder, part consultant. You will sit at the intersection of sales, product, and AI: writing code to prototype agentic demos, configuring use\-case\-specific agent flows, and then walking into the room to present them to clinical, commercial, and technical stakeholders. jobs.title: Principal Ultrasound Engineer
jobs.description: HistoSonics is a commercial\-stage medtech company advancing the Edison® System, a novel non\-invasive sonic beam therapy based on histotripsy. Since receiving FDA De Novo grant for the non\-invasive destruction of liver tumors in 2023, the company has progressed beyond initial market entry into commercial expansion, reimbursement momentum, and ongoing clinical and pipeline development. In addition to its current liver tumor indication, HistoSonics is pursuing future indications across multiple applications including kidney, pancreas, prostate, neuro, women’s health, and other significant underserved human health areas, to realize the broader potential histotripsy across multiple disease states and medical specialties. We offer an exciting work culture where cutting\-edge science meets real\-world application, and each team member’s contribution is important to our success in ensuring our physicians and their patients get what they need most. **Location**: Ann Arbor, MI; Madison, WI or Plymouth, MN **Position Summary (Why this role matters):** HistoSonics is seeking a Principal Ultrasound Engineer to own diagnostic ultrasound image quality across our histotripsy platforms. You will work across two programs in parallel: a next\-generation platform in active R\&D, where you will develop B\-mode image optimization algorithms and drive advanced imaging modes including color and power Doppler; and the Abdominal Edison System, where you will serve as an imaging subject matter expert improving image quality during histotripsy treatment alongside our ultrasound imaging partner. This is a hands\-on role. You will prototype, implement, and quantitatively validate imaging algorithms, and set technical direction for external ultrasound partners. Success is measured by demonstrable improvement in the clarity, consistency, and clinical utility of the images physicians rely on to target, guide, and monitor therapy. The role reports to the Associate VP of Research and Advanced Development and is expected to operate with a high degree of independence. **Key Responsibilities (What you’ll do):** * Design, prototype, and validate B\-mode image optimization algorithms — speckle reduction, edge detection and enhancement, adaptive filtering, compounding, and dynamic range and gain management. * Own the definition, specification, and acceptance of advanced imaging modes, including color and power Doppler — implementing directly where appropriate, and otherwise driving delivery through a beamformer OEM partner and independently verifying performance against acceptance criteria. * Serve as the imaging subject matter expert during histotripsy treatment, tuning imaging performance for targeting, real\-time visualization, treatment monitoring, and post\-treatment assessment. * Establish objective image quality methodology — contrast, contrast\-to\-noise ratio, resolution, penetration, SNR, frame rate, and Doppler sensitivity — using phantoms, tissue models, and clinical data, and convert it into acceptance criteria that carry through design verification. * Set technical direction for external ultrasound OEM and imaging partners, including transducer, beamforming, and front\-end system requirements; review implementations, independently evaluate delivered image quality, and drive partner work to program objectives. * Investigate and resolve imaging artifacts and degradation arising from concurrent therapy delivery, including therapy/imaging synchronization and cavitation\-induced clutter. * Own imaging\-related design control deliverables and support regulatory strategy, including requirements, risk and hazard analysis, verification protocols and reports, bench test protocols, and alignment with applicable IEC 60601\-2\-37 and FDA guidance. * Provide hands\-on imaging support during laboratory, preclinical, and clinical activities, and build imaging literacy across product, clinical, and regulatory teams. * Define the technical architecture and multi\-year imaging roadmap across platforms. **Qualifications and Skills:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred. * 10\+ years in diagnostic ultrasound engineering, with a record of acting as a recognized technical authority for imaging on a commercialized product. At least 4 years must be post\-degree industry experience. * Hands\-on experience developing and validating ultrasound image processing algorithms, supported by quantitative image quality assessment. * Working knowledge of the full ultrasound signal chain, from transmit sequencing and beamforming through demodulation, detection, scan conversion, and display. * Strong programming ability for algorithm prototyping, with experience taking implementations to production quality. * Direct experience with RF and IQ ultrasound data, phantoms, and image quality test methods. * Demonstrated ability to set technical direction for and manage the deliverables of external OEM or development partners. * Medical device product development experience under design controls (ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820\), including driving features through verification and validation in support of regulatory submissions. * Ability to work with minimal day\-to\-day direction, structuring your own work across two concurrent programs and surfacing decisions and risks early. * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to represent HistoSonics credibly with partner engineering teams and with clinicians. **Preferred Qualifications and Skills:** * Direct experience implementing color and/or power Doppler, including wall filter design, clutter rejection, and flow estimation. * Experience with specialized or non\-conventional ultrasound imaging form factors. * Experience integrating OEM ultrasound platforms, including SDK and API\-level customization and scan sequence programming. * Experience with therapeutic ultrasound systems (histotripsy, HIFU, or lithotripsy) and with imaging in the presence of acoustic cavitation. * GPU programming experience for real\-time imaging pipelines. * Machine learning applied to ultrasound image enhancement or segmentation, and experience with DICOM. * Experience with regulatory submissions for ultrasound\-guided or ultrasound\-integrated medical devices under FDA 510(k) or De Novo pathways. * Advanced degree (MS or Ph.D.) with a focus on ultrasound imaging, acoustics, or signal/image processing. **Travel Requirements:** Approximately 15% travel, varying with program phase: monthly visits of 1–3 days to preclinical laboratory facilities, roughly one week per year on site with partners, and one to two clinical site visits per year, domestic or international. **Benefits**: We offer a comprehensive benefits package for full\-time employees. This includes health, dental, and vision insurance, life, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, 401(k), paid time off, and more. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **U.S. Work Authorization \& Sponsorship:** Employer will not sponsor visas for position. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Materials Manager
jobs.description: **Location:** Michigan City, Indiana, United States **Job ID:** R0146062 **Date Posted:** Sep 23, 2026 **Company Name:** HITACHI GLOBAL AIR POWER US, LLC **Profession (Job Category):** Production \& Skilled Trades **Job Type (Experience Level):** Management **Job Schedule:** Full time **Remote:** No **Job Description:** **The Company** We build the machines that power industry. We are Hitachi Global Air Power, a leading global industrial compressed air manufacturer driving the innovations that keep the world moving. From our headquarters in Michigan City, Indiana, our compressed air solutions power manufacturing operations all around the globe; from food and beverage to life\-saving pharmaceuticals and cutting\-edge semiconductor chips. Our portable compressors provide the air power to build roads and bridges, lay pipelines and aid in oil and gas mining and production. We are a team of innovators, engineers, and quality experts with a shared vision to create the next generation of efficient, environment\-forward compressed air solutions that meet the demands of today, while boldly contributing to a sustainable, circular economy. With more than 60 years of legacy and trusted performance through our brands \- Hitachi, Sullair, and Champion (Australia), we are proud of our reputation for reliability, durability, and performance and groundbreaking engineering. Join us in building a future where your work has an impact. At Hitachi Global Air Power, you’ll be part of a global network that’s shaping the future of industrial power. **Summary of the position:** The Materials Manager oversees material\-related operations to ensure that all incoming and outgoing inventory is processed for Hitachi Global Air Power US, LLC (HGAP). Responsible for material storage and movement within several manufacturing and storage facilities to ensure manufacturing lines receive the correct material when needed. This position is located at the Hitachi Global Air Power manufacturing plant in Michigan City, Indiana, and reports to the Vice President of Operations. **Key Accountabilities:** * Ensure all Inventories are aligned with Sales Product Strategy and Production needs meeting Customer On\-Time delivery expectations. * Improve warehouse layout to drive sustainable inventory and production plans that meet the business financial targets and meet or exceed our customer and shareholder expectations. **Duties and responsibilities:** * Manage material inventory control, shipping and receiving, handling, and storage throughout manufacturing and storage facilities in support of production to ensure delivery demands and schedules are met. * Identify opportunities to reduce transportation, storage, and handling costs. * Strategize about inventory volumes and storage capacity to maximize productivity, rearranging containers for improved efficiency while allowing material handlers to easily navigate between aisles. * Support transformation efforts to digitally transform material handling systems such as automated guided vehicle systems (AGVs), autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), and collaborative robotic arms (cobots) for palletizing. * Maintain balanced workloads by shifting assignments, workers and other resources under own control to achieve the most effective material handling and material processing operations. * Explain work requirements, methods, and procedures; instruct workers in new procedures; and provide advice when problems arise. * Adjust plans, assignments, and methods as necessary to accomplish the work effectively and economically. * Coordinate activities with manufacturing, purchasing, engineering, planning, and quality departments to resolve material shortages. * Provide weekly schedules for direct reports, including starting/ending times, as well as overtime hours. * Monitor overtime hours to stay within budget while maintaining adequate coverage to support operations. * Hold direct reports accountable to uphold Sullair values and policies; issue discipline as required in conjunction with the Human Resource Department. * Review and execute corrective actions for Near Miss and Recordable safety incidents. Oversee proactive audits for discoveries of potential safety\-related issues. **Qualifications:** **Education**: * Bachelor’s degree in Inventory Management, Supply Chain Management, or Logistics * Graduate degree in a logistics\- or business\-related field a plus * Material Management certification, such as CPIM, CSCP, CLTD, and CLT, a plus **Professional experience:** * Five plus years of experience in material management, including inventory management systems. * Ability to establish self as credible leader and partner with site leadership as a trusted member of staff. * Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn. * Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively. * Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed. * Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision\-maker, collaborative. * Problem solver: analytical\-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker. * Working knowledge of Inventory Control Software, SAP, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access). **Key behaviors:** * Lifting up to 35 lbs, lifting over 35 lbs. requires a lifting device, crane, or assistance from another associate * Standing and walking minimum of 8 hours, must be able to bend/stoop, squat/crouch, kneel and twist * Must understand and comply with Sullair Safety Standards **Physical requirements:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk, talk, and/or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, sit, and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. **Direct reports:** * Material Handler Supervisors * Shipping / Receiving Supervisor The successful candidate is responsible for complying with Hitachi Global Air Power US Code of Ethics and related policies. In performing the job, the incumbent shall take all steps necessary to comply with our safety rules and requirements and must actively support the organization's efforts to meet and exceed its goals of creating and maintaining a safe workplace. This description is to serve as a guide. It is intended to be flexible and will continue to evolve over time with business needs and demands and may be updated periodically and at the Company's discretion. jobs.description: **Function** Cloud \& Data Engineering **Our Company** =============== We’re Hitachi Digital Services, a global digital solutions and transformation business with a bold vision of our world’s potential. We’re people\-centric and here to power good. Every day, we future\-proof urban spaces, conserve natural resources, protect rainforests, and save lives. This is a world where innovation, technology, and deep expertise come together to take our company and customers from what’s now to what’s next. We make it happen through the power of acceleration. Contribute to the development of reusable frameworks, security standards, reference architectures, and best practices that drive measurable security outcomes. * ### **What You'll Be Doing:** * Lead customer security engagements and manage teams of Forward Deployed Security Engineers, providing technical leadership and oversight throughout the delivery lifecycle. * Drive security architecture design, threat modeling, risk assessments, and implementation roadmaps across cloud platforms, applications, APIs, DevSecOps pipelines, and AI systems. * Define and implement enterprise security controls, including workload protection, identity security, software supply chain safeguards, CI/CD security gates, and automated remediation workflows. * Guide AI security initiatives by designing secure LLM, RAG, vector database, agent\-based, and MLOps architectures while addressing threats such as prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool execution, and excessive permissions. Manage project risks, dependencies, escalations, and operational handovers while ensuring successful delivery against customer security, compliance, and business objectives. * ### **What You Bring to the Team:** * 7\+ years of cybersecurity experience with proven success leading engineering teams, mentoring security professionals, and delivering large\-scale security programs across multiple workstreams. * Deep expertise in cloud security, application security, DevSecOps, identity and access management, container security, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, and software supply chain security. * Strong knowledge of AI and machine learning security, including LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, AI agents, model deployment, model lifecycle management, and MLOps practices. * Exceptional customer\-facing communication skills with experience conducting technical discovery sessions, presenting to executive stakeholders, and articulating security risks, trade\-offs, and recommendations. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced security or cloud certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer are highly preferred. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). * Industry certifications such as **CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISM, or GIAC certifications** . * Experience delivering customer\-facing security consulting or professional services engagements. * Experience building reusable security frameworks, reference architectures, playbooks, and operational standards. \#LI\-RS2 **About us** ============ We’re a global, team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can bring a better tomorrow closer to today, this is the place for you. **Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives** ===================================================== Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth. We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work. **How we look after you** ========================= We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We’re also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We’re always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you’ll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with. jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: As a Software Engineer I here at Honeywell, you will develop and maintain software solutions, working on cutting\-edge projects that transform businesses. jobs.title: Quality Engineer (Entry level, Bilingual Mandarin)
jobs.description: Job Summary The Quality Engineer (QE) supports the development, implementation, and maintenance of quality standards for the manufacturing process. This role focuses on monitoring production quality, improving yield, reducing scrap, and ensuring that manufacturing processes operate within defined control limits. The QE analyzes production and quality data, supports Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for process deviations, and participates in Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities. This position works closely with Production, Engineering, and Quality teams to improve product quality and process reliability. Duties / Responsibilities * **Process Control \& SPC:** Support and maintain Statistical Process Control (SPC) programs. Analyze trends such as Cp/Cpk and assist in identifying process shifts and potential quality issues. * **Risk Management:** Participate in Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) activities and support implementation of risk mitigation actions. * **Quality Documentation:** Create and update Quality Control Plans, Inspection Standards, and Work Instructions (WIs). * **Root Cause Analysis \& CAPA:** Participate in problem\-solving activities using tools such as 8D, 5\-Why, and Fishbone Analysis for internal non\-conformances and customer\-related quality issues. Support CAPA activities and follow\-up actions. * **Yield Improvement:** Monitor and report daily/weekly production yield, identify major loss contributors, and work with cross\-functional teams on defect reduction and process improvement activities. * **NPI Support:** Support New Product Introduction (NPI), including quality validation of new equipment, materials, and manufacturing processes. * **Audit Support:** Support internal process audits and participate in external/customer audits, including ISO 9001, UL, IEC, CSA, and TUV. * **Change Management:** Review Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) with the Quality and Engineering teams to understand potential impacts on product quality and process stability. * Perform other quality\-related duties as assigned by the manager. Required Skills / Abilities * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel; exposure to statistical software such as Minitab or JMP is a plus. * Basic understanding of statistical analysis, quality tools, and manufacturing processes. * Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, SPC, or other continuous improvement methodologies is preferred. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills. * Ability to prioritize tasks and communicate quality concerns appropriately. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability and willingness to learn solar module manufacturing processes and quality standards. Education and Experience * **Required:** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Materials Science, or a related engineering discipline). * Bingual in Mandarin would be strongly preferred for team colleboration * **Experience:** Entry\-level candidates and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Previous full\-time work experience is not required. * Internship, co\-op, academic project, or other exposure to manufacturing, quality, or engineering environments is preferred. * Familiarity with ISO 9001, Six Sigma, SPC, or quality engineering tools is a plus. * Previous exposure to Solar/PV manufacturing is a plus but not required. Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $63,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Can you speak Mandarin? Work Location: In person
