jobs.title: Senior Data Application Engineer – Enterprise Data Management
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Application Engineer, to join our Enterprise Data Management team. This is a role at the intersection of product strategy, data observability and AI enablement. You will define the product vision and architecture for NVIDIA's data integrity and observability capabilities. You will develop reusable frameworks deployable across business functions. You will also partner with senior EDM architects and business collaborators to scale trusted data across the enterprise. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Product Roadmap \- Drive the end\-to\-end product vision for data observability — defining what gets built, in what order, and why. Engage directly with business partners to surface areas of highest impact, translate difficulties into a prioritized roadmap, and maintain alignment with business from inception through execution. * Architecture and Framework \- Design the architecture for EDM data observability platform with reusability as a first principle. Identify common data quality and integrity challenges across supply chain processes and build modular, configurable solutions that eliminate one\-off implementations and accelerate onboarding of new business domains. * Agentic Frameworks \- Design and deliver AI\-powered observability capabilities by building and operationalizing enterprise\-grade agentic frameworks — encompassing orchestration layers, tool\-use patterns, and feedback loops — that enable self\-healing data pipelines, automated anomaly detection and triage, and proactive surfacing of data integrity issues before they impact operations. * Delivery \- Take full ownership from requirements through deployment — defining what gets monitored, how alerts are ranked by business impact, and how blocking issues are tracked and resolved. Drive accountability across engineering, data, and business teams to ensure data observability solutions are delivered on time and adopted at scale. * Supply Chain Experience \- Ground every observability decision in a deep understanding of Hitech supply chain business processes —planning, procurement, manufacturing, operations, finance, sales — to ensure solutions address root causes, not symptoms. Build the data specifications, business glossaries, governance rules, and lineage maps that make observability meaningful and enterprise AI data agents trustworthy in production. * Design and build foundational data infrastructure powering EDM’s data observability ecosystem. Large language model inferencing is the core engine for all observability and agentic capabilities. Design the inferencing stack — including model selection, prompt engineering standards, context window management, and output validation pipelines — ensuring LLMs are deployed in a way that is accurate, governed, and fit for enterprise use cases. * Data Governance Foundation – Partner with EDM architects and business to define the enterprise data governance artifacts that ensure both observability and AI reliability — including data assets, business glossaries, data quality rules, ownership, and process flows. Drive adoption of data ownership models that assign clear accountability for data quality at the domain level, so that issues surfaced by observability frameworks have a clear owner and resolution path. * AI\-Led SDLC. Champion AI\-assisted software development methodologies to drive high\-quality, fast\-paced delivery across the observability product portfolio **What We Need to See:** * 10\+ years of experience in Data \& product management, with a track record of deploying enterprise\-grade AI or data solutions at scale in a complex enterprise environment. * Experience building and owning knowledge frameworks for AI agent deployment, including data specifications, business glossaries, governance policies, lineage and process flows. * Working knowledge of enterprise data platforms: Databricks (Delta Lake, PySpark), Palantir, Informatica and ETL/ELT tools \& pipeline patterns. * Familiarity with agentic AI workflows (LLM\-based agents, RAG, orchestration frameworks) and experience deploying them in production for data quality, self\-healing, or observability use cases. * Strong foundation in master data management , data quality and governance with experience integrating data platforms with ERP solutions, data lakes, enterprise applications and document repositories * Demonstrated ability to build senior stakeholder relationships across business, IT, and operations, including presenting complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * Working knowledge of supply chain and manufacturing data domains: Material Master, BOM, Supplier Data, Reference Data, and how they flow across planning and execution systems. * Experience in deploying software using CI/CD tools such as Jira, Jenkins, Git etc. * Full stack experience preferred with strong knowledge of sql, python, pyspark and working knowledge of React, Angular, NodeJs. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or equivalent experience in enterprise data architecture and product management. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative, results\-oriented and enjoy having fun, then what are you waiting for? Apply today! Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD \- 264,500 USD for Level 4, and 196,000 USD \- 310,500 USD for Level 5\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 27, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Enginner
jobs.description: **Senior Full Stack Engineer** Delivering growth for marketers is what NaviStone is all about. For B2C brands in considered\-purchase verticals, we deliver proven, time\-tested results. The NaviStone platform empowers marketers by finding, activating, and converting lucrative audiences, with incredible impact! **The Role** As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will collaborate with an innovative and forward\-thinking team, use your deep expertise in TypeScript, React, and Node.js to directly contribute to the release of quality engineering solutions, and support the future of the software and company. **What You'll Do** * You will lead and participate in the design and implementation of major software components, systems, and features with high\-availability and high\-reliability in mind. * You will actively seek out opportunities to teach, mentor, and/or sponsor fellow team members. Serve as a role model for other engineers through thorough code and architecture reviews and modeling best practices within your team. * You collaborate with engineers across teams to ensure alignment and knowledge sharing. * You will partner with engineering managers to guide the approach and execution of technical solutions. * You will own the architecture of the systems you build, including how your code is designed, deployed, and operated in AWS. * You will need to apply your deep understanding of the software engineering discipline, industry best practices, and creativity toward the design, implementation, and support of software products. * You should lead by example, driving decisions, influencing others, and showcasing strong technical \& problem\-solving skills. **What You Will Need to Succeed** * You have at least 8 years of experience building web applications using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. * You have a degree in Computer Science and/or relevant experience in software development. * You are comfortable owning the architecture your code is deployed to, with familiarity working in AWS. * You have experience working with both relational databases (Postgres) and non\-relational databases. * Experience with Snowflake is a plus but not required. * Experience building asynchronous APIs and event\-driven backends is a plus. * You will use leadership skills to effectively direct engineering teams, guide managers, and support executives. * You understand and champion techniques for improving engineering productivity. * You foster positive work relationships and reinforce a strong team culture. **Location**: Cincinnati, OH in Over\-the\-Rhine; Hybrid role, in office 2 days per week **Develop your best you, and reinvigorate for what’s next** NaviStone’s benefits, programs, and perks are purpose\-built to help you grow stronger professionally, and personally. We offer generous medical, dental, vision, and retirement benefits for you and your family. We never stop growing, and we never stop learning. Want to explore AI? Develop new coding skills? Become a better presenter? Grow your leadership skills? Learn advanced yoga? We offer countless professional and personal development opportunities to fuel your ambitions. We’re a Rocketship, but even Rocketships need rest! We work hard, and we go fast. But we also recharge! With unlimited vacation, a generous number of paid holidays, and fun employee events throughout the year, you can refuel and reinvigorate for the incredible journey ahead!

jobs.title: Director, Customer Success
jobs.description: Imagine having the power to stress\-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara. We use advanced machine learning to create engineering\-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure. By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network\-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future. Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe. **Director, Customer Success** Neara is hiring a Director, Customer Success to oversee a strategic portfolio of electric utilities across the United States. Reporting directly to the VP of Customer Success, you will manage a team of 4\-5 Customer Value Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers, driving multi\-year enterprise software engagements from initial pilot phase through full\-scale deployment and long\-term value realization. In this role, you will act as a trusted operational and strategic advisor to utility executives. You will guide them through complex software deployments and help embed Neara’s core solutions, including Wildfire Mitigation, Resiliency \& Reliability, Asset Management, Risk \& Value Optimization, and Design \& Construction, into their daily operational workflows. You will balance hands\-on program management, technical team leadership, and executive stakeholder navigation to ensure our platform delivers measurable business outcomes across the entire customer lifecycle. **What You Will Do:** * Own end\-to\-end program delivery and long\-term account success across a portfolio of enterprise electric utility customers, serving as the executive escalation point and trusted advisor. * Lead, coach, and support a high\-performing team of 4\-5 direct reports (Customer Value Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers), driving delivery excellence, professional development, and resource allocation across your accounts. * Partner with utility leaders to define ROI frameworks, map new digital twin workflows to their existing processes, and ensure widespread software adoption across complex customer organizations. * Oversee the execution of complex technical workstreams, including data integration, custom scripting, and platform configuration, ensuring projects remain on schedule, within scope, and aligned with client strategic goals. * Work closely with Neara’s Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to feed customer insights back into our product roadmap, mitigate implementation risks, and identify commercial expansion opportunities. * Establish effective project governance frameworks and maintain structured communication cadences with utility executives, project sponsors, and steering committees. **Who You Are:** * Proven experience as a consulting leader (Manager, Director, or equivalent) within a global management or technology firm, or equivalent leadership experience in technical customer success, professional services, or complex project delivery. * Track record of successfully leading multi\-year, large\-scale enterprise software deployments and complex digital transformation initiatives. * A background in Engineering, Computer Science, or a quantitative field. Practical familiarity with tools like Python or SQL is a strong plus, enabling you to effectively guide technical teams and work with complex software. * Prior experience working directly with electric utilities, energy companies, or large\-scale physical infrastructure assets is ideal. * Demonstrated ability to manage, mentor, and elevate technical individual contributors (engineers, solutions architects, consultants) in customer\-facing environments. * Exceptional communication skills with a track record of building consensus, navigating internal teams, and managing relationships across complex utility organizational structures. **What We Offer:** * Play a pivotal role in protecting critical infrastructure and preventing catastrophic events, applying cutting\-edge digital twin technology to solve real\-world wildfire, storm, and resiliency challenges across the US power grid. * Take ownership of a critical, senior leadership position within Neara’s US organization, reporting directly to executive leadership while directly shaping our customer playbook. * Work with massive, engineering\-grade physics and AI models that simulate millions of miles of infrastructure, solving complex software adoption and operational challenges that few companies are capable of addressing. * Lead an elite team of technical contributors in a fast\-paced environment that balances the autonomy to drive key accounts with direct access to company leadership, product builders, and domain experts. \#LI\-BH1 Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

We build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes. Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading\-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world\-class financial services company competes in the AI era \- all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last. **Business Overview** New York Life is advancing an AI\-led transformation of Portfolio Management across OCIO and NYLIM, with the ambition of using the same trusted investment intelligence that supports internal decision\-making to improve how investment capabilities, insights, and outcomes are communicated to clients and distribution partners. The Client \& Distribution domain encompasses client reporting, institutional distribution workflows, RFP and DDQ responses, investment content, client intelligence, and related experiences. The opportunity is to move from fragmented, manually assembled processes that can take days or weeks toward continuously available, governed, personalized, and intelligence\-enabled capabilities. **Role Overview** The Corporate Vice President, Client \& Distribution Technology provides senior end\-to\-end technology leadership for Client Reporting \& Distribution within New York Life's AI\-led Portfolio Management transformation. The leader owns the technology strategy and roadmap spanning client reporting, RFP/DDQ workflows, investment content, distribution enablement, client intelligence, applications, data, analytics, AI, agentic capabilities, engineering, controls, and production readiness. The role is expected to reimagine how investment information is transformed into timely, accurate, tailored, and compliant client and distribution experiences. It requires strong judgment about authoritative content, personalization, provenance, approvals, entitlements, and how generative AI can accelerate content and response workflows without compromising accuracy or regulatory obligations. The leader will operate across NYLIM, OCIO, Distribution, Client Service, Marketing where relevant, Technology, Data \& Analytics, Architecture, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and strategic partners to build scalable enterprise capabilities rather than isolated automation solutions. **What You'll Do** **Client \& Distribution Technology Leadership** * Own the end\-to\-end technology strategy and roadmap for client reporting, institutional distribution, RFP/DDQ workflows, investment content, and related client\-service capabilities. * Reimagine manual and fragmented reporting and response workflows into continuously available, governed, reusable, and personalized capabilities. * Enable investment teams and distribution professionals to access trusted portfolio, performance, strategy, and market information with appropriate context and controls. * Create scalable capabilities that can support multiple products, client segments, and distribution channels without proliferating bespoke solutions. * Establish measurable outcomes tied to response time, content reuse, client\-service productivity, accuracy, adoption, and business value. **AI, Content \& Agentic Workflows** * Define responsible use of generative AI and agents for drafting, assembling, validating, personalizing, and maintaining client and distribution content. * Enable agentic workflows for RFP/DDQ responses, client reporting preparation, investment\-content retrieval, and contextual question answering using governed information. * Ensure generated content is grounded in authoritative sources, traceable, reviewable, and subject to appropriate human approval. * Determine where deterministic data and templates are required versus where generative capabilities add value. * Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and AI governance functions to embed appropriate controls from inception. **Technology, Architecture \& Data** * Partner with Solution Engineering \& Architecture to define scalable experience, content, workflow, API, integration, and agent patterns. * Partner with the cross\-bet Data Architect on authoritative investment and client data, semantic consistency, lineage, provenance, entitlements, and access patterns. * Integrate portfolio, performance, product, mar ching, and accountability, while fostering an inclusive, high\-performing team environment. Preferred Experience * Experience with asset management distribution, institutional client service, client reporting, RFP/DDQ processes, or investment\-content technology. * Experience with CRM, content\-management, reporting, document\-generation, workflow, or client\-experience platforms. * Experience applying generative AI to content, reporting, knowledge retrieval, or client\-service workflows in a controlled environment. * Experience within asset management, insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry with significant client communication requirements. **Why This Role** This MG3 role carries end\-to\-end accountability for an enduring technology domain within one of New York Life's strategic transformations. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program. **Company Overview** At New York Life, our 180\-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology\-, data\-, and AI\-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact. Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem\-solving, and purpose\-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long\-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress. As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it. **Our Benefits** We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site. **Our Commitment to Inclusion** At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. By embracing a broad range of perspectives and experiences, we achieve greater success and fulfill our promise of providing financial security and peace of mind to families across all communities. jobs.description: **Job ID:** 18336 **Position Title:** Senior Cyber Security Engineer, IAM Cloud / AI Identity **Location:** Atlanta, GA / Remote **Reports To:** Senior manager, IAM **Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® \- and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. lead adoption decisions, build the business case for investment, and drive implementation across impacted teams where adoption strengthens Newell's security posture * Develop and present reporting and metrics on non\-human identity coverage, risk and remediation to security leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders; may lead significant portions of complex cross\-functional initiatives and serve as a subject matter authority for non\-human identity across the security organization **Required Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience in identity and access management, cloud security or infrastructure security engineering * Hands\-on experience managing service accounts, workload identities or machine\-to\-machine authentication in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure or GCP) * Deep knowledge in AI agent architectures and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including how agents authenticate and interact with tools and data, with demonstrated ability to translate that knowledge into governance policy and engineering standards * Experience with identity governance concepts \- access certification, entitlement review, ownership assignment applied to non\-human identities * Knowledge and experience with modern authentication standards (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SPIFFE/SPIRE, mTLS) as they apply to machine and workload identity, with experience applying these standards to define enterprise\-level policies * Strong scripting or automation skills (Python, PowerShell or Terraform) to build discovery and governance tooling at scale * Ability to operate independently in ambiguity and define structure where none exists \- this space is rapidly evolving, standards are still forming, and the role requires establishing program frameworks, influencing organizational direction and driving adoption across functions **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with cloud security posture management (CSPM) or cloud infrastructure entitlement management (CIEM) tools * Familiarity with secrets management platforms (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault) * Exposure to AI/ML platform engineering or LLM application architecture * Relevant certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP security specialty, CISSP, or equivalent) The Remote base pay range for this position is from $136,000 to $187,000\. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nexus** --------------- You don't have an AI story if you don't have your data story. That's where NexusOne comes in. We're the converged data platform for the AI era — composable by design, built on an open\-source foundation, and AI\-native from the ground up. One identity, one governance envelope, one operational layer across every mainframe, data lake, warehouse, and streaming system in the business. For the first time, enterprises can bring their existing stack along instead of rebuilding it — and still give AI agents full context across the estate. What we stand for is simple: sovereign data, interoperable systems, decoupled intelligence — delivered the way modern software should be. No rip\-and\-replace. No multi\-year transformation. Our CEO Anu Jain puts it well: we turn the "ball of yarn" of data integrations into a unified engine — less like assembling car parts, more like buying the car ready to drive. 85\+ open\-source tools pre\-integrated. AI\-native automations that deploy and self\-heal the stack without human toil. Forward\-deployed engineers who build shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customer teams — hands on keyboards, not just on decks. It's working, and fast. We're tripling revenue year over year, backed by Insight Partners, and running in production in environments most vendors won't touch. Our platform processes credit risk data for 90%\+ of US small businesses — 40M\+ — every month. Intent signals for 300M\+ subscribers monthly for Africa's largest telco. The data and AI layer for a Top 3 US bank. We're 100\+ people across the US and India, headquartered in Atlanta. We think big, move fast, and don't mistake activity for progress. We hire people who'd rather ship the rocket than brief someone on it. Check out this podcast of Anu talking about our solution here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=g8g50sv5GhQ **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to embed with strategic enterprise customers after the sale and turn ambitious platform commitments into production outcomes. This is a hands\-on engineering role—not a traditional consulting, project management, or customer success position. You will work directly inside complex customer environments to understand business and technical goals, design the right solution, write production\-quality code, deploy and integrate NexusOne, and help customer teams operate it successfully. You will move between a customer's architecture room, a codebase, a Kubernetes cluster, and an executive status discussion without losing the thread. Our customers often operate large, regulated data estates with strict requirements around security, governance, resilience, performance, and data sovereignty. Their environments may span legacy platforms, cloud data systems, mainframes, warehouses, lakehouses, and AI applications. The work is rarely turnkey. You will own hard implementation problems through resolution while turning what we learn in the field into reusable product capabilities, automation, and delivery playbooks. You will partner closely with Forward Deployed Engagement Managers, Solutions Architects, Product Engineering, Customer Reliability Engineering, and customer technical teams. The engagement manager owns the delivery program; you own the engineering build. **What You Will Do** -------------------- ### **Deliver Enterprise Solutions** * Embed with strategic customers from post\-sale discovery through production rollout, stabilization, and knowledge transfer * Translate business outcomes and ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical designs, milestones, and working software * Design, build, test, and deploy customer\-specific integrations, data pipelines, platform extensions, migration utilities, and AI\-enabled workflows * Integrate NexusOne with existing enterprise systems across identity, security, governance, data catalog, storage, compute, orchestration, observability, and CI/CD * Support migrations and modernization across on\-premises, private\-cloud, public\-cloud, and hybrid environments * Establish production\-readiness criteria covering performance, reliability, security, disaster recovery, monitoring, and operational ownership ### **Engineer in the Customer Environment** * Write production\-quality code in languages such as Python, Java, Scala, or Go * Deploy and troubleshoot distributed systems on Kubernetes using infrastructure\-as\-code and modern delivery practices * Diagnose issues across application code, data pipelines, networking, IAM/RBAC, certificates, storage, compute, and customer infrastructure * Lead technical workstreams during high\-severity deployment issues, communicate hypotheses clearly, and drive fact\-based root\-cause resolution * Produce high\-quality technical artifacts: architecture diagrams, design documents, implementation plans, runbooks, test plans, decision logs, and post\-incident reviews * Work effectively within enterprise controls such ering, resident engineering, or forward\-deployed role—or equivalent experience working directly with enterprise users * Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals, with production proficiency in at least one backend language such as Python, Java, Scala, or Go * Experience with modern data infrastructure and distributed systems, such as Spark, Trino/Presto, Iceberg, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, data lakes, or cloud data platforms * Strong Kubernetes and container experience, including deployment, troubleshooting, configuration, networking, observability, and operational readiness * Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and infrastructure\-as\-code practices such as Terraform * Ability to troubleshoot across system boundaries and stay accountable until the underlying problem is understood and resolved * Experience navigating large\-enterprise constraints such as security reviews, IAM/RBAC, private networking, compliance controls, change management, and multiple stakeholder groups * Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain complex technical decisions precisely to both engineering and executive audiences * High agency, sound judgment, low ego, and comfort operating in ambiguous environments where the playbook is still being built * Willingness to travel to customer sites as engagements require ### **Strong Differentiators** * Deep experience with one or more of Kubernetes, Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Airflow, Ranger, Keycloak, DataHub, Terraform, dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, or adjacent technologies * Experience deploying data platforms in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, telecommunications, or the public sector * Experience with on\-premises or hybrid\-cloud deployments, including restricted\-network or data\-sovereignty requirements * Track record of modernizing Hadoop, Cloudera, MapR, legacy ETL, or complex enterprise data estates * Experience building production AI or agentic applications on governed enterprise data * Demonstrated success turning bespoke customer work into reusable software, automation, reference architectures, or product features * Experience with performance engineering, high availability, disaster recovery, security hardening, or production incident response * Prior experience in a startup or growth\-stage environment where you helped create the operating model rather than inherit it **What This Role Is Not** ------------------------- * **Not a project manager role.** You will plan and communicate your work, but the core expectation is to engineer and ship the solution. * **Not pre\-sales solution engineering.** You may support continuity from a proof of value, but your center of gravity is post\-sale delivery and production adoption. * **Not reactive support.** You will troubleshoot hard issues, but you are accountable for building durable solutions and creating a clean production handoff. * **Not bespoke consulting forever.** Customer\-specific work is necessary; repeated work must become automation, a playbook, or a product improvement. * **Not a role for someone who needs perfect requirements.** You will help customers discover the real problem and turn ambiguity into an executable technical plan. **Why You’ll Love Working at Nexus** ------------------------------------ At Nexus, we value people who want to grow — and support each other while doing so. You can expect: * A collaborative team culture built on curiosity and respect * Challenging work where your contributions clearly matter * A leadership team that invests in learning and development * The opportunity to work at the intersection of cloud, data, and AI innovation **Ready to Apply?** ------------------- If this role sounds like a great fit — or even *close* to one — we’d love to hear from you. We know that no candidate checks every single box, and we’re excited to meet people who bring curiosity, talent, and a desire to build meaningful work together.

patients, visitors and co\-workers with respect. * Identifies defects within the facility, and accepts personal responsibility for maintaining a clean and safe environment (pick\-up, point\-out and jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description: Position Summary The Support Engineer is responsible for managing and operating the systems environments that support ONLC Training Centers operations and IT training classes. This includes the physical computer systems support operations and classroom hardware, the cloud\-hosted virtual lab infrastructure, the Windows/Linux images deployed to student machines, and the automation used to provision and maintain them. The position combines hands\-on systems administration with lab support for instructors and students and light software development. The successful candidate will ensure that every scheduled class begins with a fully functional lab, will work directly with instructors to prepare course\-specific environments, will contribute automation and process improvements that increase the reliability and repeatability of lab builds and support the systems used by employees in our operations. The position suits a candidate with solid technical fundamentals, strong problem\-solving ability, and a demonstrated interest in building expertise across hardware, cloud infrastructure, and automation. It offers significant ownership and room to shape how the lab environment operates. Key Responsibilities Lab Environment Management (30%) * Manage and maintain classroom lab environments across all training locations, including physical workstations, network connectivity, and peripherals. * Provision, configure, and decommission cloud\-based virtual lab environments to meet class schedules and enrollment. * Monitor lab health and capacity; identify and remediate issues in advance of scheduled classes. * Maintain accurate inventory and configuration records for all lab hardware and cloud resources. * Track and control cloud consumption to ensure environments are sized appropriately and shut down when not in use. Image Development and Maintenance (25%) * Build, test, and deploy Windows/Linux images for individual courses in coordination with instructors and courseware staff. * Install and configure course\-required software with help of Instructors * Maintain the existing image catalog, applying updates as software versions and course content change. * Document image contents, build procedures, and known issues. Customer and Instructor Support (20%) * Serve as the primary point of contact for lab\-related issues during class hours, providing timely resolution for students and instructors. * Communicate clearly and professionally with non\-technical audiences, including customers, in time\-sensitive situations. * Escalate appropriately and follow issues through to resolution. * Identify recurring problems and implement permanent corrective action. Automation and Software Maintenance (15%) * Maintain and enhance the internal software and scripts used to deploy, configure, and manage lab environments. * Develop automation to reduce manual effort in provisioning, imaging, monitoring, and reporting. * Follow established development practices, including version control, code review, testing, and documentation. * Recommend and pilot improvements to lab tooling and processes. Support ONLC Business Operations (10%) * Support ONLC Associates with hardware and software issues. * Recommend improvements of systems or hardware. Required Qualifications * Working knowledge of Windows desktop operating systems, including installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. * Understanding of core networking concepts, including IP addressing, DHCP, and DNS. * Demonstrated scripting ability in at least one language, such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose problems methodically and independently. * Excellent customer service skills, including patience, professionalism, and clear verbal and written communication. * Demonstrated willingness to learn new technologies and take ownership of unfamiliar problems. * Availability during scheduled class hours to support live training delivery. * Ability to lift and transport computer equipment up to 40 pounds and to perform hands\-on hardware work in classroom and server environments. Preferred Qualifications The following are not required. Candidates who meet the required qualifications and demonstrate strong learning ability will be trained in these areas. * Experience with Windows deployment and imaging technologies (PXE/network boot, WinPE, DISM, unattended installation). * Exposure to cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, including virtual machine and virtual desktop services. * Familiarity with virtualization platforms * Experience with Git and continuous integration workflows. * Exposure to infrastructure\-as\-code or automated image\-build tooling (Packer, Ansible, Terraform). * Working knowledge of Active Directory and Group Policy. * Basic SQL and reporting skills. * Relevant certifications, coursework, degree, or documented personal projects and home lab experience. Technical Environment Windows 10/11 imaging and deployment pipelines; PXE and bare\-metal provisioning; classroom management software; Microsoft Azure virtual desktop infrastructure; automated image builds; Git\-based development workflows; PowerShell and Python. Growth and Development This position offers exposure to the full technology stack — physical hardware, operating system deployment, networking, cloud infrastructure, and application code — within a single role. Employees have access to ONLC Training Centers's full course catalog and instructor staff for ongoing professional development and certification preparation. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $74,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Wilmington, DE 19809

jobs.title: Utilities Engineer I
jobs.description: ### **Utilities Engineer I 535146** * 494723 * Stillwater * SYSTEM OPERATIONS (STW) * Staff Full\-time * Master's degree #### **Campus** OSU\-Stillwater #### **Contact Name \& Email** Brigett Broyles, brigett.broyles@okstate.edu #### **Work Schedule** Monday through Friday, 8:00 am\-5:00 pm with occasional evenings and weekends. #### **Appointment Length** Regular Continuous/Until Further Notice #### **Hiring Range** $70,500 \- $110,000/yr (contingent upon available funding) #### **Special Instructions to Applicants** For full consideration, please include a resume, cover letter, and contact information for three professional references. #### **About this Position** Develop and maintain OSU Stillwater campus chilled water, hot water, and steam system models using modeling software. Be a project manager and perform design work on campus chilled water, hot water, and steam systems, and review drawings and applications from outside sources to determine acceptability with OSU specifications. Develop OSU design guidelines for chilled water, hot water, and steam systems. Provide guidance on established engineering practices, procedures, and technical direction to other engineers as needed. Requires strong analytical skills and the ability to pay meticulous attention to detail is required. Must demonstrate solid professional ethics and possess a sound capacity to follow through on tasks. Due to the communication expectations of the position, the incumbent will be required to maintain a personal cell phone for communication during normal working hours. Must work safely, adhere to all safety requirements, and promote a safe work environment. Work conditions include exposure to construction areas, laboratory areas, industrial plants, and mechanical rooms, all of which could be deemed hazardous. Work takes place both in an office and in the field. Employee must use appropriate personal protective equipment as required (gloves, safety glasses, etc.) These items are provided and not for personal use. Requires periodic travel throughout the OSU Stillwater campus: to job sites for training, classes, and meetings, and occasionally off campus to vendors, manufacturing facilities, conferences, and other universities. Constantly positions self to fulfill the duties of the position, which include work on the underground or above\-ground electrical utility distribution systems. Construction sites may include exposure to hazardous materials and systems, including high voltage equipment, steam and high\-temperature water, open mechanical and rotating equipment, high air pressure, open trenches, areas of friable asbestos, and occasional work from ladders or heights; and processes that contain hazardous chemicals, biohazard, and radioactive products. Exposed to extreme heat and cold, working around hazardous equipment. Outside in all types of inclement weather, high levels of dust and noise. This position is heavy in manual labor and requires the physical ability to lift up to 50 pounds frequently and in excess of 50 pounds occasionally. Promotional opportunities may be available through established career development. OSU offers a generous benefits package for continuous, regular positions, including but not limited to health, life, and retirement benefits, paid leave, and 13 paid holidays per year. Other benefits include employee and dependent tuition #### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. (degree must be conferred on or before the agreed\-upon start date) * Utilities Engineer I \- will require 1 year of engineering working experience, including drafting, technical writing, estimating, and design. Utilities Engineer II \- will require 3 years of engineering working experience, including drafting, technical writing, estimating, and design. Utilities Engineer III – will require 6 years of work experience in the practical application of engineering principles. Utilities Engineer IV – will require 8 years of work experience in the practical application of engineering principles. Utilities Engineer Sr – will require 10 years of work experience in the practical application of engineering principles. Candidate position placement is dependent upon years of experience and availability. **Certifications, Registrations, and/or Licenses:** Utilities Engineer I – will require an Engineer in training (EIT) or Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) certification upon hire and/or an endorsement from a current PE. Utilities Engineer II – will require an Engineer in training (EIT) or Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) certification upon hire. Utilities Engineer III – will require a Registered Professional Engineer (PE) in Oklahoma or a PE license in another state, and be able to gain registration through reciprocity within one year of hire. Utilities Engineer IV – will require a Registered Professional Engineer (PE) in Oklahoma or a PE license in another state, and be able to gain registration through reciprocity within one year of hire. OSU FM Leadership program or an equivalent training program certification. Utilities Engineer Sr \- will require a Registered Professional Engineer (PE) in Oklahoma or a PE license in another state, and be able to gain registration through reciprocity within one year of hire. OSU staff supervisor training or other equivalent program certification. Have before hire and maintain after hire, a valid driver’s license. A valid driver’s license must be maintained for the operation of an OSU vehicle, which is required in the performance of job duties as assigned. **Skills, Proficiencies, and/or Knowledge:** Effective oral and written communication skills. Technologically proficient, capable of accurate data entry/retrieval, and learning new software as needed. Proficient in AutoCAD, Civil3D, ESRI, GIS, and KY Pipe. Working knowledge of state and federal safety and environmental guidelines and regulations. Be organized and able to work with campus staff, colleagues, peers, management, and outside contractors. Skillful in basic problem\-solving and interpersonal communications. Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively in a team environment. Basic understanding of building and life safety codes applicable to engineering work. Ability to become proficient in the use of "AiM" Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) software and the use of mobile technology. #### **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's Mechanical Engineering * Seven years of professional experience in mechanical engineering. A minimum of 1 year of experience in chilled water or steam systems design and modeling. Prior experience working with engineers in other disciplines.

jobs.title: Belgard Sales Representative
jobs.description: Job ID: 529202 Oldcastle, a CRH company, is reinventing what's possible in building solutions. We are the leading provider of innovative outdoor living products and utility infrastructure solutions for the water, energy, and communications markets throughout North America. We're a trusted and strategic partner to engineers, contractors, distributors, specifiers, retailers, and homeowners alike as the manufacturer of precast concrete, polymer concrete, and plastic infrastructure products. Our portfolio of brands includes Oldcastle APG, Oldcastle Infrastructure, Belgard® hardscape, Echelon® Masonry, RDI® railing, Catalyst™ Fence Solutions, Sakrete® packaged concrete, Amerimix® mortar, Pebble Technology International® pool finishes, and Techniseal® sands and sealant technologies. **Job Summary** The Belgard Sales Representative will be responsible for the overall sales function of the Belgard product line. This will include maintaining existing business, generating leads, creating new business, increasing customer orders, and developing customer relationships. **Job Location** * This is a remote role. This person must be based in Denver, CO or the surrounding area. **Job Responsibilities** * Responsible for maintaining effective relationships with current customers that lead to increased sales and revenue * Responsible for identifying and prospecting for new customers * Work closely with customers and contractors to develop sales strategies * Analyze market trends and develop action plan to capitalize on shifts in market * Prepare sales projects and prospecting activity reports for monthly meetings * Compile dealer's sales data, interpret buying cycles, share results with production to efficiently plan weekly and monthly production plans * Quote prices, credit terms and prepare sales contracts for orders obtained * Other duties and responsibilities related to the nature of the job may be assigned on a temporary or permanent basis as needed **Job Requirements** * Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience, training and education * 5\+ years related experience managing a multi\-million\-dollar territory * Excellent communication skills * Valid driver’s license * Ability to travel overnight as needed * Ability to lift products up to 50lbs * Experience within the building materials industry * Ability to navigate through a Customer Relationship Management platform * Preferred Bilingual – Spanish and English **Compensation** * Base salary is $70,000 \- $75,000 plus commisions with annual earnings between $130,000 \-140,000 * Monthly Car allowance * Paid Time Off \- 120 hour per calendar year (pro\-rated in first year) * 401(k) plan * Short\- term and long\-term disability benefits * Nine Paid Holidays per year **What CRH Offers You** * Highly competitive base pay * Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs * Group retirement savings program * Health and wellness programs * An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion **About CRH** CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization. jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer - Endpoint Access Agents
jobs.description: Santa Clara, California, United States of America Product Engineering Ref ID: JR\-022917 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. **Job Summary** As a Distinguished Engineer for Endpoint Engineering, you will be the chief architect and technical authority for Palo Alto Networks’ access agent platform. You will own the unified architectural vision across our core endpoint clients including GlobalProtect, Prisma Access Agent, ADEM, and many others spanning Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android. In this high\-visibility role, you will lead the evolution of our endpoint portfolio from distinct product agents into a unified, high\-performing platform foundation. By establishing shared networking, IPC, core application logic, and observability layers, you will ensure that every capability and performance optimization built in one agent automatically powers them all. Furthermore, you will define how endpoint software is engineered in an AI\-native world embedding automated defect verification, intelligent telemetry analysis, and smart crash triage into our global release pipeline. This is a high\-leverage "build\-the\-foundation" role with direct executive sponsorship, a clear evidence\-backed mandate, and an organization ready to execute under your vision. **Your Impact** --------------- * Define the Platform Architecture: Architect a high\-performance, modular core for networking, crypto, configuration, and telemetry that sibling products configure rather than rebuild. * Establish Secure Seams \& Extensions: Create localized plugin models so that new auth methods, protocol extensions, or tunnel types land once and become immediately available across all platforms. * Systemic Quality \& Reliability by Design: Own the endpoint architecture standardizing peer identity, least\-privilege decomposition, resilient error handling, and memory safety directly into type systems and CI/CD gates. * Pioneer AI\-Native Workflows \& Supportability: Integrate AI\-driven software analysis, automated crash triage, and automated regression verification into standard build pipelines while driving unified crash analytics and product telemetry to maintain a world\-class Crash\-Free SLO across millions of active enterprise endpoints. * Drive Technical Excellence: Set engineering standards, author key Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), mentor principal and senior talent, and represent our technical strategy with customers and engineering partners. **Qualifications** ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Seasoned and accomplished leadership in Endpoint systems development\`, core networking, and/or OS\-level software development. * Cross\-Product Impact: Track record of defining cross\-team architecture that was successfully adopted across multiple product groups. * Deep OS Internals: Expert hands\-on knowledge in at least two target platforms: + Windows: Kernel/driver models, WFP, services, OS process architecture. + macOS: XPC, System/Network Extensions, IOKit, code\-signing, notarization. + Linux: Netlink, routing, network namespaces, DNS handling. * Legacy Refactoring: Proven experience decomposing complex C/C\+\+ codebases into modular, testable components using incremental, safe refactoring patterns. * Technical Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to align senior engineers and executives behind complex architectural shifts. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with VPN, ZTNA, or SASE client technologies (IPsec/IKEv2, TLS/DTLS, QUIC/MASQUE, split tunneling, posture assessment). * Experience shipping multi\-platform agents at scale (millions of active endpoints) with staged rollouts and telemetry\-backed observability. * Background integrating AI/ML models into software engineering workflows (code review, test generation, defect triage). **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. * /yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. This role will be responsible for establishing and driving hardware reliability and quality processes throughout the New Product Introduction (NPI) lifecycle for next\-generation network security and firewall platforms. The NPI Hardware Reliability Engineer will work at the intersection of Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, Test Engineering, and Operations to ensure new hardware products are designed, validated, manufactured, and launched with a high level of quality and reliability. The ideal candidate has strong experience in hardware reliability, product qualification, failure analysis, NPI, and manufacturing processes, with the ability to translate reliability requirements into practical validation and production controls. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **NPI Reliability \& Quality** * Own and execute the NPI hardware reliability strategy, milestones, and phase\-gate qualification plans from early development through production ramp. * Partner with Hardware Engineering to assess architecture, design changes, and BOMs to identify electrical, mechanical, thermal, and environmental risks early in the product lifecycle. * Define and execute accelerated life, stress, and environmental test plans (including thermal cycling, drop/vibe, and HALT/ALT), setting sample sizes, conditions, and pass/fail criteria. * Analyze test data and trends to validate product readiness against defined reliability targets prior to commercial release. ### **Failure Analysis \& Corrective Action** * Lead root\-cause failure investigations across NPI testing, pilot builds, and early production using structured methods (8D, FMEA, FTA, DOE, Weibull). * Collaborate with Design, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, and CMs to implement, validate, and track closed\-loop corrective actions. * Feed field and post\-mortem learnings back into early NPI cycles to prevent recurring failure modes. ### **Manufacturing \& Supplier Reliability** * Assess supplier and manufacturing reliability risks during EVT, DVT, and PVT builds, auditing critical processes, materials, and component qualifications. * Establish quality controls, test coverage, and containment protocols for critical hardware components and sub\-assemblies. ### **Analytics \& Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Define NPI reliability metrics, statistical models, and dashboards to communicate risks and launch readiness to executive leadership. * Act as the Technical Operations SME for hardware reliability, partnering closely with cross\-functional engineering, program management, and external CM partners. ### **Process \& Framework Infrastructure** * Build, standardize, and scale the company’s NPI Hardware Reliability framework, including templates, phase\-gate criteria, and lessons\-learned mechanisms across multi\-hardware platforms. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5\+ years of experience in hardware reliability, product quality, NPI, manufacturing engineering, or a related discipline. * Experience with reliability qualification and validation of complex electronic hardware. * Strong understanding of hardware failure mechanisms and reliability engineering principles. * Experience working with contract manufacturers and external suppliers. * Experience with NPI processes and production ramp of complex electronic products. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Experience with structured root\-cause and failure\-analysis methodologies. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, schematics, BOMs, specifications, and manufacturing documentation. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Master's degree in Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. * Experience with networking, server, datacenter, storage, telecommunications, or cybersecurity hardware. * Experience qualifying high\-complexity systems containing PCBs, processors, memory, power supplies, thermal systems, fans, chassis, connectors, and high\-speed interfaces. * Experience with HALT, HASS, accelerated life testing, Weibull analysis, reliability prediction, and statistical analysis. * Experience with FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, DOE, and reliability modeling. * Experience with hardware quality systems and ISO 9001\-based processes. * Experience using data analytics and visualization tools to monitor reliability and quality performance. * Experience with RMA / field\-return analysis and incorporating field lessons into NPI. * Experience leading cross\-functional technical projects without direct authority. **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $108,200\.00 \- $174,900\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. Who We Are At Pelican, we engineer products that stand up to the world’s toughest conditions—because the people who rely on us do too. For nearly 50 years, we’ve been a trusted partner for military personnel, first responders, outdoor adventurers, and innovators who push the limits. With a global presence that includes 11 offices, 4 manufacturing facilities, and 4 custom case centers, we create high\-performance protective solutions that ensure our customers can focus on what matters most. Whether it’s transporting critical medical supplies, securing mission\-essential equipment, or keeping expedition gear safe, Pelican products are Built to Protect to Equip for the Mission. At Pelican, your work has a real\-world impact. You’ll be part of a team driven by innovation, craftsmanship, and the shared belief that when the mission is critical, failure isn’t an option. If you’re ready to build something that makes a difference, be part of a team that protects what matters most. **What You'll Do:** * Independently design, develop, and implement automated manufacturing equipment, fixtures, robotics, and control systems. * Lead automation and equipment integration projects from initial concept through installation, commissioning, implementation, and validation. * Program, troubleshoot, and support PLCs, HMIs, robotics, vision systems, servo drives, sensors, and industrial control systems. * Diagnose and resolve complex electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, controls, and automation\-related equipment issues. * Develop and maintain electrical schematics, assembly drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), control documentation, and work instructions. * Support equipment commissioning, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and process validation. * Partner with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Supply Chain, and Engineering to improve manufacturing processes and equipment performance. * Support automation rollouts, equipment standardization, and process improvements across multiple Pelican manufacturing domestic and international Pelican facilities as needed to support automation projects and equipment implementations. **What We’re Looking For:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing problem\-solving skills. * Experience leading or independently managing automation or equipment projects. * Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, and Quality. The Technical Experience We're Looking For We're especially interested in engineers with hands\-on experience in several of these areas: PLC Programming • Robotics • HMI Development • Vision Systems • Servo/Motion Control • Sensors • Industrial Controls • Equipment Integration Electrical Troubleshooting • Pneumatics • Machine Safety • FAT/SAT • Automated Manufacturing **Additional Information:** * This is an onsite position located in Torrance, California. * Domestic and international travel is required as needed to support automation projects and multi\-site initiatives. * This position requires hands\-on involvement with manufacturing equipment and production environments. * Must be able to independently manage multiple technical projects in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Supports Pelican’s commitment to Safety, Quality, Innovation, and continuous improvement. **What’s In It For You:** Join a company that truly values its employees! We offer a relaxed and casual work environment, a strong commitment to giving back to communities, and a focus on employee satisfaction. With regular opportunities to share feedback with leadership and structured performance evaluations, we ensure that your voice is heard and your growth is supported. * Competitive paid time off plans / Holiday pay / extra vacation purchase opportunities * Relocation assistance available for qualified candidates * 401(k) with immediate company match * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage * Health Savings Account Contribution * Wellness Discount Program * Global Mental Wellness Program * Quarterly Employee Celebration Days * Peer\-to\-Peer Recognition Program * Service Recognition Program * Employee Referral Program * Employee discounts on Pelican products and gear * Career growth opportunities across Engineering, Operations, and Product Development * Work on products trusted by military personnel, first responders, industrial professionals, and explorers around the world * Collaborate with experienced engineers and manufacturing teams while influencing products from concept through production * Established global brand offering premium products you'll be proud to support * And more... **Compensation \& Benefits:** Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets.
