jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Rails
jobs.description: #### **About Us** We’re Bolt.new by StackBlitz! We’re the team that brought you WebContainers, the first\-of\-its\-kind technology that made it possible to run Node.js right inside your browser. That breakthrough kicked off our journey in 2019, and it’s what powers the blazing\-fast online IDE used by over 1 million developers every month. But we didn’t stop there. We doubled down on everything we learned and built **Bolt.new** — the fastest way to go from idea to production without writing traditional code. It’s a next\-gen, AI\-powered app builder that helps you create, edit, and deploy full\-stack web and mobile apps instantly, right in your browser. No installs. No setup. Just smart automation and instant dev environments that let you move at the speed of thought. We’re a fully remote team, globally distributed, deeply collaborative, and seriously passionate about building the future of software development. This is your chance to join a small team with a big vision. If you love shipping fast, solving real problems, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, we’d love to meet you. #### **✨ About This Opportunity** We’re looking for a Senior Ruby on Rails Engineerto help build the backend systems that power StackBlitz.com and Bolt.new. In this role, you’ll work on platform features, developer infrastructure, and integrations that enable millions of developers around the world to build software entirely in the browser. You’ll be part of a small, ambitious team focused on making software development more accessible to everyone. If you enjoy building robust systems, shipping high\-quality code, and collaborating across teams — this could be the role for you. #### **️ How You'll Contribute** * Improve the scalability, reliability, and performance of our Ruby on Rails application * Design and optimize data storage using PostgreSQL and object storage services * Build features for teams, organizations, and developer communities * Develop integrations with external platforms to extend our product ecosystem * Help review and shape code from peers to ensure quality, security, and best practices #### **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional experience with Ruby on Rails * 5\+ years of experience with PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases) * Experience with AWS and modern cloud infrastructure * Familiarity with CSS, SASS, HTML, and other templating/styling languages * Experience building web applications with REST or GraphQL APIs * Production experience with Node.js and TypeScript; this role works across both the Rails and Node/TypeScript stacks * Strong communication skills — especially when explaining technical topics * Strong verbal and written English communication skills are required, as this role involves frequent collaboration with team members, stakeholders, and customers where English is the primary working language. #### **Bonus Points** * Familiarity with Cloudflare Workers or edge infrastructure * Interest in working with AI or LLMs * Experience integrating with GitHub APIs or other version control systems #### **A Few Notes** * You do **not** need a college degree to apply * You do **not** need to be located in the U.S. — we’re remote\-friendly * You do **not** need to meet every qualification listed above. If this role excites you, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Standard Bots** ----------------------- Standard Bot's mission is to significantly lower the barrier to entry to real\-world automation, bringing the power of bits to the world of atoms and unlocking productivity for entire new industries and users. Our user\-facing applications and APIs directly empower individuals and developers to jump directly into solving their challenges without the need for a background in robotics or automation. A relentless focus on simplicity and ease of use brings this revolutionary potential to new users and industries. **The Opportunity: Forward Deployed With a Large Robotics API Customer** ------------------------------------------------------------------------ We are looking for an exceptional Staff Software Engineer to work on site with one of our largest customers. That customer is an AI robotics company that drives our arms from its own models through our streaming APIs and SDK. You join our SDK and external APIs team and build on our platform. For the first nine to twelve months, you spend most of your week at the customer's facility in the San Francisco Bay Area. Your impact will be measured not just by fixing their problem but building production level fixes that make it into our product. It will also be measured by how much of what you learn on site shapes the platform for all developers who build on our APIs. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Strategic Architecture \& Long\-Term Vision** * **Define the Future:** Own the technical vision for how advanced customers drive our robots programmatically: realtime streaming control, the Python SDK, ROS 2 integration, and the safety limits that make streamed motion trustworthy across a fleet. * **Decouple and Scale:** Generalize what you learn on site into product capabilities with clear, stable interfaces. Each fix and feature you ship should be brought back to the team to bring into the product for all developers. You keep that standard through all one\-off solutions. * **Standard Setter:** Set the bar for the reliability, safety, and observability of our external control surface. Failure modes found in the field then become tested guarantees in the platform. ### **Complex Project Leadership \& Execution** * **Represent the Customer Inside Engineering:** Be the customer's technical point of contact and the team's eyes on their floor. Convert what you see into prioritized, testable requirements. Hold the line when a request takes the product somewhere unsafe or off the roadmap. * **Pragmatic Trade\-Offs:** Decide clearly between the fast fix the customer needs this week and the durable change the platform needs. Put those decisions in writing for both sides. * **Hands\-on Delivery:** Ship fixes and features across our stack, from TypeScript/Node services and our Python SDK to a ROS 2 adapter and the robot controller. Take each one from a first reproduction at the customer's cell to a release\-gated change in the product. ### **Production Excellence \& Organizational Leverage** * **Systemic Reliability:** Root\-cause the hard problems on site: realtime streaming faults, networking and environment issues, safety stops, and collision behavior. Turn each one into fixes, tests, and runbooks that prevent recurrence across the customer’s fleet. * **Technical Multiplier:** Pair with the customer's engineers to help them diagnose and integrate more on their own. Bring what you learn back to the team, and everyone builds with the customer's reality in view. * **Influence \& Accountability:** Run the weekly working session with the customer's engineers and contribute to the monthly roadmap review with their leadership. Priorities then live in one place, and progress is visible to both companies. **Who You Are** --------------- We are looking for a technically deep, product\-minded engineer who wants to see their work run in a customer's facility every day. You are direct and tactful with customers, hard to push into shortcuts, and quick to ramp on a large existing codebase. You want to spend most of your week at a customer site. **Skills You'll Bring** ----------------------- * **Experience:** 8\+ years of professional software engineering, including ownership of a technical problem space end to end and leadership of complex work across teams. Time as a forward deployed, solutions, or customer\-embedded engineer is a strong plus. Experience with a technical customer that runs its own engineering team matters more than the title you held. * **Debugging Depth:** You root\-cause across a distributed system: Linux, containers, networking, logs, and timing, often on hardware you did not build and with incomplete information. * **Customer Judgment:** You have worked directly with demanding technical customers. You know how to decline a request and offer the roadmap path instead, and you handle sensitive product information with care. * **Clarity of Communication:** You write requirements, incident write\-ups, and decisions that a customer's ML engineer and our leadership can both act on. * **Tech Stack Expertise:** Fluency in Python and TypeScript/Node.js, with range across the rest of our stack (React, C\+\+, Kubernetes). Working knowledge of ROS 2 is preferred. * **Robotics and Realtime Control is a plus:** Hands\-on experience with robot control interfaces such as ROS 2, streaming or trajectory APIs, or motion control at 100 Hz and above. Familiarity with safety stops and collision handling is a plus. **Location and Benefits** ------------------------- This role is on site at our customer's facility in the San Francisco Bay Area, five days a week, for the first nine to twelve months. You start with about a month of onboarding with the team, followed by at least two weeks in our New York City office. After that, you return to New York for a week every one to two months. When the on\-site engagement ends, the role continues on the SDK and external APIs team. ### **Office \& Workplace Perks** When you are in New York, you work from our office near Grand Central Station: * **Direct Access to Robotics:** Work alongside our physical products with dedicated demo and testing cells, allowing you to validate your work on real robots daily. * **Collaborative \& Modern Space:** Enjoy open collaborative spaces for team problem\-solving and focus zones for deep work. * **Customizable Workstations:** We provide ergonomic and customizable setups to ensure a comfortable and productive work environment. * **Amenities:** Daily catered lunch, fully stocked kitchens with snacks and beverages, and regular team events. **Compensation** ---------------- The base salary range for this role is $215,000 to $275,000, depending on experience. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full\-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full\-time employees. Compensation Range: $215K \- $275K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Control Plane
jobs.description: **About Starburst** ------------------- Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock\-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai. **About the role** Starburst is looking for strong Java engineers to work with our globally distributed engineering team on the core of Starburst's software. This role sits on the Control Plane team, whose mandate is to converge the control planes of our two flagship deployment models, self\-managed Starburst Enterprise Platform (SEP) and fully managed Starburst Galaxy, into a single, unified platform. You will design and build backend services and cloud infrastructure that run in both worlds: multi\-tenant SaaS at global scale, and customer\-operated on\-premise and air\-gapped deployments. Both models bring unique and interesting problems, and incredible learning opportunities for any engineer. Starburst offers the opportunity to compete at **global scale** with other elite vendors in the Data Analytics space and external customers. **As a Senior Software Engineer, Control Plane at Starburst you will:** * Design, develop, and maintain control plane services shared by Starburst Enterprise, Starburst Galaxy, and Trino. * Contribute to the Unified Control Plane: take capabilities that exist in one product (access control, multi\-cluster management, routing, catalog management, observability) and deliver them as a single implementation that serves both SaaS and self\-managed deployments. * Own the reliability, scalability, and efficiency (performance/$) of the services you build \- provisioning and upgrading APIs, cluster lifecycle management, and the operational tooling that runs them. * Build for two very different operating models at once: a service Starburst operates at scale, and software our customers deploy and operate themselves across AWS, Azure, and GCP as well as on\-premise. * Provide considerate and timely review of your peers' pull requests and design proposals. * Continuously improve our engineering processes, tests, and systems so the codebase and the team's productivity scale together. * Collaborate with team members and other teams globally, and operate in a fast\-paced environment. * + We prioritize focused work, ensuring minimal time is spent in formal meetings, allowing you to concentrate on coding and PR reviews. + Clearly articulating your ideas in writing — Slack, GitHub PRs, design documents — is essential in our globally distributed team. * Provide exceptional customer support for both internal and external customers. * + We're humbled by the trust our customers place in our platform to crunch their data, and we handle the problems they report with utmost seriousness. * Periodically assist with the React and TypeScript\-based Portal UI that surfaces these features; while knowledge of frontend development is beneficial, it is not a prerequisite. **Some of the things we look for:** * Prior experience developing distributed systems. * Extensive software development experience with Java. * Cloud infrastructure architecture and orchestration experience across at least one major cloud provider. * Experience building and operating backend services that others depend on — APIs, control loops, lifecycle management. * Hands\-on adoption of AI coding tools and agents in day\-to\-day engineering — shipping real code with them, and sound judgment about where they help and where they don't. * Demonstrated experience with software engineering and design best practices. * Appreciation for creating maintainable, performant, and high\-quality software as part of a high\-performing, globally distributed team. * Intrinsic motivation for improving your software engineering craftsmanship. * Comfort with significant autonomy and ownership. * Curiosity to see what other engineering teams are doing, and the ability to connect the dots — essential when the goal is one implementation replacing two. * Demonstration of **Ownership, Grit, and Bias for Action** — core values at Starburst. **Where could this role be based?** * Warsaw \- Remote, Poland **Build your career at Starburst** ---------------------------------- All\-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we're empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry\-proven technology and unprecedented success, All\-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry – and the future. Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more. We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All\-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All\-Stars to show up authentically. Starburst provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Road 3 Design Transportation Engineer Associate

You will be an essential member of a highway design team that collaborates with numerous stakeholders to develop innovative transportation improvement plans. As a **Transportation Engineer Associate,** your duties will include, but are not limited to: * Participating in engineering studies of transportation system improvements and developing alternatives for meeting the goals of the identified improvement. * Analyzing transportation engineering data to determine the optimal operating characteristics for the proposed highway improvement project. * Producing highway designs that are engineered in harmony with national (American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials) and Iowa DOT design guidance. * Participating on a team to produce decisions that balance safety, mobility, environmental impacts, property impacts, cost, and long\-term maintenance. * Performing design and engineering analysis for small to large, highly complex highway improvement projects using advanced civil engineering software applications, including 3D modeling and visualizations. * Preparing roadway construction plans that clearly and accurately convey all aspects of the project. **Preferred Experience:** * Ability to successfully utilize advanced software applications and work in a 3D design environment that produces cutting\-edge 3D machine guidance data for automated construction equipment. * Ability to successfully utilize advanced software applications. **Preferred Characteristics:** * Analyze challenges, define successful solution alternatives, and proactively solve problems. * Passion and commitment to excellence in our highway design products. * Effectively communicate with all levels of management and a wide variety **Additional Requirements:** * Possession of an Engineer certificate issued by the Iowa State Board of Engineering Examiners is required within 24 months of hire. * Licensure as a Professional Engineer is required within 6 years of hire for continued employment as a Transportation Engineer Associate. We encourage you to learn more about the State of Iowa Employee benefits and costs at the State of Iowa Employee Benefits Website! **You have the freedom to flourish in Iowa – Apply now!** Iowa DOT complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact the EEO \& ADA Officer at 515\-689\-1009 or via email at amy.weerheim@iowadot.us. jobs.title: Industrial Photographer
jobs.description: We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Industrial Photographer to join our vehicle engineering team. The successful candidate will play a critical role in supporting engineering projects by capturing high\-quality still photographs and high\-speed video footage of vehicles, components, and testing processes. This position requires technical expertise in photography and videography, a collaborative approach, and the ability to work in a dynamic industrial environment. **Key Responsibilities:** * Capture clear, high\-resolution still photographs of vehicles, prototypes, assemblies, and engineering tests for documentation, analysis, and presentation purposes. * Operate high\-speed video cameras to record vehicle tests and dynamic events, ensuring critical moments are captured for detailed engineering review. * Collaborate with engineers, technicians, and project managers to understand specific imaging requirements and adapt techniques to best support engineering objectives. * Set up and calibrate lighting, backdrops, and camera equipment in laboratory, workshop, and outdoor environments to achieve optimal image quality. * Edit, process, and catalog photographic and video assets, ensuring accurate labeling and secure storage for future reference and compliance needs. * Maintain and troubleshoot photographic and video equipment, including high\-speed cameras, lenses, lighting, and supporting hardware. * Ensure compliance with safety protocols and company policies during all photographic activities within industrial and test environments. * Support presentations, reports, and technical publications by providing visual content that effectively communicates engineering findings and solutions. Requirements: **Basic Qualifications:** * Minimum of an Associate's degree in photography, Visual Arts, Media Production, or a related field * Minimum of 2 years of proven experience in industrial, automotive, or technical photography, with a strong portfolio demonstrating still photographs and high\-speed video work. * Proficiency with DSLR/mirrorless cameras, high\-speed video cameras, and image/video editing software (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro). * Understanding of vehicle engineering processes, testing environments, and the unique challenges of industrial photography. * Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. * Strong communication and teamwork abilities. * Ability to work flexible hours and adapt to changing project requirements. * Physical ability to safely operate equipment and work in industrial settings (e.g., standing for long periods, lifting equipment, working outdoors). **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in photography, Visual Arts, Media Production, or a related field * Experience with specialized imaging techniques such as time\-lapse, macro, and infrared photography. * Familiarity with data security and digital asset management practices. * Background in engineering, automotive testing, or related technical fields.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Student Experience
jobs.description: **About Stepful**: Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice\-ready healthcare workers. Layering onto our successful direct\-to\-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most. Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY\-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more. Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the \#1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025\. **Our values**: We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission\-driven builders who thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values: * **Care first**: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed. * **Learn quickly**: We test, learn with data, and iterate. * **Build together**: We win when we rely on each other. * **Own it**: We show up, take initiative, and show pride. **The opportunity:** -------------------- Thousands of adult learners come to Stepful to change their lives, often while balancing full\-time jobs, families, and financial pressure. Our Student Experience teams build the classroom experience for all of our learners. Every step of their journey matters, from their first day of class through graduation, certification and final licensing exams. As the Product Manager for Student Experience, you'll own the product that carries them through that journey. You won't just optimize what exists. jobs.title: Electrical Test Technician
jobs.description: Flextech Solutions is seeking a hands\-on Automotive Electrical Test Systems Technician or Engineer to join our Traverse City, Buck Building Team. The ideal candidate enjoys hands\-on electrical work and is comfortable reading automotive wiring diagrams, identifying connectors and components, building wiring assemblies, troubleshooting communication issues, and working with automotive electronic control units (ECUs). connectors, wiring, terminals, relay boards, power supplies, network equipment, and other electronic components. * Read and interpret automotive wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, connector views, and vehicle network topology documents. * Wire and connect ECUs to support CAN and other automotive communication networks. * Mount ECUs and related components to test panels using identification tags, brackets, and organized wiring. * Identify and order ECUs, connectors, terminals, wiring, relay boards, and other required materials. * Track ordered and received components using spreadsheets and inventory records. * Assist with test\-system layout, component placement, cable routing, and assembly. * Use automotive diagnostic software and tools to confirm ECU communication and system functionality. * Assist with ECU programming, vehicle configuration routines, scan reports, and other diagnostic procedures. * Troubleshoot wiring, power, communication, and non\-responsive ECU issues. * Replace damaged or non\-functioning components and perform ongoing test\-system maintenance. * Connect test systems to automated testing equipment, Ethernet\-controlled relay boards, network switches, routers, and controllable power supplies. * Create and maintain wiring diagrams, relay\-board configurations, component lists, photographs, scan reports, and other build documentation. * Update assignments, issues, and project status in Jira or a similar project\-management system. * Communicate build status, part shortages, technical problems, and scheduling concerns to the project lead. * Help maintain a clean, secure, organized, and safe electronics assembly workspace. * Perform other related duties needed to support automotive electrical test\-system builds. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Hands\-on experience with electronics, wiring, diagnostics, automotive electrical systems, or a closely related technical field. * Ability to read and follow electrical schematics and automotive wiring documentation. * Experience using electrical hand tools, crimping tools, multimeters, and related test equipment. * Strong mechanical aptitude and attention to detail. * Ability to organize and label wiring and electronic components accurately. * Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to manage multiple assignments and work independently after receiving direction. * Dependable attendance and availability to work on\-site during standard business hours. * Ability to communicate professionally with coworkers, project leads, customers, and suppliers. * Ability to safely lift and move electronic components, panels, tools, and building materials associated with the position. **PREFERRED \- Nice to Have QUALIFICATIONS** Candidates do not need to meet preferred qualifications to be considered. * Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electrical engineering technology, automotive technology, electronics, mechatronics, or a related field. * Experience wiring automotive ECUs, sensors, modules, connectors, or test benches. * Knowledge of vehicle electrical architecture and automotive communication networks. * Experience with CAN, UDS, KWP2000, J1962/OBD\-II, Ethernet, or related automotive diagnostic protocols. * Experience with automotive diagnostic, scan, or ECU\-programming software. * Experience building hardware\-in\-the\-loop systems, electrical test benches, simulator panels, prototype harnesses, or automotive development bucks. * Experience with Ethernet\-controlled relays, network switches, routers, or programmable power supplies. * Ability to create or update CAD\-based electrical drawings. * Experience with Jira or another issue\-tracking or project\-management platform. * Experience maintaining accurate parts, inventory, and build\-tracking records. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE LEVELS** Flextech will consider candidates from either of the following backgrounds: Technician\-level candidates: * Relevant automotive, electrical, electronics, or wiring experience. * Technical\-school education, automotive certifications, military technical training, or equivalent hands\-on experience may substitute for a college degree. Engineer\-level candidates: * Bachelor’s degree * Experience with automotive electrical architecture, ECU integration, diagnostics, validation, or electrical test\-system development is strongly preferred. **SCHEDULE** * Full\-time, hourly position. * Monday through Friday. * Standard availability generally between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. * Occasional schedule adjustments or additional hours may be needed to meet project deadlines. * This is primarily an on\-site, hands\-on position in Traverse City, Michigan. **BENEFITS** * Company 401K Plan, 3% Safe Harbor Match (Eligible after one year) * Profit Sharing (Eligible after one year) * 10 days / 80 hours \- Paid Vacation * Raises are performance\-based * On and off\-site training **ABOUT FLEXTECH SOLUTIONS** Flextech Solutions, LLC provides specialized technical products and engineering support for automotive electronics, diagnostics, testing, and validation. The mission of the organization is to maximize fleet health and delight our customers while minimizing the cost of maintaining the fleet. The Residential Field Service Program Manager is responsible for solving complex, cross\-functional problems that affect our Field Service organization’s ability to operate \& maintain solar and storage assets. This requires partnership with Engineering, Suppliers, Field Service, and other stakeholders to identify root causes, propose solution options, select a solution, implement the solution, and validate efficacy. The Residential Energy Service Operations Programs team is embedded in daily operations, supporting both near\-term execution and long\-term planning. Team members are expected to partner closely with the business to analyze technical data, provide recommendations, and lead cross\-functional decision\-making and implementation of the recommendations. **What You'll Do*** Review primary information from Residential Field Service visits including technician documentation, system performance, site observations, and customer feedback * Structure and categorize causes of Residential Field Service inefficiencies. jobs.description: **What to Expect** The Tesla Battery Cell Data Team owns the database pipeline and databases that store battery test data. Our applications support hundreds of global users; our pipeline supports test labs across the world and dozens of different data streams. We are comprised of data and software engineers. You will be a thought leader in developing solutions as well as managing the implementation and program execution. This requires you to acquire deep subject matter knowledge about the different supply chain and transportation processes, systems and KPIs. It is essential that you can think strategically, connecting the dots in the bigger picture, as well as being comfortable in the details of the deliverables. evaluate and adopt new tools. 4\. **Engineering quality** * Follow coding standards, reviews, CI/release process — AI\-generated code goes through the same review and test gates. * Write tests and docs; control technical debt. 5\. **Business collaboration** * Clarify and break down requirements with the manager and stakeholders. * Follow adoption feedback and fix defects post\-launch. **Education** Bachelor’s degree or above; computer science or software engineering preferred. **Professional Experience** 3\+ years in full\-stack development; experience inheriting and improving existing codebases preferred. **Knowledge \& Skills** Masters the full SDLC (requirements, design, build, test, deploy, operate); jobs.description: Data and intelligence are becoming central to how we identify and unlock transaction growth opportunities in Retail. Our ambition is to help sellers see where the biggest opportunities are, understand what actions are most likely to create value, and learn from what happens in the market, so the next recommendation gets better. Getting there requires more than better analytics or another dashboard. We are building product capabilities that bring together data from across the business, predictive models, commercial context, and frontline execution. The goal is to make increasingly sophisticated intelligence simple and useful for a seller: Where should I focus? What should I do? Why does it matter? And what can we learn from what happens next? Our product organization brings together small, empowered teams across product, engineering, data science, design, and the business. Together, we are building the data and intelligence foundation for Transaction Growth and the experiences that put those capabilities into the hands of sellers. If you're excited about turning complex data into better decisions, working across business and technology, and building products that get smarter through use, we'd love to meet you. **About the Role** ================== The Sr. Product Manager \- Retail Platforms will help shape the data and intelligence capabilities that power Transaction Growth in Retail. You'll sit at the intersection of business, data science, and engineering, connecting the commercial problems we're trying to solve with the data, models, and technology needed to solve them. You'll need to be comfortable moving between those worlds: understanding the needs of a seller, working through a model or data\-quality question with a data scientist, and making trade\-offs with engineering. This is not primarily a backlog\-management role. You'll make real product decisions about how data is brought together and made usable, how models and recommendations are evaluated, how intelligence reaches frontline users, and how we measure whether any of it is actually creating value. A central part of the role is treating data and models as part of the product itself. How do we know a recommendation is good? Did the seller act on it? What happened as a result? What should we learn from that outcome? You'll work with the team to build those learning loops into the product, so recommendations become more relevant and useful over time. Ultimately, the work should make something complicated feel simple: help sellers focus on the right opportunities, take the right actions, and drive measurable transaction growth. You'll be part of a small, empowered product team with the autonomy to discover problems, test ideas, make informed trade\-offs, and improve the product through continuous learning. **Responsibilities** ==================== **Product Ownership \& Strategy** --------------------------------- * Own the vision, outcomes, and roadmap for Retail Transaction Growth data and intelligence capabilities. * Define the business and user problems the team should solve and establish measurable outcomes for success. * Connect Retail priorities to the data, models, and technical capabilities needed to support them. * Balance foundational investments in data and technology with near\-term opportunities to create value for sellers. * Use evidence from the market to continually reassess priorities and where the team should invest. **Data \& Intelligence Products** --------------------------------- * Treat data, models, and decisioning capabilities as products, with clear users, outcomes, quality expectations, and measures of success. * Work with engineering to understand how data is sourced, transformed, connected, and made available to products, and make informed trade\-offs around architecture, pipelines, APIs, quality, and reliability. * Partner with data science to define what makes a recommendation or prediction useful and how model performance should be evaluated. * Determine what signals we need to understand whether recommendations are relevant, whether sellers act on them, and what happens as a result. * Build feedback loops that allow market behavior and outcomes to improve future recommendations. **Discovery \& Delivery** ------------------------- * Spend time with sellers and commercial teams to understand how they work, the decisions they make, and where better data or intelligence could help. * Lead discovery through field research, data analysis, experimentation, prototyping, and testing. * Translate what we learn into clear priorities and product requirements. * Partner closely with engineering, data science, and design to build solutions that are valuable, usable, feasible, and viable. * Define measurement up front and use results to decide what to improve, scale, change, or stop. * Make thoughtful trade\-offs when evidence is incomplete and priorities compete. **Frontline Experience** ------------------------ * Turn complex  signals, and uses what the team learns to improve the product. **Strategic \& Systems Thinking** --------------------------------- Sees the whole system, from business problem and user behavior through data, models, technology, frontline execution, and measurement. Understands how decisions in one part of the system affect the others. **Influence \& Communication** ------------------------------ Makes complicated topics understandable. Builds common ground among commercial and technical teams and creates clarity when different groups come at a problem from different perspectives. **Execution \& Learning** ------------------------- Balances longer\-term product foundations with immediate business opportunities. Our products — including SiteGrades, CPAGrades, and Tod AI, our agentic AI analyst — are all built on a governed data layer where metrics are *defined once and queried anywhere*. The integrity of that layer is central to everything we deliver, and this role exists to protect and extend it. **The Role** We're looking for a Data Engineer who treats governance and foundational discipline as first\-class work, not overhead. You'll own the pipelines that move client data from raw ingestion through to the conformed, permissioned datasets that power our products and our conversational AI. Because we operate in regulated environments, we hire people who are meticulous about the unglamorous parts. **What You'll Do** * Build and maintain data ingestion and transformation pipelines across our platform. * Design and evolve the data models that power our products and analytics. * Implement data governance and access controls appropriate to a regulated environment, keeping client data correctly isolated. * Establish and uphold engineering fundamentals — CI/CD, consistent naming conventions, and environment separation — and hold the codebase to them. * Partner with product and software development to translate client requirements into well\-modeled, usable data. * Support the infrastructure that makes governed data available to downstream consumers, including our AI products. * Monitor data quality and lineage and respond to issues before they reach clients. **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years in data engineering, with hands\-on Databricks experience (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog). * Strong proficiency in **SQL** — comfortable writing complex queries, joins, window functions, and optimizing for performance, designing dimensional/star\-schema data models from ambiguous requirements. · Solid experience with **Python** for data processing (e.g., PySpark, pandas) and scripting · Hands\-on experience with **Databricks** (notebooks, Delta Lake, jobs, clusters) · Excellent **problem\-solving and debugging skills** — able to trace issues through logs, code, and data to find root causes * Demonstrated care for data governance and multi\-tenant isolation — you can speak to how you've kept datasets correctly separated and permissioned. * Experience with CI/CD, version control, and disciplined naming/environment conventions in a data context. * Track record of independently delivering foundational infrastructure work without close supervision. * Clear written communication; you document what you build. **Nice to Have** * Experience in a HIPAA, SOC 2, or otherwise regulated data environment. * Familiarity with healthcare/clinical research or financial/accounting data domains. * Exposure to enabling AI/LLM consumers of a governed semantic layer. * Databricks certification. **Why Todata** You'll work directly with leadership on a platform where your work is visible in the product and in client trust. Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, short and long\-term disability, PTO, matching 401K, fitness center and golf simulator in building and more! Core Values: Have Grit, Be Open, Be Curious, Collaborate, Make It Simple Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * This role is on\-site at our office in Omaha, Nebraska. jobs.title: SR. RIGHT OF WAY TECHNICIAN
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Cary is seeking an experienced and collaborative professional to serve as the Sr. Right of Way Technician. This position is a key resource in supporting the safe, efficient, and well\-coordinated use of the community’s public infrastructure. This position offers an opportunity to apply sound judgment, technical expertise, and relationship\-building skills in a role that directly supports the Town’s growth, development, and delivery of quality public services. The successful candidate will be a trusted partner to internal and external stakeholders and will bring a proactive, solutions\-oriented approach to a diverse and evolving workload. The Sr. Right of Way Technician performs advanced administrative, technical, and professional work involving the management and coordination of public right\-of\-way (ROW) matters. Responsibilities include managing permitting processes, conducting inspections, administering bonding requirements, and ensuring compliance with safety standards and Town regulations during construction, maintenance, and utility operations within the public ROW. The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical and strategic problem\-solving skills and the ability to conduct research, review construction drawings, and manage special assignments. Additionally, this position requires a thorough understanding of Town policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, along with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with contractors, utility companies, developers, residents, businesses, and Town staff. Work is performed under the general supervision of the Business Service Manager in the Facilities, Construction and Field Service Department. Anticipated Hiring Range: $69,139\.20 \- $84,905\.60 **Typical Tasks** ----------------- * Performs field inspections related to ROW encroachment matters; * Responsible for the Right\-of\-way (ROW) permitting approval process; * Responds to complaints and issues related to work in the right\-of\-way; * Responsible for tracking and managing bonds related to Major Right\-of\-Way Encroachment applications for existing master bonds. * Responsible for creating and managing new bonds for work within the Town public right\-of\-way for Minor Right\-of\-Way Encroachment applications that warrants bonding. * Manage web pages and processes via IDT to automate the bond submittal and approval process. * Responsible for street light applications, requests, and reimbursement program. * Reads and interprets construction plans, specifications, and blueprints of difficult complexity and accurately compares them with construction in process. * Conduct field visits as needed to ensure quality control and compliance with contracts performed in the ROW by contractors (e.g., in a clean, safe manner and in conformance with the permit); * Collaborate with consultants and Town stakeholders to process encroachment permits and agreements efficiently and in a timely manner. Coordinates with admin staff as needed to process permits. * Coordinates with the NC Department of Transportation (NCDOT) for work within the NC DOT ROW within Town limits. * Collaborates with internal experts as needed to address review comments and finalize permits; * Perform inspections within Town of Cary right\-of\-way as needed to ensure work is completed per each encroachment agreement; * Assists with traffic control compliance by contractors working in the ROW; * Assist with Driveway reviews and permits; * Responds to calls and resolves complaints in a timely manner from citizens that are submitted through the Town's 311 group, or social media, related to issues within the ROW; * Collaborates with the Town's 311 group to develop processes that help improve customer service and effectively address and resolve issues in a timely manner; * Works with all Town stakeholders to help improve coordination between ROW permits and Town Capital Projects and private development projects. * Utilizes Salesforce, Box, GIS applications, and other tools as applicable to track and store applications; * Assist other groups within the Planning, Inspections, and Development Services groups with administrative tasks as needed. * Performs other duties as assigned. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** ----------------------------------- * Comprehensive knowledge of equipment relating to public works, utilities, and ROW matters; * Ability to read and interpret ROW and engineering/construction plans, specifications, and blueprints of varying complexity; * Comprehensive knowledge of the ROW encroachment permit process. * Ability to establish effective working relationships with utility company representatives, engineers, surveyors, geologists, construction contractors, real estate brokers, real property appraisers, government entities, other property management professionals and citizens; * Ability to proficiently use computer equipment and software such as MS Word, Excel, Salesforce, and GIS applications; * Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing; * Excellent customer service, problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills for interacting with the general public on challenging and complicated ROW matters; * Ability to handle multiple and often conflicting priorities; * Good organizational skills, including the ability to keep detailed business records. **Minimum and Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------------------- Requires a combination of education and experience equivalent to an associates degree in engineering, construction, real estate, or a related field, along with at least three (3\) years of experience in engineering, construction and/or maintenance of roads, storm drainage systems, water and sewer infrastructure, and other public and/or private utility systems. Preference will be given to candidates with the following: * 3\+ years working with utility companies and right\-of\-way matters. * 2\+ years working with the right\-of\-way encroachment and bond process. * 3\+ years of experience working with Salesforce and 311 system. Physical Requirements Work in this class is generally light but may require exposure to various environmental conditions, such as heat, cold and rain, while performing outside inspections related to ROW encroachment matters and infrastructure projects. An employee in this class must have the physical ability to move about freely including the ability to walk over unimproved terrain, climb ladders, stoop, kneel, etc. An employee must have the visual acuity necessary to read construction plans, read typewritten and handwritten materials, and visually inspect ROW sites. An employee must be able to talk and hear in order to communicate with contractors, the general public, and others. Special Requirements * Requires drug testing and background check (which may include criminal history check, SBI finger\-printing, motor vehicle records check, education verification and credit history review) and satisfactory reference checks prior to employment. * Requires a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. ***Cary ensures equal employment opportunities (EEO) are provided to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, political affiliation, marital status, veteran status, or genetic information.***

jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **Senior Growth EngineerRole Details** **Hybrid Work Policy:** San Francisco, CA or Bay Area (Hybrid) **Full\-time Position** **Location:** San Francisco, CA, Bay Area, CA **Tech Stack:** TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, LLM APIs, Datadog, Vercel, React, Next.js, Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Anthropic Claude API, Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog **Equity:** Competitive equity — details shared during the process. **Visa Sponsorship Details:** Open to visa transfers (e.g. OPT, H1B transfers) **Additional Visa Sponsorship Details:** Open to discussion for truly exceptional candidates, but not standard practice currently. **Hiring Count:** Looking to hire **1 \- 2 candidates** for this role **About this Role:Senior Growth Engineer Role** You'll write the code that turns developers discovering Firecrawl into developers who can't live without it. This is a full\-stack engineering role pointed entirely at growth: you'll own the signup, activation, onboarding, and conversion experience, and you'll be measured on the funnel metrics you move, not just the features you ship. You'll instrument, experiment, build, and iterate on the product surfaces that drive our PLG motion. You'll report to our VP of Revenue and Success and own real conversion outcomes from day one. **About Firecrawl:** Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM\-ready markdown or structured data \- the boring\-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved. We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. We have 147k\+ GitHub stars, and developers, agents, and category\-defining AI companies build on us every day. Growth like this is rare, and we're just getting started. We're a small team punching far above our weight. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves \- no hiding behind process or headcount. This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web. **What You'll Do** · Own the growth surfaces end to end: signup, activation, onboarding, and conversion · Instrument the funnel, run experiments, and ship the changes that move real metrics · Build full\-stack, from the frontend a developer first touches to the backend that powers it · Treat conversion and activation as your number, you own it, measure it, and move it · Work close to the data, form hypotheses, test them, and iterate fast on what works **What We're Looking For** · You're a strong full\-stack engineer who's worked on growth or PLG products · You've personally owned a conversion, activation, or funnel metric, and moved it, not just shipped features someone else measured · You think like a scientist: hypothesis, experiment, measure, iterate, and you've run real A/B tests you can talk about, including what you learned when they didn't go as planned · Bonus if you've shipped in\-product growth surfaces at a dev\-tools or SaaS company (onboarding, activation, upgrade flows, in\-product guidance) or built conversion pages that measurably moved signup, not just static pages that shipped · Bonus for experience with our stack (Next.js, React, Tailwind, TypeScript, Vercel, PostgreSQL, and the Anthropic Claude API) or for having built with LLMs in production: prompt engineering, tool use, inference pipelines · You've worked on developer\-facing products, SDKs, playgrounds, docs surfaces, APIs, and understand how developers actually adopt tools · You have a track record of staying with your work long enough to see it through (we look for real tenure, not a trail of short stints) · You move fast and close the loop \- you'd rather ship, measure, and iterate than perfect on paper **What We're NOT Looking For** · A growth marketer, this is an engineering role that writes production code · A backend engineer with no interest in the product surface or the metrics · Someone who's only ever shipped features without owning an outcome · A pattern of short stints, we want someone who commits **A Note On Pace** We operate at an absurd level of urgency because the window for what we're building won't stay open forever. If you've felt what "scaling chaos" is like at a company growing fast from early revenue to real scale, you'll feel right at home. If that excites you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings — but this role probably isn't for you. Pay: $114,703\.03 \- $138,136\.98 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer-Internship
jobs.description: **The opportunity** Unity Vector builds an offline ML platform that powers insight, experimentation, attribution, and AI\-driven decision\-making across the company. Our systems operate at scale across batch and streaming data, supporting analytics, product intelligence, machine learning pipelines, and business operations. As data volume and complexity grow, our platform enables large\-scale model training, feature generation, and experimentation workflows that power production ML systems. We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer,Intern to join our Offline Infrastructure team. This is an ideal role for people who is excited to work on large\-scale systems and apply research\-driven thinking to real\-world machine learning problems. You’ll help build and evolve the infrastructure that powers training data generation, ML workflows, and distributed model training. Working closely with experienced engineers and researchers, you’ll contribute to systems that ensure our ML pipelines are reliable, scalable, and efficient. This role offers the opportunity to bridge research and production—translating advanced ideas into systems that operate at scale. **What you'll be doing** * Build and maintain data pipelines that generate training datasets for machine learning models and experimentation * Contribute to infrastructure that supports distributed training workflows (e.g., PyTorch, Ray) * Work with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Flyte, or similar) to support multi\-stage ML pipelines * Improve reproducibility and reliability through dataset validation, monitoring, and testing * Partner with ML engineers to support experimentation and model iteration * Help optimize performance and efficiency across data processing and training systems * Contribute to the evolution of our offline ML platform architecture as it scales **What we're looking for** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Systems, or a related field * Strong foundation in machine learning systems, distributed systems, or large\-scale data processing (through research or projects) * Experience with Python and working with data\-intensive workloads * Familiarity with ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and/or distributed systems (e.g., Ray, Spark) * Experience (academic or applied) with data pipelines, model training workflows, or large datasets * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to translate research ideas into practical systems * Interest in building scalable, reliable infrastructure for machine learning * Nice to Have * Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Flyte, etc.) * Exposure to large\-scale data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, streaming systems) * Publications or research in ML systems, distributed systems, or related areas **Additional information** * Zone A: $117,000 \- $152,000Zone B: $104,100 \- $135,300Zone C: $92,000 \- $119,600 *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. jobs.description: **The opportunity** At Unity, we don't just help game developers build their games: we help them grow what they've built, and get their titles in front of the right players, through an ad system that makes billions of real\-time decisions every day. Every one of those decisions has to respect what a player has consented to, across dozens of jurisdictions whose rules disagree with each other and change every year. Getting that right at this scale is a permanent engineering problem. It belongs to our Ads Privacy team, which owns privacy compliance alongside the creative moderation and fraud prevention systems that keep the network trustworthy. You will own privacy\-critical services end to end, from design through production. You will work in the request path, where a wrong answer is both a legal exposure and a revenue event. **What you’ll be doing** * Build and operate the systems that carry consent and opt\-out signals from the SDK through to the auction, in the request path at high QPS, owning their latency, correctness, and reliability * Own data subject request fulfilment: orchestrating deletion across many downstream systems and teams, tracking it to completion, and holding the SLA * Translate new and changing regulations (GDPR, CCPA) into per\-jurisdiction configuration and enforcement that ships without a code change per country * Build the measurement and auditing that proves the above is actually working, and catch it when it isn't * Contribute to the team's wider trust and safety surface: content policy enforcement at scale, deduplication and labeling, and tooling that detects and mitigates fraud across the marketplace * Partner with legal and privacy counsel to turn evolving requirements into working systems, and with ML and data engineers to put models and pipelines into production * Manage your own priorities and drive work across team boundaries **What we’re looking for** * Experience designing low\-latency APIs and distributed backend services running at high QPS in production * Proficiency implementing scalable code in Golang; jobs.title: Senior/Principal Electrical Engineer - Spacecraft and Instruments
jobs.description: Requisition Number: 74227 Location: Boulder, Colorado City Boulder State Colorado Employment Type: Research Faculty Schedule: Full\-Time Posting Close Date: 30\-Sep\-2026 Date Posted: 14\-Sep\-2026 ### **Job Summary** Design, analyze, build, and test the electronics behind space science missions. At the Laboratory for Atmospheric and Space Physics (LASP), electrical engineers develop custom flight and ground electronics for scientific instruments and spacecraft exploring Earth, the Sun, the Moon, planets, and the wider universe. We are seeking a senior electrical hardware engineer who enjoys hands\-on circuit design and can carry high\-reliability electronics from requirements and schematic capture through PCB implementation, board bring\-up, environmental qualification, and system integration. This position requires you to be a motivated, largely self\-directed individual contributor with capabilities to also lead a small electrical design team. You will work within a multidisciplinary mission team, make and document consequential hardware decisions, and provide technical direction to keep the electrical design effort moving forward. You will often be the responsible engineer for a circuit\-card assembly or instrument electrical subsystem, but people management is not the focus of the position. CU is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. We are committed to creating a workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. ### **Who We Are** LASP combines the agility of a university laboratory with the technical capability of a premier space mission organization. Engineers work directly alongside scientists, students, and mission operators, allowing technical decisions to move quickly while maintaining scientific excellence. As part of the University of Colorado Boulder (CU), LASP began in 1948 and is a world\-recognized space science research institute that implements the full life cycle of science missions from the definition of the science questions through the development of space flight hardware and the subsequent mission operations. We are the only research institute in the world to have sent science instruments to all eight planets, Pluto, and beyond the solar system. LASP combines all aspects of space exploration through our expertise in science, engineering, mission operations, and scientific data analysis. As part of CU, LASP also works to educate and train the next generation of space scientists, engineers and mission operators by integrating undergraduate and graduate students into working teams. Our students take their unique experiences with them into government or industry or remain in academia to continue the cycle of exploration. ### **What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be** * Focused design in at least one area of discipline including analog, mixed\-signal, power, motor\-control, embedded, and high\-speed digital electronics for spaceflight instruments and small spacecraft. You should have deep experience in at least one of these areas. * Develop electrical requirements, interfaces, architecture, grounding, power and performance budgets, fault\-management concepts, and verification plans with systems, FPGA, software, mechanical, thermal, science, manufacturing, quality, parts, and radiation engineers. * Capture schematics in Altium Designer, guide and review PCB layout, and release circuit\-card assembly (PCBA) design data for fabrication and assembly. * Select EEE parts; complete derating, worst\-case, reliability, and circuit\-performance analyses; and model designs using LTspice, PSpice, Ansys, or comparable simulation tools. * Bring up and debug new hardware in the laboratory, support EMI and EMC, thermal\-vacuum, vibration, and other environmental tests, investigate anomalies, and integrate electronics with instruments or spacecraft. * Prepare and present design decisions, technical risks, verification results, and readiness evidence at internal design reviews and mission milestone reviews. Provide technical leadership and mentoring within small project teams. * Other Duties Assigned The engineer who will thrive here You can move between schematic design, PCB review, circuit analysis, laboratory troubleshooting, supplier conversations, and project decisions without losing the technical thread. You communicate assumptions and residual risk plainly, work well across disciplines, and build the documentation and configuration discipline required for reproducible, reviewable flight hardware. Your experience allows you to work day\-to\-day with minimal direction and you are excited to mentor early career engineers and student engineering assistants. ### **What You Should Know** * Because this position requires access to export\-controlled information, appl main, such as analog or sensor electronics, power conversion, motor control, embedded systems, FPGA\-enabled hardware, or high\-speed digital design, with working breadth across adjacent disciplines. * Schematic capture and PCB design experience using Altium Designer, or transferable experience with Cadence OrCAD or KiCad. * Experience modeling and simulating circuit performance using LTspice, Ansys, MATLAB, Python, or similar tools * Hands\-on experience in the lab for board bring\-up, electrical test, and troubleshooting with standard laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, spectrum analyzers. * Experience working in multidisciplinary teams and providing technical leadership for a major engineering work package, design review, or hardware\-development effort. Strong candidates build expertise in different ways. If this work excites you and you meet many of these core qualifications, please apply even if your background does not include every core or preferred qualification. ### **What You Will Need** You are comfortable making progress when requirements are incomplete and several risks interact. You can move between architecture, schematic and PCB review, circuit analysis, laboratory troubleshooting, supplier conversations, and program decisions without losing the technical thread. You communicate assumptions and residual risk plainly, mentor other engineers, and build the documentation and configuration discipline needed for reproducible, reviewable flight hardware. You are motivated by LASP’s mission of exploration and furthering humanity’s understanding of the cosmos. ### **What We Would Like You to Have** * Experience with spaceflight, avionics, or other high\-reliability electronics, including radiation effects and mitigation, EEE parts, and design for thermal, vacuum, vibration, or shock environments. * Working knowledge of electronics manufacturing standards, including IPC\-6012 and IPC/WHMA\-A\-620 and experience selecting EEE parts and applying derating guidance such as NASA EEE\-INST\-002\. * Experience using advanced design simulation and analysis software such as Siemens HyperLynx for signal integrity, power integrity, or high\-speed PCB analysis. * Knowledge of high\-speed digital interfaces and hardware design using AMD Xilinx and Microchip FPGAs and DDR3 or DDR4 memory. * Experience presenting to and interfacing with project customers through requirements definition, project milestone reviews, design reviews, and anomaly investigations. * Experience with EMI and EMC design, test, troubleshooting, and corrective\-action closure. * Experience with design for manufacture and test, rigid\-flex PCB or harness design, supplier coordination, production support, or automated electrical test. * Experience performing worst\-case circuit analysis, electrical parts stress analysis, failure modes and effects analysis, or reliability analysis for high\-consequence hardware. ### **Special Instructions** To apply, please submit the following materials: * Resume or CV. * Cover Letter. (Optional) Transcripts/Proof of Degree: If you are selected as the finalist, your degree will be verified by the CU Boulder Campus Human Resources Department using an approved online vendor. However, if your degree was obtained outside of the United States, please submit an English\-translated version as an Optional document. Please apply by 9/30/2026 for consideration. Note: Application materials will not be accepted via email. For consideration, applications must be submitted through CU Boulder Jobs. In compliance with the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act, in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age\-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. #### **Posting Contact Information** **Posting Contact Name:** Boulder Campus Human Resources **Posting Contact Email:** Recruiting@colorado.edu

Populate technical engineering responses to end\-user questions, coordinate responses with licensing personnel, hold screenshare sessions to help end\-users navigate the interface and/or resolve technical challenges, and ensure that any feature requests or potential software bugs are reported to senior programmers/engineers. jobs.description: * JR10001334 * On Site * Madison, Wisconsin * Instructional **Job Category:** ----------------- Academic Staff **Employment Type:** -------------------- Regular **Job Profile:** ---------------- Radiation Oncology Medical Physicist **Job Summary:** ---------------- It’s an exciting and transformational time to join the University of Wisconsin! The Radiation Oncology Physics Section in the Department of Radiation Medicine at the UW–Madison School of Medicine and Public Health is seeking a dynamic, collaborative Director of Clinical Physics. We are a highly engaged team of 27 physicists, 6 residents, 2 clinical engineers, and medical physics assistants across 2 major hubs and two satellite locations. With a strong foundation already in place, we’re looking for a leader eager to help propel our program forward—advancing technology, introducing new ideas, and guiding emerging clinical initiatives. Over the next 1–3 years, several major imaging, therapy, and software projects will launch, offering exceptional opportunities to shape clinical practice, integrate cutting‑edge technologies, and influence the future of our clinical capabilities. The successful Director of Clinical Physics will provide leadership, mentorship, and performance management for clinical and support staff. They will be central to clinical project management, operational oversight, and fostering a culture of excellence and innovation. We are deeply committed to supporting scholarly activity, professional development, and research, providing abundant opportunities for growth, creativity, and meaningful impact within a forward‑thinking physics and departmental leadership team. Administrative effort will be balanced with clinical activities, teaching, and academic pursuits. The UW\-Madison University campus currently includes a Viewray MRIdian Linac with daily online adaptive radiation therapy, three Varian TrueBeams (one STx), an AccuRay Stellar with Synchrony and online ART capabilities expected, and two Elekta Flexitron Remote Afterloaders. We offer a broad range of special procedures, including SRS/SBRT, TBI, TSE, and brachytherapy for a wide range of treatment sites (e.g., GYN, breast, prostate) with MRI\-guided planning and BodyTom CT for image verification. In Fall 2024, we opened our dual\-hub UW Health Cancer Center, Eastpark Medical Center location on Madison's east side. The 469,000 square foot state\-of\-the\-art facility introduced two new Varian TrueBeams, a Varian Edge, and an Elekta Flexitron Remote Afterloader coupled with Siemens multi\-energy CT on rails. Both locations offer advanced simulation capabilities using Siemens dual\-energy computed tomography with upgrades to photon counting CT simulation planned and 1\.5 T GE MR\-simulator units. Aria Record and Verify systems and advanced treatment planning via RayStation are fully integrated with central planning and chart checking between our two major hubs. The Director of Clinical Physics will have opportunities to collaborate with physics leaders across the growing imaging, theranostics, SRS, and proton therapy programs, facilitating alignment of practice standards, technology development, and strategic initiatives across the department. The proton therapy program, which opened for patient care in July, 2026, includes a Hitachi synchrotron, high\-energy beam transport, intensity modulated proton therapy (IMPT) capability, a gantry room with 360\-degree rotation, and an upcoming fixed beam room with a first\-of\-kind upright patient positioning system provided by Leo Cancer Care coupled with on\-board CT. Additional academic opportunities, based on the candidate's interests and accomplishments, in research, education, and service are fully encouraged and supported, including interactions with the Department of Medical Physics Graduate Program. UW is a state\-of\-the\-art integrated clinical, research, and training facility, ranked number 1 in Wisconsin in the U.S. News \& World Report for the 12th consecutive year and ranked 2nd in the TIME World’s Top Public Universities of 2026, that continually invests in the latest technological advancements.
